Job Title: Maintenance Supervisor, Industrial Manufacturing                   
Location:  Alsip, IL
 
About Us
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.  

Job Overview:
Build the team. Strengthen the maintenance systems. Drive reliability. Keep production moving.  Ingersoll Rand’s Alsip facility supports the IRP, MP Pump and Oberdorfer Pump businesses, trusted brands known worldwide for reliable, innovative and durable fluid-handling solutions. We are seeking an experienced, hands-on Maintenance Supervisor who is, first and foremost, a skilled people leader with a proven track record of building and improving maintenance operations in an industrial manufacturing environment.

This strategic, highly visible role will help shape the maintenance function across a large, complex machine shop supporting more than 80 machining centers. We need a builder—not simply someone to maintain an established maintenance program. The successful candidate will bring the technical expertise, leadership and initiative to strengthen maintenance processes, establish accountability and move the organization from reactive repairs toward a more proactive, planned and reliability-focused operation. This role requires demonstrated success in developing preventive and predictive maintenance (PM/PdM) programs, owning and optimizing CMMS processes and work-order quality, improving maintenance planning and scheduling, and strengthening spare parts and asset management. This leader will use key reliability measures, including downtime, MTTR and MTBF, to identify opportunities, measure results and drive continuous improvement.

Equally important, this individual will develop a skilled, accountable maintenance team by setting clear expectations, identifying training needs and fostering a culture of safety, ownership and operational excellence. The ideal candidate brings recent, hands-on maintenance leadership experience in an active industrial production environment and strong knowledge of mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic and control systems. CNC expertise is helpful but not required, and union-environment leadership experience is highly valued.

Working closely with Operations, Engineering, EHS, Purchasing and Finance, this supervisor will develop people, influence maintenance strategy, improve equipment reliability and help position the Alsip facility for continued growth.  If you are a hands-on maintenance leader who thrives on building teams, improving systems and creating a stronger, more reliable operation, we want to hear from you.

Responsibilities 
Maintenance Execution & Reliability:
  • Supervise and direct maintenance technicians in the completion of preventive maintenance (PM), corrective work orders, and emergency repairs.
  • Prioritize and assign daily work to maximize equipment uptime and minimize production disruption.
  • Lead troubleshooting of mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, and controls issues on CNC machining and production equipment.
  • Ensure PM schedules are executed on time and to standard; escalate recurring failures for root cause analysis.
  • Own accurate work order and equipment records within the CMMS/TPM system.
  • Coordinate spare parts availability with the storeroom to reduce downtime.
 
Cross-Shift Continuity:
  • Conduct structured shift handoffs, documenting open work orders, equipment status, and outstanding safety concerns to the incoming supervisor.
  • Maintain alignment with the other shift's supervisor on shared priorities, PM completion, and carry-over repairs.
  • Ensure consistent standards and expectations are applied regardless of shift.
 
Leadership & People:
  • Provide direct supervision, coaching, and development for maintenance technicians.
  • Support hiring, onboarding, training, and skills development for the maintenance team.
  • Hold the team accountable to performance, attendance, and quality expectations.
  • Foster a positive, collaborative, and accountable team culture.
 
Environment, Health & Safety:
  • Champion a safe workplace through daily engagement, inspections, and hazard identification.
  • Enforce LOTO, machine guarding, PPE, and all applicable EHS policies and OSHA requirements.
  • Support accident investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective action follow-up.
  • Verify JHAs are current and technicians are trained before performing tasks.
  • Oversee contractor safety compliance for work performed on their shift.
  • All other duties as assigned

Continuous Improvement
  • Lead and support continuous improvement and reliability initiatives (PM optimization, downtime reduction, standard work).
  • Analyze downtime and failure trends and recommend engineering or process improvements.
  • Assist with budget input and assessment of new technology or equipment.
 
Requirements:
  • Technical degree in a mechanical, electrical or industrial discipline, trade certification, or equivalent maintenance experience.
  • 3–5+ years of progressive maintenance leadership or supervisory experience in an industrial manufacturing environment, ideally in a union environment.
  • 3+ years of hands-on industrial maintenance experience supporting production equipment.
  • 2+ years of experience developing, implementing or significantly improving preventive and predictive maintenance (PM/PdM) programs and maintenance processes.
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience managing and optimizing CMMS processes, such as maintenance planning and scheduling, and using reliability metrics (downtime, MTTR, MTBF) to drive equipment performance improvements.
  • 2+ years of working knowledge of OSHA regulations, LOTO and machine guarding.

Core Competencies
  • Authentic, approachable leader who earns trust and respect.
  • Decisive and results-driven, particularly under time-sensitive conditions.
  • Clear communicator who collaborates effectively across shifts and functions.
  • Exercises sound judgment and consistently delivers on commitments.
  • Proficient with CMMS platforms, TPM practices and Microsoft Office.

Preferences:
  • MaintainX platform exposure 
  • CNC machining maintenance experience. 
  • Lean manufacturing exposure.

Travel and Work Arrangement
  • Onsite role at the Alsip, IL manufacturing facility.
The pay range for this role is an annual base of $85,000 - $95,000. The pay range considers a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location.

The Regional Sales Manager will concentrate on assigned product and/or group of products in order to increase revenue, market share and profitability for assigned product. They will be responsible for the P&L of this product and doing all the necessary things to continue to make it sustainable and profitable for SSI.

Responsibilities:

  • Promote the product line with reps to drive pre-selection wins using strong spec-positioning strategies and tactics.
  • Provide sales support to reps, end users, and consultants on applications, design specifications, and pricing.
  • Develop product-specific selling strategies and maintain competitive intelligence to support growth objectives.
  • Collaborate closely with Engineering, Process, Production, Field Services, and Installation teams to ensure accurate, timely fulfillment of customer needs.
  • Manage project profitability in alignment with SSI norms and participate in sales presentations as needed.
  • Serve as an expert in equipment design and applications, ensuring compliance with local regulations and supporting customer troubleshooting.
  • Contribute ideas for product improvements, cost reductions, win strategies, resource allocation, and the development of new offerings.
  • Support on-time, on-budget development and launch of innovative commercial and technical solutions, while participating in ISO-9001:2015 compliance.
  • Understand the market, competitive landscape, and product features/benefits; create product messaging and maintain accurate installation lists with marketing.
  • Work with marketing and engineering to update sales tools (specs, drawings, case histories), train sales reps, and maintain useful bid-related metrics for Engineering.

Requirements:

  • High School Diploma
  • 5+ years relevant industrial product sales experience 

Core Competencies:

  • Channel Sales Expertise: Strong understanding of channel sales strategies, including managing partner networks, driving revenue growth, and achieving measurable results through collaboration.
  • Strategic Thinking and Planning: Ability to assess market opportunities, develop actionable strategies, and set specific, measurable goals to drive growth and profitability.
  • Customer-Centric Approach: Skilled at building strong relationships, understanding customer needs, and providing tailored solutions to ensure high satisfaction and repeat business.
  • Technical Proficiency: Proficient in process engineering, troubleshooting product issues, and guiding customers through product selection, installation, and maintenance.
  • Strong Communication and Collaboration: Excellent interpersonal, negotiation, and persuasion skills to foster positive relationships with customers, vendors, and internal teams.
  • Time and Task Management: Highly organized with strong time management skills, ensuring timely execution of tasks while balancing multiple priorities effectively.
  • Business Acumen: High level of business and financial acumen, enabling informed decision-making and alignment with organizational goals.
  • Self-Motivation and Discipline: Demonstrates intrinsic motivation, a disciplined work style, and the ability to work independently while contributing as part of a team.
  • Technology Proficiency: Skilled in using Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, Outlook) and CRM tools like Salesforce to document and manage sales opportunities.

Preferences:

  • Bachelor’s Degree highly preferred in: Engineering, Business, or Business 
  • Strong positive displacement and centrifugal blower systems experience demonstrated
  • 5+ years outside sales experience in water/wastewater treatment and solutions
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce
  • Working knowledge of SAP

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:

  • Up to 50%+ overnight travel is common with this role
  • This is a remote based position that is to be located near a major airport in the U.S.

The total pay range for this role, not including incentive opportunities, is $110,000 - $130,000. The pay range takes into account a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location.  Hired applicant will be eligible to receive (discretionary/nondiscretionary) annual bonuses and incentive compensation.

Location: Campbellsville, KY or Davidson, NC
 

About Us
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Job Overview
As a Design Engineer II for Reciprocating Products, you will be responsible for the design, development, analysis, testing, and continuous improvement of reciprocating compressor products and related systems. This role focuses on the mechanical design of compressor components and assemblies, supporting new product development, product enhancements, and sustaining engineering initiatives.

The successful candidate will apply mechanical engineering principles to develop innovative and reliable compressor solutions that meet performance, quality, cost, manufacturability, and customer requirements. This position requires close collaboration with manufacturing, testing, sourcing, quality, service, and product management teams.


Responsibilities
  • Design and develop reciprocating compressor components and assemblies.
  • Create and maintain engineering drawings, 3D models, specifications, and bills of materials using CAD tools.
  • Perform engineering calculations, analytical studies, and simulations to validate component strength, durability, thermal behavior, vibration characteristics, and overall system performance.
  • Support product development activities from concept through prototype validation, testing, production launch, and field support.
  • Evaluate compressor designs for performance, reliability, safety, manufacturability, and cost optimization.
  • Investigate product performance issues through root cause analysis and develop corrective actions for field and manufacturing concerns.
  • Collaborate with manufacturing and supply chain teams to improve production efficiency, reduce product cost, and enhance quality.
  • Develop and participate in compressor performance testing, design verification, and validation activities.
  • Ensure designs comply with applicable industry standards, customer requirements, and engineering best practices.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on product reliability, durability, efficiency, and customer satisfaction.
  • Manage engineering projects and workstreams with limited supervision while meeting project schedules and business objectives.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers and engineering support personnel.
  • Work cross-functionally with global engineering, operations, quality, testing, and service organizations to deliver successful product outcomes.

Requirements
  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or Agricultural, Mining engineering discipline
  • 2+ years of engineering experience in mechanical design, product development, sustaining engineering, or related mechanical systems.
  • 2+ years of experience creating or interpreting engineering drawings, 3D models, specifications, and bills of materials (BOM). 

Preferred Qualifications
  • Proficiency with 3D CAD software and engineering documentation practices.
  • Working knowledge of engineering calculations, GD&T, and manufacturing processes.
  • Experience with compressors, pumps, engines, rotating equipment, reciprocating equipment, pressure systems, or industrial machinery.
  • Experience supporting design verification, validation testing, performance testing, or simulation and analysis activities.
  • Exposure to reliability, durability, vibration, thermal, fatigue, airflow, or pressure-related design considerations.
  • Experience working across manufacturing, quality, sourcing, service, testing, or product management teams.
  • Familiarity with Design for Manufacturing/Assembly, value engineering, cost reduction, or continuous improvement initiatives.

Key Competencies
  • Strong mechanical engineering aptitude with the ability to analyze complex technical challenges, develop practical solutions, and drive continuous improvement in product performance, reliability, and quality.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage engineering projects and product development activities of moderate to high complexity, balancing technical, schedule, and business objectives.
  • Effective collaborator and communicator who works successfully across multidisciplinary teams and influences stakeholders to achieve project goals.
  • Results oriented professional with strong organizational skills and a customer-focused mindset, committed to delivering high-quality engineering solutions throughout the product lifecycle.

Travel & Work Arrangements / Requirements
  • Ability and willingness to travel up to 10-15%, primarily to manufacturing facilities, testing laboratories, customer sites, and supplier locations.
  • Occasional hands-on support of prototype builds, testing activities, and field investigations.

Job Overview:?? 
The Customer Service Specialist plays a critical role in delivering a high-quality customer experience through effective execution of the order-to-cash process. This position owns the day-to-day transactional relationship with customers and ensures accurate, timely processing of orders, claims, and service requests. 

This role serves as the primary interface for customer inquiries and is accountable for managing order lifecycle performance, resolving issues, and coordinating cross-functionally to meet customer and business objectives. Success in this role requires strong execution discipline, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. 

Responsibilities:?? 

  • Own the end-to-end order lifecycle (quote to invoice) with accountability for accuracy, cycle time, and on-time delivery performance  

  • Serve as the primary customer interface for all transactional and service-related inquiries across phone, email, EDI, and portal channels, ensuring timely and professional resolution  

  • Execute and validate order entry, pricing, and configuration requirements in compliance with commercial policies, contracts, and system controls  

  • Proactively manage order flow, including backlog, backorders, allocation, order holds, and delivery commitments; communicate risks and recovery plans to customers and Sales  

  • Resolve order, pricing, and fulfillment issues within defined authority levels; escalate issues with clear problem statements and recommended solutions when needed  

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for customer claims, owning the end-to-end claims process including intake, documentation, root cause analysis, cross-functional coordination, and timely resolution  

  • Partner with Sales to support account execution, including quote follow-up, order conversion, and proactive outreach on opportunities such as restocking, expediting, and lifecycle replacements  

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Operations, Supply Chain, and Finance to remove barriers and improve service performance  

  • Maintain data accuracy and adhere to standard work processes to support operational efficiency and consistency  

  • Identify opportunities for continuous improvement in order-to-cash processes and customer service execution  

  • Other duties as assigned 

? 

Requirements:?? 

  • Associate’s degree in Business or a related field preferred or equivalent experience considered  

  • 2–5 years of experience in customer service, inside sales, or order management in a manufacturing, industrial, or distribution environment  

  • Proven experience working within ERP systems (SAP preferred) with strong attention to data accuracy

Preferences:

Job Overview:

The ideal candidate will manage a team of 10 employees, ensure efficient processes, and maintain compliance with company policies and systems. This role is integral to ensuring timely and accurate execution of work orders, material planning, customer communication, and safety reporting.

  • Lead a team of 10–15 shop employees, including general labourers, mechanics, machinists, and welders.

  • Support the selection and onboarding of new suppliers.
  • Review the sales order backlog and update the revenue forecast.
  • Oversee fixed assets and mobile equipment, including expense reporting.

  • Oversee site shipping and receiving activities.
  • Ensure the quality of completed work and projects.

 

Requirements:

  • Experience in the blower industry or similar industry.

  • Proven supervisory experience in a shop or manufacturing environment.
  • Proficiency in ERP systems (existing experience with Oracle is an asset)

Job Overview:

Ingersoll Rand is seeking a diligent and skilled Blower Mechanic. The role involves a hands-on, mechanically inclined individual with at least three years of experience as mechanic in a relevant industry. Primarily focused on the disassembly, inspection, rebuilding, and maintenance of blowers and pumps. The position requires proficiency in dynamic balancing of lobes, regular performance of maintenance and repair tasks, and adherence to detailed inspection reports for troubleshooting and rectification of equipment malfunctions. The successful candidate will also assist in the dynamic balancing and testing of PD (Positive Displacement) blowers, contribute to the maintenance of the service facility, and collaborate with certified technicians on various projects. A basic understanding of mechanical equipment, particularly blowers, pumps, and vacuum trucks, is a strong asset. The role demands a candidate with the ability to interpret technical reports, a strong work ethic, team collaboration skills, and a commitment to safety and company standards.

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Disassemble, Inspect & Rebuild Blowers
  • Perform regular maintenance and repair tasks on blowers and pumps.
  • Follow detailed inspection reports to assess and rectify equipment issues.
  • Perform Repair on blowers.
  • Assist in the dynamic balancing and testing of Positive Displacement (PD) blowers.
  • Contribute to the upkeep of the service and repair facility.
  • Ensure that all tasks are completed to meet or exceed specifications.
  • Collaborate with certified trades technicians in various maintenance projects.

Qualifications:

  • Mechanical experience (3 years of experience minimal).
  • Formal training in heavy equipment or industrial equipment (strong asset, not required).
  • Basic understanding of mechanical heavy equipment, specifically blowers and pumps, and vacuum trucks (strong asset).
  • Welding experience (strong asset).
  • Ability to interpret inspection reports and follow maintenance protocols.
  • A strong work ethic and the ability to work in a team environment.
  • Capable of adhering to safety standards and company policies.

Job Title: Account Manager
Location: Remote - Territory - Winchester, VA to Roanoke, VA on I-81

About Us:
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. Job Overview: 
Ingersoll Rand’s Compression Systems and Services Customer Center is hiring a General Line Account Manager to join their team. In this role, you will be responsible for driving the Customer Center equipment sales and service activity for a specific territory. Traveling in a defined geographic area, this includes quoting, strategizing, prospecting, and developing relationships to achieve revenue targets, maximize profits, increase market share and maintain customer loyalty while achieving organizational goals. The position is a unique blend of supporting a major distributor and selling direct to customers. 

Responsibilities:

  • Generate Revenue - Responsible for generating sales of equipment, service contracts, and service offerings with our direct end users and partners selling to a defined customer base within a geographic area.  Develop existing customer base and secure new, competitive accounts to expand IR presence in the market. Provide and design compressed air solutions to fulfil industrial customer needs. Products include compressed air equipment, accessories, turnkey installations, service contracts, parts, service, rental equipment and energy audits. Keep current with all product knowledge, industry standards and training needed. Execute strategy for continuous improvement and exceeding customer satisfaction. Achieve all assigned sales targets.  
  • Develop People Capabilities - Provide selling skills and product/services training for dealer sales personnel (as required) as well as personnel within the Customer Center. Partner with services team to best understand products and services and satisfy and anticipate customer’s needs.  
  • Manage Cash - Ensure that all orders obtained are error-free with correct customer documentation. Ensure resolution of all customer disputes. Manage all costs associated with selling efforts, including travel and entertainment expenditures.   
  • Ensure adherence to safety rules (vehicle safety, customer site safety) in the field, as well as in the Customer Center.  
  • Earn customer loyalty by collaborating cross functionally. Leverage best support for customers by partnering with service team to help troubleshoot customer issues or offer unique solutions.   
  • Maintain Customer Relationship Management database including face-to-face customer interactions, assets, agreements, contacts, and opportunities in order management system. Record order follow-up activities (e.g. delivery), reporting requirements (email) and database requirements. Provide feedback on market conditions. Responsible for driving and tracking sales pipeline of all account activity and daily reporting.  


Requirements:

  • High school diploma or GED required
  • 2+ years of an industrial sales business setting or successful completion of the Ingersoll Rand Sales Development Program (SDP).


Core Competencies:

  • Excellent relationship-building and interpersonal skills, including verbal, written and presentation communication skills. 
  • Establishes and builds solid relationships with customers, key institutions and team members 
  • Honest, self-motivated and team oriented. 
  • Able to work within a team environment and independently. 
  • Mechanical and electrical expertise required. 
  • Ability to assess customer needs, analyze and interpret, perform basic equipment performance calculations, and to recommend technical solutions 
  • Tech savvy; knowledge of Salesforce or other CRM software is preferred 
  • Proven business and sales acumen, including the ability to prospect accounts, effectively navigate within a customer organization, value sell, and win competitive accounts 
  • Must have excellent prioritization and time management skills 


Preferences:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, engineering technology, business or equivalent 
  • Knowledge of Salesforce 


Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:

This position will be remote, and may travel within the territory about 50% of the time. A company vehicle and fuel card will be provided. Must possess a valid driver’s license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations included, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving, Multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years. 

Pay Range:
The pay range for this role, not including incentive opportunities, is $60,000 - $75,000. The pay range takes into account a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location. Hired applicant will be eligible to receive (discretionary/nondiscretionary) annual bonuses and incentive compensation.

Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to empower you with the tools and support necessary to take charge of your health, ensuring that together, we can continue to make life better. Our range of benefits includes health care options like medical and prescription plans, dental and vision coverage, as well as wellness programs. Additionally, we provide life insurance, a robust 401(k) plan, paid time off, and even an employee stock grant, among other offerings. These benefits are our commitment to you, so you can be your best at work and beyond.

The Regional Sales Manager will concentrate on assigned product and/or group of products in order to increase revenue, market share and profitability for assigned product. They will be responsible for the P&L of this product and doing all the necessary things to continue to make it sustainable and profitable for SSI.

Responsibilities:

  • Promote the product line with reps to drive pre-selection wins using strong spec-positioning strategies and tactics.
  • Provide sales support to reps, end users, and consultants on applications, design specifications, and pricing.
  • Develop product-specific selling strategies and maintain competitive intelligence to support growth objectives.
  • Collaborate closely with Engineering, Process, Production, Field Services, and Installation teams to ensure accurate, timely fulfillment of customer needs.
  • Manage project profitability in alignment with SSI norms and participate in sales presentations as needed.
  • Serve as an expert in equipment design and applications, ensuring compliance with local regulations and supporting customer troubleshooting.
  • Contribute ideas for product improvements, cost reductions, win strategies, resource allocation, and the development of new offerings.
  • Support on-time, on-budget development and launch of innovative commercial and technical solutions, while participating in ISO-9001:2015 compliance.
  • Understand the market, competitive landscape, and product features/benefits; create product messaging and maintain accurate installation lists with marketing.
  • Work with marketing and engineering to update sales tools (specs, drawings, case histories), train sales reps, and maintain useful bid-related metrics for Engineering.

Requirements:

  • High School Diploma
  • 5+ years relevant industrial product sales experience 

Core Competencies:

  • Channel Sales Expertise: Strong understanding of channel sales strategies, including managing partner networks, driving revenue growth, and achieving measurable results through collaboration.
  • Strategic Thinking and Planning: Ability to assess market opportunities, develop actionable strategies, and set specific, measurable goals to drive growth and profitability.
  • Customer-Centric Approach: Skilled at building strong relationships, understanding customer needs, and providing tailored solutions to ensure high satisfaction and repeat business.
  • Technical Proficiency: Proficient in process engineering, troubleshooting product issues, and guiding customers through product selection, installation, and maintenance.
  • Strong Communication and Collaboration: Excellent interpersonal, negotiation, and persuasion skills to foster positive relationships with customers, vendors, and internal teams.
  • Time and Task Management: Highly organized with strong time management skills, ensuring timely execution of tasks while balancing multiple priorities effectively.
  • Business Acumen: High level of business and financial acumen, enabling informed decision-making and alignment with organizational goals.
  • Self-Motivation and Discipline: Demonstrates intrinsic motivation, a disciplined work style, and the ability to work independently while contributing as part of a team.
  • Technology Proficiency: Skilled in using Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, Outlook) and CRM tools like Salesforce to document and manage sales opportunities.

Preferences:

  • Bachelor’s Degree highly preferred in: Engineering, Business, or Business 
  • Strong positive displacement and centrifugal blower systems experience demonstrated
  • 5+ years outside sales experience in water/wastewater treatment and solutions
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce
  • Working knowledge of SAP

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:

  • Up to 50%+ overnight travel is common with this role
  • This is a remote based position that is to be located near a major airport in the U.S.

Pay Range:
The total pay range for this role, not including incentive opportunities, is $110,000 - $130,000. The pay range takes into account a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location.  Hired applicant will be eligible to receive (discretionary/nondiscretionary) annual bonuses and incentive compensation.

Job Title: Senior Technical Support Engineer

Location: Buffalo, NY; Davidson, NC or Quincy, IL (This role could be performed remotely for strong candidates)

About Us 
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.

Job Overview:

Technical Support Senior Engineer – Compression Technologies and Services is responsible for providing post sales technical support on air product lines for the authorized local service providers. Reporting to the regional Technical Support manager of a designated product range, this position is responsible for understand and driving key product quality and reliability issues, handing escalated customer issues, mentoring of the team, supporting Technical Training as a subject matter expert and leveraging technology, to maximize customer satisfaction, loyalty and retention to assure company business goals are achieved.  This role collaborates with other regional Technical Support teams and enables capability between regions. 

Responsibilities:

• Provide a high level of problem solving in a technical support role.  Frequently takes lead on quality / reliability issues and projects

• Communication skills necessary to effectively lead teams dealing with resolution of complex technical issues with peers, Engineers, Operations and Management

• Provide Top Tier technical support for the field support organizations (IRCC's and Distribution) and directly to customers as required via phone, emails and customer site visits

• Mentor Tech Support team members to enhance the professional and technical skills

• Compile technical bulletins fault trees and troubleshooting guides to ensure field personnel have access to latest updates / reference data. This includes contributing to the Knowledge Base to improve field connectivity and effective troubleshooting, through all mode of multimedia.

• Support the development and implementation of “state-of-the –art” practices and technology and solutions to achieve operational excellence and customer support 24/7

• Engaged in New Product Development / IRPDP activities such as design and reliability, field trial testing / feedback, field upgrades training / technical support capability of new technology. 

• Support contact management capability for high cadence interaction with channel field technicians in support of resolving complex product and system issues impacting our customers.

• Actively involved in weekly global QRMSa issued escalated as a result of know field issues related to negative repetitive quality and reliability trends.

• Subject master / expert (SME) / Champion for a designated line of complex air products.

• Coordinates / participates in the activities of global expertise network leaders to drive Tech Direct knowledge management execution; improve technician effectiveness with faster access to solutions and knowledge base.

• Instruct Technical classes on multiple air product lines

• Global multi-media technical solution authoring, proof reading and deployment.

• Scope & Dimensions: Fiscally responsible for equipment valued around $2,500,000+ USD.  40% Reliability / Projects / content creation, 30% Training, 20% Phone (Phone Calls 5-10, Escalated Issues 5-10 Per day) & Travel 10% 

• Leads calls for Master Techs on field experience and feedback.

Qualifications: 

• Bachelor’s degree or global/regional technical equivalent experience. (e.g. N3)

• 10+ years’ experience in a technical work environment.  Experience and ability to work effectively acting on own initiative with minimal supervision required.    •

• MS Office skills - proficiency in PowerPoint, Excel and Word essential. 

Core Competencies:

  • Work does involve confidentiality to prevent potential exposure to claims against the company either legally or financially
  • Solid Leadership skills, communication & motivation skills, able to build strong internal & external relationships the development of team capabilities. Experience of supporting teams, complex customer issues and projects.
  • Strong Interpersonal Skills, with ability to influence others at different levels.
  • Self-motivation and ability to make and defend complex decisions.
  • Planning and organizational skills with effective follow up and follow through.
  • English language, additional languages are an advantage.
  • Effective communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Presentation skills – customers, channel partners, internal senior management and peers.
  • Influencing skills - customers, internal management and peers
  • Problems faced will usually be difficult and often complex, ability to deal effectively in potentially volatile and highly charged / emotional situations.
  • Required to make technical assessments in complicated product issues, potentially incurring high-cost liability, write and edit detailed technical report. 
  • Work will involve confidentiality to prevent potential exposure to claims against the company either legally or financially.
  • Requires direct customer contact, needs to be confident, courteous and professional in all situations.
  • Pro-active approach to resolving customer issues, taking responsibility to form and lead teams as required to drive corrective actions and follow through to conclusion.
  • Mastery (Skill) and Expertise (Knowledge) – Master / Expert in two of the eight competencies, working to become Master / Expert in one other, with a good understanding of the remaining: 
  • Small Air reciprocating compressors
  • Rotary Air Compressors
  • Air dryers (Desiccant/Refrigerated)
  • Variable Frequency Drives, Electric Motors
  • Industrial Controls and Communications
  • Large Industrial Air reciprocating compressors
  • Industrial Air Centrifugal compressors
  • Industrial Gas Centrifugal compressors
Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:
  • The position requires travel both domestically and internationally including weekends as required, approx. 15% of time.
  • Onsite in Buffalo, NY; Davidson, NC or Quincy, IL (Remote opportunity for strong candidate)
Pay Range:
The pay range for this role is $91,600- $135,000. The pay range considers a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location.

What We Offer 
At Ingersoll Rand, we embrace a culture of personal ownership — taking responsibility for our company, our communities, and our environment, as well as our individual health and well-being. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to empower you with the tools and support necessary to take charge of your health, ensuring that together, we can continue to make life better. Our range of benefits includes health care options like medical and prescription plans, dental and vision coverage, as well as wellness programs. Additionally, we provide life insurance, a robust 401(k) plan, paid time off, and even an employee stock grant, among other offerings. These benefits are our commitment to you, so you can be your best at work and beyond.

Job Title: Maintenance Supervisor, Industrial Manufacturing                 
Location:  Alsip, IL
 
About Us
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.  

Job Overview:
Build the team. Strengthen the maintenance systems. Drive reliability. Keep production moving.  Ingersoll Rand’s Alsip facility supports the IRP, MP Pump and Oberdorfer Pump businesses, trusted brands known worldwide for reliable, innovative and durable fluid-handling solutions. We are seeking an experienced, hands-on Maintenance Supervisor who is, first and foremost, a skilled people leader with a proven track record of building and improving maintenance operations in an industrial manufacturing environment.

This strategic, highly visible role will help shape the maintenance function across a large, complex machine shop supporting more than 80 machining centers. We need a builder—not simply someone to maintain an established maintenance program. The successful candidate will bring the technical expertise, leadership and initiative to strengthen maintenance processes, establish accountability and move the organization from reactive repairs toward a more proactive, planned and reliability-focused operation. This role requires demonstrated success in developing preventive and predictive maintenance (PM/PdM) programs, owning and optimizing CMMS processes and work-order quality, improving maintenance planning and scheduling, and strengthening spare parts and asset management. This leader will use key reliability measures, including downtime, MTTR and MTBF, to identify opportunities, measure results and drive continuous improvement.

Equally important, this individual will develop a skilled, accountable maintenance team by setting clear expectations, identifying training needs and fostering a culture of safety, ownership and operational excellence. The ideal candidate brings recent, hands-on maintenance leadership experience in an active industrial production environment and strong knowledge of mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic and control systems. CNC expertise is helpful but not required, and union-environment leadership experience is highly valued.

Working closely with Operations, Engineering, EHS, Purchasing and Finance, this supervisor will develop people, influence maintenance strategy, improve equipment reliability and help position the Alsip facility for continued growth.  If you are a hands-on maintenance leader who thrives on building teams, improving systems and creating a stronger, more reliable operation, we want to hear from you.

Responsibilities 
Maintenance Execution & Reliability:
  • Supervise and direct maintenance technicians in the completion of preventive maintenance (PM), corrective work orders, and emergency repairs.
  • Prioritize and assign daily work to maximize equipment uptime and minimize production disruption.
  • Lead troubleshooting of mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, and controls issues on CNC machining and production equipment.
  • Ensure PM schedules are executed on time and to standard; escalate recurring failures for root cause analysis.
  • Own accurate work order and equipment records within the CMMS/TPM system.
  • Coordinate spare parts availability with the storeroom to reduce downtime.
 
Cross-Shift Continuity:
  • Conduct structured shift handoffs, documenting open work orders, equipment status, and outstanding safety concerns to the incoming supervisor.
  • Maintain alignment with the other shift's supervisor on shared priorities, PM completion, and carry-over repairs.
  • Ensure consistent standards and expectations are applied regardless of shift.
 
Leadership & People:
  • Provide direct supervision, coaching, and development for maintenance technicians.
  • Support hiring, onboarding, training, and skills development for the maintenance team.
  • Hold the team accountable to performance, attendance, and quality expectations.
  • Foster a positive, collaborative, and accountable team culture.
 
Environment, Health & Safety:
  • Champion a safe workplace through daily engagement, inspections, and hazard identification.
  • Enforce LOTO, machine guarding, PPE, and all applicable EHS policies and OSHA requirements.
  • Support accident investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective action follow-up.
  • Verify JHAs are current and technicians are trained before performing tasks.
  • Oversee contractor safety compliance for work performed on their shift.
  • All other duties as assigned

Continuous Improvement
  • Lead and support continuous improvement and reliability initiatives (PM optimization, downtime reduction, standard work).
  • Analyze downtime and failure trends and recommend engineering or process improvements.
  • Assist with budget input and assessment of new technology or equipment.
 
Requirements:
  • Technical degree in a mechanical, electrical or industrial discipline, trade certification, or equivalent maintenance experience.
  • 3–5+ years of progressive maintenance leadership or supervisory experience in an industrial manufacturing environment, ideally in a union environment.
  • 3+ years of hands-on industrial maintenance experience supporting production equipment.
  • 2+ years of experience developing, implementing or significantly improving preventive and predictive maintenance (PM/PdM) programs and maintenance processes.
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience managing and optimizing CMMS processes, such as maintenance planning and scheduling, and using reliability metrics (downtime, MTTR, MTBF) to drive equipment performance improvements.
  • 2+ years of working knowledge of OSHA regulations, LOTO and machine guarding.

Core Competencies
  • Authentic, approachable leader who earns trust and respect.
  • Decisive and results-driven, particularly under time-sensitive conditions.
  • Clear communicator who collaborates effectively across shifts and functions.
  • Exercises sound judgment and consistently delivers on commitments.
  • Proficient with CMMS platforms, TPM practices and Microsoft Office.

Preferences:
  • MaintainX platform exposure 
  • CNC machining maintenance experience. 
  • Lean manufacturing exposure.

Travel and Work Arrangement
  • Onsite role at the Alsip, IL manufacturing facility.
The pay range for this role is an annual base of $85,000 - $95,000. The pay range considers a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location.

Location: Charlotte, NC

About Us
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Job Overview:
Make Your Mark on Manufacturing Quality. We’re seeking a proactive, adaptable Quality Engineer who enjoys hands-on problem-solving, tackling technical challenges, and building expertise in a collaborative manufacturing environment. Whether you're growing your engineering career or bringing established quality experience, this opportunity offers meaningful ownership, direct exposure to manufacturing operations, and the chance to make a visible impact. As the site’s Quality Engineer in Charlotte, you’ll help strengthen quality systems, resolve product and process challenges, and drive corrective actions from concept through implementation. 

Spending the bulk of your time on the manufacturing floor, you’ll partner with Engineering, Operations, suppliers, and cross-functional teams to interpret engineering drawings, evaluate product conformance, investigate customer complaints, and resolve supplier and internal quality issues. You’ll also support supplier defect reduction, packaging enhancements, PPAP, first article inspections, PFMEA, control plans, 8D problem solving, quality metrics, and continuous improvement initiatives. Success in this role means being curious, taking initiative, and looking beyond immediate problems to find better solutions.** You’ll gather and evaluate information, develop sound judgment, and take on increasing ownership of projects, from targeted process changes to broader operational and floor-layout initiatives. You’ll work independently where appropriate while collaborating with experienced colleagues and engaging additional resources when needed.

With broad business exposure, meaningful project ownership, and involvement in the site’s transition to SAP, this opportunity offers room to expand your expertise, build highly transferable skills, and grow your career across Quality, Sourcing, Materials, Operations, or leadership.

Responsibilities:

  • Drive process and quality improvements to strengthen product reliability, identify production concerns, implement corrective solutions, and serve as Quality Project Lead for new product introductions, as assigned.
  • Develop and maintain manufacturing and quality documentation including process controls, inspection logs, visual work instructions, engineering change notices (ECNs), and related procedures.
  • Implement, maintain, and audit quality management systems, including departmental procedures supporting ISO certification and participation in internal and external plant audits.
  • Investigate and resolve internal and customer quality issues, analyzing defects in products, materials, processes, and procedures to identify root causes and drive timely corrective and preventive actions.
  • Manage supplier quality issues, including nonconforming materials, supplier communications, corrective action requests, and follow-through to resolution.
  • Develop and analyze quality reports and performance metrics to monitor supplier and internal manufacturing quality, identify trends, and drive corrective and preventive actions.
  • Partner with Engineering, Customer Service, Sales, and customers on design and contract reviews, customer quality requirements, root cause investigations, corrective actions, and occasional customer audits.
  • Support employee training and quality awareness, identifying production-process training needs and participating in programs that reinforce quality standards and manufacturing practices.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, ideally Mechanical Engineering. Other engineering disciplines considered with relevant experience.
  • 3+ years of Engineering or Quality Engineering experience, including relevant hands-on engineering assignments. Internships and co-ops may be considered for exceptional early-career candidates.
  • 3+ years of experience investigating and resolving product, supplier, or internal quality issues, including root cause analysis, corrective actions, interpreting engineering drawings, evaluating product specifications, and resolving discrepancies.
  • 3+ years of experience supporting quality processes and continuous improvement, including experience in several areas such as supplier quality, PPAP, first article inspections, customer complaints, PFMEA, control plans, 8D, or process improvements.
  • Advanced Excel proficiencey working with formulas such as VLOOKUP, and macros or similar automation, with the ability to apply these skills to Smartsheet workflows and dashboards.


Core Competencies

  • Communicate effectively: verbally be able to take complex technical subjects and translate them effectively for non-technical person; set up timely, effective communication across the organization; active listening skills; professional presentation capabilities; clear, respectful and positive communication skills. 
  • Foster Teamwork: Work cooperatively and effectively with others to set goals, resolve problems and make decisions that enhance organizational effectiveness. 
  • Decision Maker: Assess situations to determine the importance, successfully prioiritize, understanding urgency and risks, and make clear decisions which are timely and in the best interests of the organization and customer. Acts with a sense of urgency. 
  • Proven organizational skills: Utilize project tools, calendar and organizational tools effectively to be able to deliver on time, within scope and cost. 
  • Effective Problem solving: proven product investigation skills, identifying root cause(s), gather and process relevant information, generate possible solutions and make recommendations and/or resolve the problem in a timely and sustainable manner. 


Preferences:

  • AQE, CSQP, ISO or auditor (CQA) certification
  • Quality and manufacturing experience: Background in automotive quality, industrial manufacturing, distribution, or another ISO-regulated environment, including supplier defects, packaging improvements, customer complaints, or process nonconformities.
  • Quality tools and processes: Experience with PPAP, first article inspections, PFMEA, control plans, 8D problem solving, Quality CAR systems ETQ.
  • Continuous improvement: Experience leading productivity, process, workflow, or floor-layout improvements from identification through implementation.
  • Systems and data tools: Experience with Smartsheet workflows and dashboards, advanced Excel functions and macros, and ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, JD Edwards, or Infor.
  • Project and cross-functional leadership: Project-management experience and demonstrated collaboration with Engineering, Operations, Quality, suppliers, sourcing, materials, or EHS.
  • Education preference: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering preferred; other engineering disciplines are acceptable.


Travel and Work Arrangements 

  • This position is based onsite in Charlotte, NC.

Job Overview: 
Build on Your Accounting Strengths. Expand Your Impact in Cost Accounting. Join our growing manufacturing operation in the greater Buffalo, NY area as our Cost Accountant where you’ll apply your accounting expertise and strengthen your cost accounting skills while helping drive decisions in a complex manufacturing environment. Our facility manufactures a diverse range of large-scale Multi Stage Geared (MSG) air compressors and aftermarket remanufactured products that support customers across a variety of industries. As a key member of the finance team, you’ll contribute to the facility’s financial operations—supporting accurate cost accounting processes, informing business decisions, and driving continuous improvement.

This onsite opportunity is ideal for a proactive accounting professional with costing knowledge, exposure, or hands-on experience who enjoys tackling complex tasks and collaborating with peers and leadership. You’ll bring a positive attitude, strong attention to detail, exceptional organizational skills, and sound judgment to manage competing priorities effectively. If you’re energized by understanding what drives manufacturing costs and turning that insight into better business outcomes, this is an opportunity to grow your expertise and make a meaningful contribution.

Responsibilities:
  • Drive reliable and meaning Standard Costing within the plant including:
    • Daily costing updates for manufactured and purchased parts
    • Execute the annual cost roll for material, labor and overhead
    • Supporting new product development cost estimates and analysis
    • Activities and analysis to improve overall accuracy of product cost
    • Analyze and report variances such as PPV, Labor, and Freight.
  • Partner with on-going cost reviews (monthly/quarterly models, manufacturing variances and all other cost analysis)
  • Support month-end, quarter-end and year-end closing activities
  • Complete/Review monthly account reconciliations and financial performance analysis
  • Execute and Improve close processes and the environment of control
  • Monitor processes and controls relating to financial transactions, recommending and implementing improvements with the Controller and business partners.
  • Support Sarbanes-Oxley compliance and work directly with internal/external audit teams
  • Support Operations teams in project and productivity execution
  • Work closely with non-finance team members to drive cost improvements and analysis in all production activities (leveraging Lean manufacturing concepts in the pursuit of continuous improvements)
  • GRNI Process: Work with team to process GRNI, to keep within an acceptable level and in alignment with company policy.
  • Analyze/Report/Close Capital Projects
  • Partner in Annual Budget, Quarterly Forecasting, and Monthly Financial Projections.
  • Provide Meaningful Business Analysis
  • Support and execute ad hoc projects as assigned by the Plant Controller

Requirements:
  • Bachelor degree in Accounting or Finance.
  • 3+ years of progressive accounting experience, ideally in a manufacturing environment.
  • 2+ years of experience using Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications proficiently.
  • 1+ years of experience using an ERP system or for accounting or financial processes.
  • 1+ years of cost accounting exposure, knowledge or expertise. 

Core Competencies
  • Manufacturing Cost Accounting and Standard Costing: Demonstrated ability to maintain reliable standard costs for manufactured and purchased components, execute annual cost rolls, develop new-product cost estimates, and improve product-cost accuracy.
  • Cost and Manufacturing Variance Analysis: Ability to analyze and report purchase price variance (PPV), labor variance, freight variance, manufacturing variance, and other production-related cost drivers, translating findings into meaningful business analysis.
  • Financial Close, Reconciliation, and Internal Controls: Experience supporting month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities; completing account reconciliations; reviewing financial performance; and improving accounting processes and the control environment.
  • Cross-Functional Partnership and Communication: Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing, and build productive working relationships with internal and external customers. Ability to collaborate across Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, Engineering, auditors, and other business partners to support cost analysis, financial reporting, productivity initiatives, and operational decision-making.
  • Budgeting, Forecasting, and Continuous Improvement: Experience supporting annual budgets, quarterly forecasts, monthly financial projections, capital-project analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives within a complex manufacturing operation.

Preferences:
  • Advanced degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline.
  • Experience analyzing and interpreting large data sets.
  • Experience using SAP in a manufacturing or cost-accounting environment.
  • Professional certification such as:
    • Certified Management Accountant (CMA)
    • Certified Public Accountant (CPA)
    • Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA)
  • Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing methodology and its application to cost reduction and continuous improvement.

Travel and Work Arrangements 
  • Position is based in our Buffalo site.
  • Hybrid schedule available

The pay range for this role is $65,000 - $85,000 annually. The pay range considers a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location.

Job Title: Service Supervisor, Commercial Compressed Air
Location: Livonia, MI

About Us 
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.

Job Overview: 
The Service Supervisor in the compressed air commercial segment is responsible for leading the local service function for the full life cycle of the equipment to achieve exceptional customer satisfaction. This encompasses supporting the sales team to grow the business, collaborating with service coordination, and managing a Service Technician team that installs, repairs and maintains all makes of rotary screw and reciprocating air compressors and compressed air system components. The Service Supervisor also has responsibility for the Service P&L for their Customer Center.

Responsibilities:
  • Effectively attract, coach, counsel, train, develop, and retain all service employees. Drive continuous improvement through company performance management process and technical product training programs available. Develop employee skill levels, including customer service, process improvement, and technical skills to the highest degree possible.  
  • Collaborate with the service coordination function to respond efficiently to customers, ensure technicians’ training and skill level is appropriately matched to service customers, and ensure resources are effectively leveraged across the service area to maximize Service Technician utilization. This includes balancing customer requests for emergency repair, regular maintenance contracts, scheduled work and upgrades, installations, replacement components, and long-term service agreements.  
  • Collaborate with the sales function to consult on service agreements; attend customer meetings to win new and grow existing; service business; provide service support for installations; and drive new service business through Service Technician generated leads, quotes, and requests for proposals.    
  • Maximize cash flow by ensuring invoices are generated immediately upon completion of work and warranty claims are filed accurately and timely, managing expense budgets, and increasing utilization of the service team. Ensure that standard service work processes are created and followed. Improve transactional processes impacting customer experience and increase overall customer satisfaction.  
  • Effectively manage service team inventory to maintain accuracy, reduce year-end write-offs, and maintain SOX compliance through detailed reporting and regular cycle counts.   
  • Ensure environmental, health and safety compliance within service team. Provide training to all employees to ensure all service personnel follow and maintain safe and productive work habits in the shop, as well as at the customer site.  
 
Requirements: 
  • High School Diploma or GED 
  • 7+ years of relevant services experience (primarily with industrial equipment).
  • 3+ years’ experience in managing teams of people with relevant experience coaching, training and mentoring as a peer-leader.   
  • 3+ years of progressive customer service leadership experience, including conflict resolution, effective communication, and negotiation
  • Must possess a valid driver's license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving, or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years. 

Core Competencies:
  • Solid professional communication skills both verbal and written.
  • Advanced operating knowledge with Microsoft Office and general business applications.
  • Strong working knowledge of handheld and mobile technologies (smartphones, tablets) and network-based systems.
  • Demonstrated understanding of financial impacts related to process efficiency, cost control, and business performance.
  • Ability to work in diverse conditions at times requires interpretation or deviation from standard processes including but not limited to mechanical equipment rooms with exposure to noisy operating equipment, exposure to extreme weather conditions, precarious places, and risk of electrical shock (high voltage) with NFPA or equivalent standards.  

Preference: 
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, engineering technology, business or a relevant area
  • Managing budgets and processes 

Travel & Work Arrangements:
  • This role is Hybrid from Livonia, MI (Detroit metro area)
  • Company vehicle and fuel card provided
  • Regional travel approximately 20% to customer sites, including work outdoors and in mechanical or equipment rooms 
  • This position will have physical demands and requires regular use of hands, fingers, walking, stooping, and kneeling.  It requires employees to regularly lift and or move weight limits in line with the safety policy.

Location: Sidney, OH
 
About Us
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.  

Job Overview:
Help build the next generation of mission-critical power in this true ground-floor opportunity. The Electrical Design Engineer, Power Generation Containerization will help design, integrate, and launch a new line of large-scale, containerized power generation solutions supporting mission-critical data centers. Ingersoll Rand is building a new data center power generation vertical, and this engineer will help shape the electrical architecture, system integration, and manufacturing strategy behind it. The role will translate existing product knowledge from Ingersoll Rand’s acquired Australian business and North American partners into in-house designs that can be manufactured efficiently and at scale in Sidney, Ohio.

The Electrical Design Engineer will own key aspects of the electrical design and integration of large generator systems, including generator enclosures, power connections, controls access, electrical equipment layout, and overall packaged-system integration. These are not small commercial generators, but large-scale diesel generator systems designed to provide critical backup power for data center environments where reliability, uptime, and continuity are essential.  As an early member of this growing technical team, the engineer will have meaningful hands-on ownership from design and integration through validation, manufacturing readiness, and commercialization. The role will partner closely with the Mechanical Engineer, applications engineering, manufacturing, sourcing, suppliers, project management, and the Sidney plant to ensure the complete packaged solution meets both customer requirements and manufacturing needs.

The ideal candidate brings electrical design experience in power generation, large generator systems, data center electrical infrastructure, mission-critical backup power, industrial equipment, or modular/containerized power systems. Experience with generator packaging or containerization, 2MW+ systems, diesel generator sets, and environments where code compliance, serviceability, and reliability are critical is especially valuable. For an engineer who wants to do more than support an established product line, this is an opportunity to help build one from the ground up—with significant technical ownership, strong company investment, and meaningful growth potential.

Responsibilities:

Electrical System Design

  • Design electrical systems for containerized and modular power generation packages supporting data center applications.

  • Develop electrical schematics, single-line diagrams, wiring drawings, cable schedules, panel layouts, and system architecture documentation.

  • Design and integrate:

    • Diesel and natural gas generator systems

    • Generator paralleling systems

    • Switchgear and switchboards

    • Medium- and low-voltage distribution equipment

    • Automatic transfer switches (ATS)

    • UPS interfaces

    • Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS)

    • Auxiliary systems including HVAC, lighting, monitoring, and fire protection

  • Perform electrical calculations including:

    • Load flow analysis

    • Equipment sizing

    • Short-circuit studies

    • Voltage drop calculations

    • Protective device coordination

Data Center Power Solutions

  • Develop solutions that support mission-critical data center reliability requirements including N, N+1, and 2N architectures.

  • Support integration with customer electrical infrastructure and utility interconnection requirements.

  • Design systems to meet data center expectations for uptime, maintainability, scalability, and serviceability.

  • Collaborate with customers and internal stakeholders to evaluate custom power generation and backup power solutions.

  • Support electrical integration for modular and prefabricated power systems used in hyperscale and colocation data centers.

Product Development & Standardization

  • Drive development of standardized containerized power generation platforms for data center markets.

  • Create and maintain engineering specifications, design standards, and best practices.

  • Conduct design reviews and support FMEA, reliability analysis, and risk assessments.

  • Evaluate emerging technologies including hybrid power systems, energy storage, microgrids, and renewable energy integrations.

Testing, Validation & Commissioning

  • Support prototype development, testing, and validation activities.

  • Develop and review Factory Acceptance Test (FAT) procedures and Site Acceptance Test (SAT) protocols.

  • Participate in commissioning and startup activities for customer projects.

  • Troubleshoot electrical integration issues during manufacturing, deployment, and field operation.

Customer & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work directly with data center customers, consultants, contractors, and equipment suppliers.

  • Provide technical leadership during project execution and customer design reviews.

  • Support sales and business development teams with technical proposals and engineering evaluations.

  • Coordinate with manufacturing and sourcing teams to ensure successful product implementation.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related engineering discipline. 
  • 3+ years of progressive electrical design experience ideally in power generation, critical facilities, industrial systems, modular infrastructure, or related industries. 
  • 3+ years experience interpreting electrical specifications and customer technical requirements.
  • 2+ years experience designing power distribution systems and power generation equipment.
  • 2+ years of proficienct experience in AutoCAD Electrical, EPLAN, SolidWorks Electrical, or similar design platforms.
  • 2+ years of demonstrated knowledge in: 
    • Generator systems 
    • Electrical protection and coordination 
    • Low-voltage and medium-voltage power distribution 
    • Electrical codes and standards

 

 

Core Competencies:

  • Emergency and standby power systems

  • Generator controls and synchronization

  • Utility interconnection

  • Switchgear and switchboards

  • Protective relaying and system coordination

  • Medium-voltage distribution systems

  • Containerized power solutions

  • Energy storage integration

  • Mission-critical infrastructure

  • Data center electrical architecture


Preferences:

  • 5+ years of experience supporting data center, mission-critical, or power generation industries.

  • Experience with:

    • Data center electrical infrastructure

    • Generator paralleling systems

    • Medium-voltage switchgear

    • Microgrid applications

    • Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS)

  • Knowledge of data center design practices and redundancy architectures.

  • Familiarity with PLC controls, SCADA systems, and power monitoring systems.

  • Professional Engineer (PE) license or Engineer-in-Training (EIT) certification.

  • Experience supporting hyperscale data center customers such as Microsoft, AWS, Google, Meta, or other colocation providers.

 

 

Travel & Work Arrangements

  • Position is based onsite in Sidney, OH 
  • Relocation assistance available
  • Standard work hours 8:00 am - 5:00 pm

Sourcing Analyst

Charlotte, NC

 

We are seeking a highly motivated and organized Sourcing Analyst to support sourcing activities for our Compression Systems & Services North America Sourcing Organization. The Sourcing Analyst will play a key role in supporting supply assurance, cost competitiveness, supplier performance, and sourcing execution through data analysis, reporting, project coordination, and process support.

 

This role works closely with sourcing leaders and internal stakeholders, including Materials, Product Management, Operations, Engineering, and Finance, to gather and analyze information that supports sourcing decisions and business improvements. The Sourcing Analyst will identify opportunities, support sourcing initiatives, maintain reporting and tracking tools, and assist with day-to-day sourcing activities that contribute to operational and financial objectives.

 

This position provides exposure to sourcing strategy, supplier management, manufacturing operations, and supply chain processes while developing analytical, business, and problem-solving skills.


Responsibilities

  • Analyze spend, supplier performance, pricing, and operational data to identify opportunities for cost reduction, supply chain improvement, risk mitigation, and process optimization.

  • Prepare and maintain reports, presentations, and other sourcing tools for sourcing team and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Support continuous improvement efforts by identifying reporting efficiencies, process enhancements, and data-driven opportunities.

Preferences

Job Overview:
Turn Demand into a Plan That Delivers. At Ingersoll Rand, the Master Scheduler connects customer demand with what the factory can deliver—helping ensure the right products move through production at the right time. Your decisions will influence delivery reliability, inventory levels, and how effectively the plant uses its people, materials, and equipment. In this role, you’ll turn business forecasts into a realistic production plan, anticipate bottlenecks, and guide trade-offs as priorities change. You’ll work across Operations, Supply Chain, and Customer Service to balance immediate customer needs with longer-term manufacturing capacity, bringing clarity to competing demands and helping teams act before constraints become disruptions.

This opportunity is ideal for an analytical manufacturing professional who enjoys solving complex problems and influencing decisions across teams. You’ll take ownership of the production plan, work independently, and use data, manufacturing knowledge, and sound judgment to strengthen production flow, improve planning accuracy, and help the factory deliver on its commitments.

Responsibilities:
  • Translate the monthly SIOP consensus plan by product family to a detailed weekly master production schedule (MPS) with a 12-18 month planning horizon into the ERP for weekly MRP generation
  • Incorporate inter-company demand and backlog into SIOP supply planning process to ensure capacity and resources are available to meet demand requirements.
  • Monitor and drive resolution of MRP processing errors.
  • Support customer service with exception request analysis and expediting resolution.
  • Create and publish daily/weekly/monthly factory schedule adherence, capacity, and inventory reports.
  • Serve as a factory subject matter expert (SME) for ERP production planning and scheduling modules.
  • Identification and resolution of Constraints - Capacity, Resource & Material.
  • Facilitates long term capacity assessment (RCCP) and development of countermeasure/action plans.
 
Requirements:
  • Bachelor's degree in business or engineering discipline.
  • 3+ years of experience in analyzing data relating to product forecasting, master scheduling, or shipment forecasting.
  • Experience with rate-based or flow line (non-MRP) and job shop manufacturing environments.
  • Experience in operations, inventory management, MRP and lean manufacturing processes.

Core Competencies:
  • Ability to effectively make complex decisions with limited time and information and can determine decision making criteria based on priorities.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across multiple disciplines with internal and external resources.
  • Strong analytical capabilities, with a basic understanding of statistical analysis techniques.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, independent problem resolution, proven leadership ability, and the ability to manage the requirement of others.
  • Comfortable leading discussion and debate both within peer group and with matrix business partners, operational partners and leaders.

Preferences:
  • APICS Certification in Production and Inventory Management (CPIM) required or hiring commitment to obtain in first 18 months of employment.
  • Experience with visual management systems.
  • Working knowledge of ERP system.
  • Data access/retrieval skills with extensive experience in data analysis, data manipulation using MS Excel and/or other tools as provided.

  • Onsite.
