Job Overview:
The Molding Engineer is responsible for the development, optimization and sustaining robust molding processes for liquid silicone rubber (LSR) and high consistency rubber (HCR) utilizing injection, transfer and compression molding processes.

The Molding Engineer plays a key role in driving process capability, optimizing cycle times, reducing scrap, troubleshooting production issues and ensuring stable manufacturing performance across all molding work centers.

The Molding Engineer collaborates closely with the Tooling, Production, Quality, NPI and Maintenance teams to ensure successful product launches, consistent quality and efficient manufacturing processes. 

Responsibilities:
  • Develop, validate, and optimize LSR and HCR molding processes (injection, compression, transfer) using scientific molding principles and DOE methodologies.
  • Establish robust process parameters, including injection/fill profiles, pack/hold strategies, cure cycles, and thermal controls to improve capability (Cp/Cpk) and reduce variation.
  • Troubleshoot complex molding defects (flash, short shots, voids, knit lines, shrinkage, dimensional variation, and cure issues) using structured root cause analysis and corrective actions.
  • Partner with tooling and maintenance teams to qualify molds, optimize gate/vent designs, improve thermal management, and ensure validated equipment performance.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on cycle time reduction, scrap minimization, OEE improvement, material yield optimization, and Lean/Kaizen implementation.
  • Support New Product Introduction (NPI) through feasibility assessments, mold trials, process qualification, production launch, and transition to manufacturing.
  • Develop and maintain process documentation, standardized parameter sheets, work instructions, and SPC-based process monitoring while training operators and technicians on best practices.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Engineering, Production, Quality, and Estimating teams to improve manufacturability, manage process changes, and ensure quality, customer, and business objectives are achieved.

Requirements:
  • Bachelor’s degree in an Engineering (Mechanical, Manufacturing, Materials, Plastics, Polymer)
  • 5+ years’ direct experience in silicone and/or rubber molding

Competences: 
  • Liquid Silicone Rubber (LSR) injection.
  • High Consistency Rubber (HCR) molding.
  • Compression and transfer molding.
  • Cure cycles, post-cure and material behavior.
  • Tool design elements (cavitation, gating, venting, steel types).
  • Experience using DOE, SPC and statistical tools for process improvement.
  • Strong ability to interpret engineering drawings, GD & T, CAD models, customer and regulatory specifications.
  • Demonstrated success in troubleshooting complex molding issues.

Preferences:
  • Experience with SolidWorks or other 3D modelling software.
  • Experience with mold flow analysis (or ability to interpret results).
  • Background in medical, automotive, aerospace or industrial silicone components.
  • Experience supporting APQP, PPAP and customer audits.
  • Experience with automation, vision inspection and deflashing /trimming technologies.
  • Background with adhesion/bonding techniques, multi-shot molding and over molding.
  • RJG/Paulson certification or silicone-specific molding training.
  • Familiarity with ISO13485 and clean room procedures would be beneficial.

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:
  • Fully onsite based - Lincolnshire, IL

Pay Range:
The pay range for this role is $100,000-$125,000.  The pay range considers a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location.

Job Overview:

The Connected Manufacturing & Field Service Engineer plays a critical role in supporting, integrating, and optimizing Precision Fastening Tools, Controllers, and Connected Manufacturing solutions within customer production environments. This position serves as the technical liaison between customers, service teams, and engineering organizations, ensuring reliable operation, seamless system integration, and exceptional customer satisfaction.

The engineer will be responsible for installation, commissioning, troubleshooting, testing, and support of fastening systems and related manufacturing technologies. This includes integration with Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), PLCs, industrial networks, and digital I/O interfaces.

Through direct customer engagement and hands-on technical expertise, the Connected Manufacturing & Field Service Engineer helps drive operational excellence, product reliability, and continuous improvement while supporting Ingersoll Rand's commitment to making life better through innovative manufacturing solutions.

Responsibilities

Field Service & Customer Support

  • Travel to customer facilities to install, commission, maintain, and troubleshoot precision fastening systems, controllers, and software solutions.
  • Provide onsite and remote technical support for customers, distributors, and internal service teams.
  • Diagnose and resolve software, hardware, networking, and process-related issues in production environments.
  • Conduct equipment assessments and recommend corrective actions to improve system performance and uptime.
  • Deliver customer training on product operation, software functionality, troubleshooting, and best practices.
  • Support production launch activities and ensure successful implementation of connected manufacturing solutions.

Connected Manufacturing & Systems Integration

  • Ensure reliable wired & wireless communication between fastening tools and controllers.
  • Support integration & troubleshooting of communication between IR products and plant MES systems using open protocols like Power Focus Open Protocol (PFOP) and ToolsNet, and proprietary protocols for Ford, Volkswagen, Toyota, Stellantis and more.
  • Verify traceability, production reporting, recipe management, and quality data collection requirements.
  • Collaborate with customer automation, IT, quality, and manufacturing engineering teams to ensure reliable system performance.
  • Support Industry 4.0 and Smart Factory initiatives through deployment of connected manufacturing solutions.

Digital I/O & Automation Support

  • Configure and troubleshoot digital I/O communications between fastening controllers, PLCs, conveyors, robots, and automation equipment.
  • Verify machine interlocks, cycle complete signals, fault outputs, part-present inputs, and process control functions.
  • Support industrial communication protocols including Ethernet/IP, Profinet, Modbus, and OPC-UA.
  • Assist with factory acceptance testing (FAT), site acceptance testing (SAT), and production startup support.

Continuous Improvement

  • Identify recurring field issues and provide feedback to engineering and product management teams.
  • Support the development of service procedures, technical documentation, and best practices.
  • Stay current on manufacturing technology trends, industrial automation, and connected factory solutions.
  • Mentor service technicians and junior engineers as needed.

Qualifications:

  • 5+ Years of experience with MES with power tools communicating with PFOP
  • 5+ Years of experience with Digital I/O configuration and troubleshooting
  • 5+ Years of experience with Fieldbus communications with Profinet or EthernetIP
  • 5+ Years of experience with Software installation and validation
  • 5+ Years of experience with Configuring devices for Wi-Fi communications & troubleshooting

Core Competencies: 

  • Strong customer-facing communication skills
  • Ability to characterize, diagnose and resolve complex technical issues
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills
  • Self-motivated and capable of working independently
  • Effective collaboration across engineering, service, and customer teams
  • Willingness to travel extensively to support customer operations

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Joints, fasteners, power tools
  • Must be very comfortable with customer interaction! Will have a sales incentive bonus.
  • Exposure to industrial automation with OPC-UA, MES and Fieldbus protocols
  • Experience with devices communicating over Zigbee or 802.15.4
  • Experience with mobile app communications with devices over BLE or USB
Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements 
  • Regular Travel by car and plane to our customer sites in the US and Canada. Must have a valid passport or ability to get one. You will be provided with a company vehicle. 
Pay Range:
The total pay range for this role, not including incentive opportunities, is Min - 97000 - Max - 125000. The pay range takes into account a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location.  Hired applicant will be eligible to receive (discretionary/nondiscretionary) annual bonuses and incentive compensation.

Job Overview

We are seeking a Non-Warranty Claims Specialist in Charlotte or Mooresville, North Carolina, to manage customer claims for post-shipment issues outside product warranty coverage, including freight damage, shipment shortages, incorrect shipments, returns, and freight-pricing discrepancies. 

You will own assigned claims from initial review through resolution—validating requests, researching order and shipment details, reviewing documentation, and determining responsibility and next steps. Working with customers, distributors, carriers, factories, and internal teams—including Quality, Shipping, Engineering, and Data Management—you will resolve discrepancies, support carrier claims, process credits, and communicate credit and return information. Success requires strong analytical skills, sound judgment, and the ability to evaluate substantial information across multiple business systems while managing shifting priorities. You will independently resolve straightforward claims and engage the appropriate internal partners on more complex issues. 

The ideal candidate is someone with a strong customer-service mindset, effective time management, and a commitment to finding workable solutions. You will apply company policies and creative problem-solving to identify what can be done for the customer while supporting business needs.   • Lead Customer Engagement and Presentations: Schedule, facilitate, and lead presentations to customers while attending industry trade shows and conferences to establish contacts, identify trends, and proactively develop leads.

Job Title:  Non-Warranty Claims Specialist
Location:  Charlotte, NC, Mocksville, NC

About Us
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.

Job Overview

We are seeking a Non-Warranty Claims Specialist in Charlotte or Mooresville, North Carolina, to manage customer claims for post-shipment issues outside product warranty coverage, including freight damage, shipment shortages, incorrect shipments, returns, and freight-pricing discrepancies. 

You will own assigned claims from initial review through resolution—validating requests, researching order and shipment details, reviewing documentation, and determining responsibility and next steps. Working with customers, distributors, carriers, factories, and internal teams—including Quality, Shipping, Engineering, and Data Management—you will resolve discrepancies, support carrier claims, process credits, and communicate credit and return information. Success requires strong analytical skills, sound judgment, and the ability to evaluate substantial information across multiple business systems while managing shifting priorities. You will independently resolve straightforward claims and engage the appropriate internal partners on more complex issues. 

The ideal candidate is someone with a strong customer-service mindset, effective time management, and a commitment to finding workable solutions. You will apply company policies and creative problem-solving to identify what can be done for the customer while supporting business needs. Clear, timely, professional communication with customers, distributors, and internal teams will be essential to delivering a world-class customer experience.


Responsibilities

  • Validate claim requests and collaborate with internal teams and external customers/distributors
  • Coordinate with shipping carriers, factories, and quality teams to resolve claims
  • Book and communicate credit or return information efficiently
  • Maintain clear and professional communication via email and phone with internal and external contacts
  • Provide outstanding customer service and support
  • Handle multiple tasks in a professional and efficient manner
  • Use SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, and MS Office tools to manage customer and claim data
  • Analyze customer needs and resolve issues by applying problem-solving skills
  • Maintain detailed and accurate records of claim interactions and resolutions

Requirements:

  • High School Diploma or GED
  • 2+ years of experience in customer service, product services, or a related role. 
  • 2+ years independently using a computer to navigate multiple applications and manage files.
  • 2+ years of experience using Microsoft Outlook to manage business email, calendars, and meeting invitations.
  • 2+ years of experience using Microsoft Excel to maintain, review, and analyze data.

Core Competencies:
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks professionally and efficiently
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Experience with SAP, Oracle, Salesforce (especially customer-related modules) is advantageous
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

Preferences:
  • Associates Degree in Business, Marketing, or Technical related field preferred
  • Some accounting/financial experience is preferred
  • Mechanical aptitude and product knowledge a plus

Travel and Work Arrangements

  • This position is based onsite at our Charlotte, NC or Mocksville, NC

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.

About Us

Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planet. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies, from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gases, and powders, to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end markets, including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we're driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.

 

Job Overview

The Automated Test Engineer is responsible for the development, execution, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of product validation testing and test infrastructure. This role serves as the technical lead for test data acquisition systems, controls, instrumentation, electrical troubleshooting, sound testing, performance testing, and test cell capability development. The position works closely with Product Engineering, Operations, Quality, Manufacturing, and Customer Support to ensure accurate product validation and rapid resolution of product and test-related issues.

 

What Success Looks Like

  • Executes testing with minimal supervision.
  • Troubleshoots electrical and instrumentation issues independently.
  • Maintains and improves LabVIEW applications.
  • Supports successful qualification and release of products.
  • Builds confidence in engineering decision-making through reliable test data.
 

 

Responsibilities

  • Develop, coordinate, and execute validation testing for vacuum pumps, compressors, packaged systems, and related rotating equipment.
  • Identify, diagnose, and resolve product or test-system issues discovered during validation to support successful product qualification and release.
  • Serve as the technical owner of motors, VFDs, DC drives, PLCs, controls, instrumentation, and data acquisition systems while ensuring accurate, reliable, and repeatable testing.
  • Maintain and improve LabVIEW applications, National Instruments hardware, instrumentation systems, and test infrastructure while supporting future automation and test cell capability development.
  • Analyze test data and performance trends and partner with Product Engineering to validate designs, evaluate performance, and support continuous product improvement initiatives.
  • Create and improve test procedures, validation methods, calibration plans, and standard work instructions to enhance testing efficiency, repeatability, and product quality.
  • Generate engineering development reports, nonconformance reports, engineering change requests, product performance reports, and other technical documentation.
  • Communicate test setups, methods, results, conclusions, and recommendations to engineering, operations, customers, leadership teams, and third-party inspectors.
 

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Controls Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  • Three or more years of experience in test engineering, controls engineering, instrumentation, validation engineering, or a related role within a manufacturing environment.
  • Must be a U.S. citizen and eligible to obtain and maintain required government security clearances.
 

Core Competencies

  • Comfortable working with motor starters, VFDs, DC drives, controls, and instrumentation systems.
  • Experience developing and troubleshooting LabVIEW applications used for automated testing, data acquisition, or control systems.
  • Understanding of industrial manufacturing, assembly, and testing practices involving pumps, compressors, or other rotating equipment.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and technical communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple technical priorities and work effectively with limited supervision.
  • Understanding of electrical noise, grounding, and signal integrity principles.
  • Ability to analyze large data sets, identify trends, and convert results into actionable conclusions.
  • Ability to communicate technical information effectively to engineers, operations personnel, customers, and leadership.
  • Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and the ability to drive issues to closure while prioritizing work based on business impact.
 

Preferences

  • Electrical Engineering background preferred.
  • Experience troubleshooting VFDs, SCR drives, power electronics, or industrial motor control systems.
  • Experience with National Instruments (NI) data acquisition hardware and software.
  • Experience performing acoustic or vibration analysis.
  • Experience with vacuum pumps, compressors, liquid ring equipment, or other rotating fluid machinery.
  • Experience applying mechanical equipment to customer operating conditions, performance requirements, or industrial process applications.
 

Travel & Work Arrangements

This position is based at the Ingersoll Rand facility in Bentleyville, Pennsylvania. Travel requirements are expected to be minimal.

 

What We Offer

At Ingersoll Rand, we embrace a culture of personal ownership, taking responsibility for our company, our communities, and our environment, as well as our individual health and well-being. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to empower you with the tools and support necessary to take charge of your health, ensuring that together, we can continue to make life better.

Our range of benefits includes health care options like medical and prescription plans, dental and vision coverage, as well as wellness programs. Additionally, we provide life insurance, a robust 401(k) plan, paid time off, and even an employee stock grant, among other offerings. These benefits are our commitment to you, so you can be your best at work and beyond.

Location: Alsip, IL

About Us:  
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. The Ingersoll Rand Pump (IRP), MP Pump and Oberdorfer Pump (MPOB) Business Unit is a dynamic division within Ingersoll Rand, renowned for its Ingersoll Rand Pumps and MP Oberdorfer Pumps. These brands are celebrated for their reliability, innovation, and service to industries worldwide. Our commitment to excellence propels us to constantly improve our products and services, ensuring that we remain leaders in fluid handling technologies. Our teams are dedicated to upholding the highest standards of quality and customer satisfaction, making our pumps the go-to choice for professionals seeking efficient and durable solutions.

Job Overview:
Ingersoll Rand seeks a talented Production Supervisor for its Ingersoll Rand Pump (IRP), MP Pump and Oberdorfer Pump (MPOB) Business Unit. Production Supervisor will supervise and coordinate daily operation of production teams at the Ingersoll Rand Alsip IL plant with responsibility for achieving maximum quality and cost effectiveness in an on-time and efficient manner. Actively participates in all areas of employment, performance evaluations, associate relations, and associate development while promoting employee involvement. 

Responsibilities:

 
  • Ensures a safe work place is provided for all employees; frequently inspects department for safety compliance. Completes accident or near miss investigations and schedules appropriate follow-up reviews; identifies areas of needed learning and conducts necessary training to create a zero accident environment.
  • Builds a high performing team by creating and implements engagement plans to create a work environment which grows and retains talent.  Collaborates with functional teams to establish and manage to headcount plan supporting recruiting, onboarding, training and retention efforts.
  • Supervises the activities of production associates to achieve key objectives with regard to safety, quality, cost, inventory management, delivery, down time reduction and employee engagement. Evaluates and engages in 2 way performance and development conversations with associates and completes necessary reports. Creates and implements training programs to ensure development and flexibility of the team.
  • Reviews daily and weekly shipping schedules and production capabilities to assure all deadlines are met. Checks running orders/query dispatch lists to determine schedule priorities. Coordinates and expedites hot parts and assigns rework. Create and maintain visual results boards and owns results.
  • Inspects and monitors production quality and equipment. Ensures quality procedures/practices are applied to the process, tooling, and equipment to achieve expected quality results.  Responds with urgency to improve quality control and reduce downtime.
  • Manages the effective utilization of materials to assure an appropriate amount of parts are available to maintain smooth production flow; completes bottleneck analysis in the workflow and implements lean solutions.
  • Builds a positive, respectful and engaged workforce – follows the CBA with consistency of application.
  • Leads communications to ensure the team is kept up to date on current concerns, activities and events impacting the production team, business and plant.
  • Builds a culture of continuous improvement through use of lean tools and stakeholder involvement.


Requirements: 

  • High School Diploma or G.E.D.
  • 3 + years Manufacturing leadership experience
  • CNC production machining experience
  • Strong communicator who can collaborate and cooperate with the ability to translate technical or complex information so it is easily understood
  • Successful history of working with deadlines to deliver goals and projects
  • Good problem-solving skills and facilitation

 
Preferences:

  • Bachelor's Degree
  • Lean Manufacturing or Operational Excellence experience
  • Experience with SAP
  • Experience with injection molding
  • Hands on utilization of lean tools such as Takt Time, standard work, value stream mapping, %Load, 5s, Kanban, practical problem solving
  • Pump manufacturing experience
  • Experience in union setting
  • Successful history of developing teams, understanding the importance of engagement, and celebrating success


Core Competencies:

  • Manages Ambiguity – Makes significant progress and remains calm and composed even when things are uncertain.  Adapts quickly to change.  Leads others effectively through change.
  • Communicates effectively – Delivers messages in a clear, compelling and concise manner.  Actively listens and checks for understanding.  Adjusts communication style to meet the needs of a diverse audience.  Models positive leadership.  Encourages the expression of diverse ideas. Builds effective communication channels.
  • Project management – able to effective use project tools and communication skills to complete projects within deadline, anticipated result and budget.
  • Action Oriented – Quickly and decisively takes action in fast-changing, unpredictable situations.  Spots and seizes opportunities to improve workflows.  Drives for results in the right manner.
  • Instills trust – Gains the confidence and trust of others at all levels in the organization.  Honors commitments and keeps confidences.  Expresses self in a credible and transparent manner.
  •

job.description:
Ingersoll Rand is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.

About Us

Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planet. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies, from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gases, and powders, to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end markets, including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we're driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.

 

Job Overview

The Automated Test Engineer is responsible for the development, execution, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of product validation testing and test infrastructure. This role serves as the technical lead for test data acquisition systems, controls, instrumentation, electrical troubleshooting, sound testing, performance testing, and test cell capability development. The position works closely with Product Engineering, Operations, Quality, Manufacturing, and Customer Support to ensure accurate product validation and rapid resolution of product and test-related issues.

 

What Success Looks Like

  • Executes testing with minimal supervision.
  • Troubleshoots electrical and instrumentation issues independently.
  • Maintains and improves LabVIEW applications.
  • Supports successful qualification and release of products.
  • Builds confidence in engineering decision-making through reliable test data.
 

 

Responsibilities

  • Develop, coordinate, and execute validation testing for vacuum pumps, compressors, packaged systems, and related rotating equipment.
  • Identify, diagnose, and resolve product or test-system issues discovered during validation to support successful product qualification and release.
  • Serve as the technical owner of motors, VFDs, DC drives, PLCs, controls, instrumentation, and data acquisition systems while ensuring accurate, reliable, and repeatable testing.
  • Maintain and improve LabVIEW applications, National Instruments hardware, instrumentation systems, and test infrastructure while supporting future automation and test cell capability development.
  • Analyze test data and performance trends and partner with Product Engineering to validate designs, evaluate performance, and support continuous product improvement initiatives.
  • Create and improve test procedures, validation methods, calibration plans, and standard work instructions to enhance testing efficiency, repeatability, and product quality.
  • Generate engineering development reports, nonconformance reports, engineering change requests, product performance reports, and other technical documentation.
  • Communicate test setups, methods, results, conclusions, and recommendations to engineering, operations, customers, leadership teams, and third-party inspectors.
 

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Controls Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  • Three or more years of experience in test engineering, controls engineering, instrumentation, validation engineering, or a related role within a manufacturing environment.
  • Must be a U.S. citizen and eligible to obtain and maintain required government security clearances.
 

Core Competencies

  • Comfortable working with motor starters, VFDs, DC drives, controls, and instrumentation systems.
  • Experience developing and troubleshooting LabVIEW applications used for automated testing, data acquisition, or control systems.
  • Understanding of industrial manufacturing, assembly, and testing practices involving pumps, compressors, or other rotating equipment.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and technical communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple technical priorities and work effectively with limited supervision.
  • Understanding of electrical noise, grounding, and signal integrity principles.
  • Ability to analyze large data sets, identify trends, and convert results into actionable conclusions.
  • Ability to communicate technical information effectively to engineers, operations personnel, customers, and leadership.
  • Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and the ability to drive issues to closure while prioritizing work based on business impact.
 

Preferences

  • Electrical Engineering background preferred.
  • Experience troubleshooting VFDs, SCR drives, power electronics, or industrial motor control systems.
  • Experience with National Instruments (NI) data acquisition hardware and software.
  • Experience performing acoustic or vibration analysis.
  • Experience with vacuum pumps, compressors, liquid ring equipment, or other rotating fluid machinery.
  • Experience applying mechanical equipment to customer operating conditions, performance requirements, or industrial process applications.
 

Travel & Work Arrangements

This position is based at the Ingersoll Rand facility in Bentleyville, Pennsylvania. Travel requirements are expected to be minimal.

 

What We Offer

At Ingersoll Rand, we embrace a culture of personal ownership, taking responsibility for our company, our communities, and our environment, as well as our individual health and well-being. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to empower you with the tools and support necessary to take charge of your health, ensuring that together, we can continue to make life better.

Our range of benefits includes health care options like medical and prescription plans, dental and vision coverage, as well as wellness programs. Additionally, we provide life insurance, a robust 401(k) plan, paid time off, and even an employee stock grant, among other offerings. These benefits are our commitment to you, so you can be your best at work and beyond.

  Ingersoll Rand Inc. (NYSE:IR), driven by an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset, is dedicated to helping make life better for our employees, customers and communities. Customers lean on us for our technology-driven excellence in mission-critical flow creation and industrial solutions across 40+ respected brands where our products and services excel in the most complex and harsh conditions. Our employees develop customers for life through their daily commitment to expertise, productivity and efficiency. For more information, visit www.IRCO.com.

Job Title: Internal Auditor             
Location:  Davidson, NC (Hybrid)
 
About Us
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.  

Job Overview:
Launch Your Audit Career Beyond Compliance. At Ingersoll Rand, Internal Audit is a highly visible function offering firsthand exposure to the people, operations, and strategic initiatives driving a global industrial manufacturer. You’ll partner with leaders across manufacturing, finance, operations, and corporate functions while learning how our businesses operate. 

This opportunity is ideal for an early-career audit or accounting professional ready to grow beyond traditional financial reporting and compliance. You’ll build broad experience across financial, operational, compliance, and business-process audits, with a focus on business processes rather than IT systems or technology controls. 

Working alongside experienced audit leaders, you’ll support internal audits, SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley) walkthroughs and testing, risk-based business-process reviews, and special projects that strengthen controls and improve performance. Visits to manufacturing facilities will allow you to observe operations firsthand and understand the financial and operational drivers of our business. You’ll also help the team apply technology, automation, data analytics, and AI-enabled tools to create more capacity for operational auditing and business partnership.  We’re seeking a curious, adaptable, and collaborative professional with a solid foundation in accounting and auditing and an eagerness to learn.

Bring your curiosity and build your career through hands-on audit experience, manufacturing exposure, travel, and professional development.

Responsibilities:
  • Perform SOX testing across various corporate functions and business locations
  • Assist in developing audit plans and programs based on scope of audit work.
  • Participate in fieldwork for business process reviews covering strategic, operational, financial, and regulatory risks.
  • Provide timely, clear, and actionable feedback tailored to the specific business environment regarding findings or improvements.
  • Work collaboratively with team members, guest auditors, and external resources to ensure accurate, timely completion of assigned work.
  • Partner with business to proactively advise on controls and risks.
  • Identify opportunities for continuous improvement within the audit process or business processes, using automation and analytics where possible.
  • Willingness to learn, utilize technology and understand data structure.
  • Stay current with industry trends, regulatory changes, and best practices in internal auditing.

Requirements:
  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance or related discipline and relevant work experience.
  • 1 - 3+ years of progressive experience in public accounting, internal audit or general accounting functions within a corporate environment.
  • 1+ years working knowledge of Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP).
  • 2+ year demonstrated intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including experience using advanced formulas such as V-Lookups, PivotTables, data validation, filtering, and data analysis.

Core Competencies
Analytical Thinking and Judgment
  • Analyzes financial, operational, and business data to identify risks, draw sound conclusions, and recommend practical improvements.
  • Demonstrates strong business curiosity, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
Integrity and Accountability
  • Maintains the highest standards of ethics, integrity, objectivity, and confidentiality.
  • Works independently, manages priorities effectively, and seeks guidance or escalates concerns when appropriate.
  • Demonstrates accountability, attention to detail, and consistent follow-through.
Communication and Business Partnership
  • Communicates risks, findings, and recommendations clearly, professionally, and with appropriate sensitivity.
  • Builds credible relationships while maintaining audit independence and delivering constructive, actionable feedback.
Collaboration and Adaptability
  • Collaborates effectively across global, cross-functional, and virtual teams.
  • Adapts quickly to changing priorities, unfamiliar processes, and diverse business environments.
Technology and Continuous Improvement
  • Experience working with Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Teams, and Copilot.
  • Demonstrates initiative and uses technology to improve audit quality, efficiency, and business processes.

Preferences:
  • Advanced degree and relevant professional certifications e.g. CPA, CIA highly desired.
  • Understanding of US SOX requirements and experience in documenting and testing SOX controls.
  • Working knowledge of Generally Accepted Audit Standards (GAAS)
  • Experience in the manufacturing industry with a global organization.
  • Experience using SAP, Oracle, and consolidation software for audit related purposes.
  • Working knowledge of data analysis, automation, and AI tools.
  • Experience with Tableau, QlikView, Snowflake, KNIME, and /or Sigma.
  • Ability to speak multiple languages.

Travel and Work Arrangements 
  • This is a hybrid role based from Davidson, NC
  • Travel anticipated 10-15%; Domestic and Internationally
  • Must be fluent in English.

Job Overview

The Automated Test Engineer is responsible for the development, execution, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of product validation testing and test infrastructure. This role serves as the technical lead for test data acquisition systems, controls, instrumentation, electrical troubleshooting, sound testing, performance testing, and test cell capability development. The position works closely with Product Engineering, Operations, Quality, Manufacturing, and Customer Support to ensure accurate product validation and rapid resolution of product and test-related issues.

 

What Success Looks Like

  • Executes testing with minimal supervision.
  • Troubleshoots electrical and instrumentation issues independently.
  • Maintains and improves LabVIEW applications.
  • Supports successful qualification and release of products.
  • Builds confidence in engineering decision-making through reliable test data.

 

 

Responsibilities

  • Develop, coordinate, and execute validation testing for vacuum pumps, compressors, packaged systems, and related rotating equipment.
  • Identify, diagnose, and resolve product or test-system issues discovered during validation to support successful product qualification and release.
  • Serve as the technical owner of motors, VFDs, DC drives, PLCs, controls, instrumentation, and data acquisition systems while ensuring accurate, reliable, and repeatable testing.
  • Maintain and improve LabVIEW applications, National Instruments hardware, instrumentation systems, and test infrastructure while supporting future automation and test cell capability development.
  • Analyze test data and performance trends and partner with Product Engineering to validate designs, evaluate performance, and support continuous product improvement initiatives.
  • Create and improve test procedures, validation methods, calibration plans, and standard work instructions to enhance testing efficiency, repeatability, and product quality.
  • Generate engineering development reports, nonconformance reports, engineering change requests, product performance reports, and other technical documentation.
  • Communicate test setups, methods, results, conclusions, and recommendations to engineering, operations, customers, leadership teams, and third-party inspectors.

 

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Controls Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  • Three or more years of experience in test engineering, controls engineering, instrumentation, validation engineering, or a related role within a manufacturing environment.
  • Must be a U.S. citizen and eligible to obtain and maintain required government security clearances.

 

Core Competencies

  • Comfortable working with motor starters, VFDs, DC drives, controls, and instrumentation systems.
  • Experience developing and troubleshooting LabVIEW applications used for automated testing, data acquisition, or control systems.
  • Understanding of industrial manufacturing, assembly, and testing practices involving pumps, compressors, or other rotating equipment.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and technical communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple technical priorities and work effectively with limited supervision.
  • Understanding of electrical noise, grounding, and signal integrity principles.
  • Ability to analyze large data sets, identify trends, and convert results into actionable conclusions.
  • Ability to communicate technical information effectively to engineers, operations personnel, customers, and leadership.
  • Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and the ability to drive issues to closure while prioritizing work based on business impact.

 

Preferences

  • Electrical Engineering background preferred.
  • Experience troubleshooting VFDs, SCR drives, power electronics, or industrial motor control systems.
  • Experience with National Instruments (NI) data acquisition hardware and software.
  • Experience performing acoustic or vibration analysis.
  • Experience with vacuum pumps, compressors, liquid ring equipment, or other rotating fluid machinery.
  • Experience applying mechanical equipment to customer operating conditions, performance requirements, or industrial process applications.

 

Travel & Work Arrangements

This position is based at the Ingersoll Rand facility in Bentleyville, Pennsylvania. Travel requirements are expected to be minimal.

 

What We Offer

At Ingersoll Rand, we embrace a culture of personal ownership, taking responsibility for our company, our communities, and our environment, as well as our individual health and well-being. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to empower you with the tools and support necessary to take charge of your health, ensuring that together, we can continue to make life better.

Our range of benefits includes health care options like medical and prescription plans, dental and vision coverage, as well as wellness programs. Additionally, we provide life insurance, a robust 401(k) plan, paid time off, and even an employee stock grant, among other offerings. These benefits are our commitment to you, so you can be your best at work and beyond.

Customers lean on us for our technology-driven excellence in mission-critical flow creation and industrial solutions across 40+ respected brands where our products and services excel in the most complex and harsh conditions. Our employees develop customers for life through their daily commitment to expertise, productivity and efficiency. For more information, visit www.IRCO.com.

You’ll partner with leaders across manufacturing, finance, operations, and corporate functions while learning how our businesses operate. 

This opportunity is ideal for an early-career audit or accounting professional ready to grow beyond traditional financial reporting and compliance. You’ll build broad experience across financial, operational, compliance, and business-process audits, with a focus on business processes rather than IT systems or technology controls. 

Working alongside experienced audit leaders, you’ll support internal audits, SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley) walkthroughs and testing, risk-based business-process reviews, and special projects that strengthen controls and improve performance. Visits to manufacturing facilities will allow you to observe operations firsthand and understand the financial and operational drivers of our business. You’ll also help the team apply technology, automation, data analytics, and AI-enabled tools to create more capacity for operational auditing and business partnership.  We’re seeking a curious, adaptable, and collaborative professional with a solid foundation in accounting and auditing and an eagerness to learn.

Bring your curiosity and build your career through hands-on audit experience, manufacturing exposure, travel, and professional development.

Responsibilities:
  • Perform SOX testing across various corporate functions and business locations
  • Assist in developing audit plans and programs based on scope of audit work.
  • Participate in fieldwork for business process reviews covering strategic, operational, financial, and regulatory risks.
  • Provide timely, clear, and actionable feedback tailored to the specific business environment regarding findings or improvements.
  • Work collaboratively with team members, guest auditors, and external resources to ensure accurate, timely completion of assigned work.
  • Partner with business to proactively advise on controls and risks.
  • Identify opportunities for continuous improvement within the audit process or business processes, using automation and analytics where possible.
  • Willingness to learn, utilize technology and understand data structure.
  • Stay current with industry trends, regulatory changes, and best practices in internal auditing.

Requirements:
  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance or related discipline and relevant work experience.
  • 1 - 3+ years of progressive experience in public accounting, internal audit or general accounting functions within a corporate environment.
  • 1+ years working knowledge of Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP).
  • 2+ year demonstrated intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including experience using advanced formulas such as V-Lookups, PivotTables, data validation, filtering, and data analysis.

Core Competencies
Analytical Thinking and Judgment
  • Analyzes financial, operational, and business data to identify risks, draw sound conclusions, and recommend practical improvements.
  • Demonstrates strong business curiosity, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
Integrity and Accountability
  • Maintains the highest standards of ethics, integrity, objectivity, and confidentiality.
  • Works independently, manages priorities effectively, and seeks guidance or escalates concerns when appropriate.
  • Demonstrates accountability, attention to detail, and consistent follow-through.
Communication and Business Partnership
  • Communicates risks, findings, and recommendations clearly, professionally, and with appropriate sensitivity.
  • Builds credible relationships while maintaining audit independence and delivering constructive, actionable feedback.
Collaboration and Adaptability
  • Collaborates effectively across global, cross-functional, and virtual teams.
  • Adapts quickly to changing priorities, unfamiliar processes, and diverse business environments.
Technology and Continuous Improvement
  • Experience working with Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Teams, and Copilot.
  • Demonstrates initiative and uses technology to improve audit quality, efficiency, and business processes.

Preferences:
  • Advanced degree and relevant professional certifications e.g. CPA, CIA highly desired.
  • Understanding of US SOX requirements and experience in documenting and testing SOX controls.
  • Working knowledge of Generally Accepted Audit Standards (GAAS)
  • Experience in the manufacturing industry with a global organization.
  • Experience using SAP, Oracle, and consolidation software for audit related purposes.
  • Working knowledge of data analysis, automation, and AI tools.
  • Experience with Tableau, QlikView, Snowflake, KNIME, and /or Sigma.
  • Ability to speak multiple languages.

Travel and Work Arrangements 
  • This is a hybrid role based from Davidson, NC
  • Travel anticipated 10-15%; Domestic and Internationally
  • Must be fluent in English.

Job Overview: 
The Regional Sales Manager (RSM) will be responsible for increasing revenue and achieving sales targets in the assigned geographic territory. The RSM will work closely with the distribution network to identify the addressable market and generate opportunities within the territory. RSM will maintain regular communication and constructive relationships with senior leadership, Customers, Channel Partners, End Users and other internal and external stakeholders. A strong understanding of the selling process, a technical acumen and outstanding written and verbal communication skills are essential in this role. RSM must have the skill sets defined below to competently discuss, share knowledge, train and troubleshoot our products to a variety of stakeholders.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage and Develop Channel Partners: Build, manage, and develop a robust network of Channel Partners to drive the sale of Elmo Rietschle products. Assess partner competencies to identify strengths and areas of improvement, develop action plans, and appoint new partners in underperforming areas to meet business goals.

Drive sales activity through Channel Partners to achieve measurable outcomes and maintain a documented pipeline via Salesforce.
  • Provide Technical and Product Support: Offer product education and technical assistance to customers, including troubleshooting, installation guidance, and identifying causes of product malfunctions to maintain the high-quality image of Elmo Rietschle products.
  • Engage in Sales Cycle and Account Management: Actively participate in all stages of the sales cycle, including quoting, account management, and assisting with collections. Establish measurable goals for targeted accounts and provide regular updates on progress and opportunities.
  • Collaborate with Cross-Functional Teams: Work with internal teams such as Engineering, Product Management, Business Development, and Operations to ensure seamless implementation, new product commercialization, and effective account growth.
  • Lead Customer Engagement and Presentations: Schedule, facilitate, and lead presentations to customers while attending industry trade shows and conferences to establish contacts, identify trends, and proactively develop leads.
  • Oversee Channel Partner Network: Supervise a large network of Channel Partner organizations across multiple states, ensuring alignment with Elmo Rietschle’s standards and objectives.

  • High School Diploma or related field.
  • 3+ years of sales experience in industrial Sales with Blowers, Vacuums or Rotating equipment.

  • Product and Market Knowledge: Expertise in dry and lubricated vacuum technologies, booster blowers, and other rotating equipment, with the ability to articulate the value proposition of Elmo Rietschle products in customer terms.
  • Strategic Thinking and Planning: Ability to assess market opportunities, develop actionable strategies, and set specific, measurable goals to drive growth and profitability.
  • Customer-Centric Approach: Skilled at building strong relationships, understanding customer needs, and providing tailored solutions to ensure high satisfaction and repeat business.
  • Technical Proficiency: Proficient in providing technical support, troubleshooting product issues, and guiding customers through product selection, installation, and maintenance.
  • Strong Communication and Collaboration: Excellent interpersonal, negotiation, and persuasion skills to foster positive relationships with customers, vendors, and internal teams.
  • Time and Task Management: Highly organized with strong time management skills, ensuring timely execution of tasks while balancing multiple priorities effectively.
  • Business Acumen: High level of business and financial acumen, enabling informed decision-making and alignment with organizational goals.
  • Self-Motivation and Discipline: Demonstrates intrinsic motivation, a disciplined work style, and the ability to work independently while contributing as part of a team.
  • Technology Proficiency: Skilled in using Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, Outlook) and CRM tools like Salesforce to document and manage sales opportunities.


Preferences:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in: Engineering, Business, or Business degree with strong hydraulic/pneumatic systems experience demonstrated.
  • Candidates must demonstrate strong experience with positive displacement, blower systems, vacuums, or rotating equipment.
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce and SAP

Up to 50%+ overnight travel is expected. This is a remote based position that is to be located near a major airport in the Northeast U.S.

  • Monitors approved supplier list and rates suppliers through score card ratings

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to effectively engage an influence both internal and external stakeholder

We specialize in vacuum pumps, systems, and components for laboratories, life sciences, and industrial manufacturing. Operating within Ingersoll Rand's medical and laboratory division, we combine the engineering strengths of US-based Welch Vacuum Technology and Germany's Ilmvac GmbH.

Job Overview:
We are seeking a dynamic Area Sales Manager to lead our Sales Engineering function across the US West Coast, Mexico, and potentially South America. Requiring up to 75% travel, this role drives the promotion and sale of diverse vacuum technologies and OEM components. You will champion solution-based selling to distributors, manufacturers, system integrators, and end-users across vital sectors—including Life Sciences, Medical, Chemical, and General Manufacturing.

Responsibilities

  • Drive Business Growth: Expand market share using modern prospecting methods, structured toll-gate sales processes, and solution-selling best practices.
  • Manage & Acquire Accounts: Nurture the existing distributor base and partner with dealer reps while aggressively pursuing new distribution, reseller, and OEM/system integrator opportunities.
  • Provide Technical Support: Serve as a trusted technical advisor to OEMs, large end-users, and academic research institutions to guide the pump specification and selection process directly in customer labs.
  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner closely with Field Sales Support, Application Engineering, Product Management, Operations, Quality, Finance, and Demand Generation to secure new business and drive profitable growth.
  • Lead Commercial Negotiations: Manage major pricing negotiations, define technical specifications, and ensure alignment across complex commercial agreements.
  • Build Multi-Level Relationships: Interface confidently with diverse customer departments on a technical and commercial level, including Engineering, Purchasing, Quality, and decision makers and leadership.
  • Maintain Data Integrity: Manage accurate sales forecasts and maintain up-to-date internal CRM reporting to support strategic growth objectives.
  • Apply Subject Matter Expertise: Leverage technical sales experience and vacuum pump technology knowledge to develop business and promote the Welch brand to new customers.
  • Execute Strategic Agility: Perform other responsibilities as assigned or required to support evolving business needs.

Requirements: 

  • High School Degree or a related technical field.
  • 3+ years of customer-facing vacuum sales experience, with a proven track record of growth.

Core Competencies

  • Strategic Selling: Ability to execute sophisticated sales strategies and drive new business development.
  • Problem Solving: Creative problem-solver skilled at resolving technical challenges and open issues.
  • Collaboration: Strong relationship builder with both external clients and internal support teams.
  • Organization: Exceptional multi-tasking abilities with sharp attention to detail, organization, and analysis.
  • Technology: Proficient in Microsoft Office and CRM systems (Salesforce preferred).
  • Languages: Professional fluency in English is required; Spanish proficiency is a strong plus.

Preferences:  
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, chemistry, Life Sciences, or a related technical field.
  • Industry Expertise: Experience in the Laboratory, Analytical, and Life Sciences markets.
  • Technical Knowledge: Proven sales or application experience with vacuum pump technologies (or closely related industrial systems).
  • Account Management: Demonstrated success in prospecting, securing, and managing enterprise-level accounts.
  • Drive: High-energy self-starter with a goal-oriented mindset.

  • Remote with the ability to travel up to 50% within the West region.

Job Overview:
We are looking for a skilled assembler to perform a variety of tasks as assigned in conjunction with the assembly of our product. You will ensure all parts fit correctly and are suitable for the final product. This position is responsible for safely performing high-level continuous work to quality standards. Assignments may change based on business demands.


Responsibilities:

  • Perform a variety of tasks to support the assembly and test of industrial machinery and compression equipment within the plant, in accordance with predetermined standard work.
  • Read, understand, and apply method sheets, assembly diagrams, and blueprints.  
  • Detect quality defects and unsafe conditions.
  • Be knowledgeable and follow all applicable safety rules and procedures.
  • Interpretation of drawings and specifications to determine dimensions, identify materials for construction, and assemble components.
  • Operate power pneumatic and hand tools required for performing job duties.
  • Maintain and inspect tools and equipment and create work orders for repaired as needed.
  • Loading and unloading of equipment utilizing fork trucks, and hoists.
  • Work in a team environment and assist co-workers in other areas as needed/directed, suggesting process improvement ideas.
  • Maintains safe and clean working environment by complying with procedures, rules, and regulations.
  • Material handling activities may include managing inventory levels by checking stock to determine inventory level, anticipating needed supplies, shipping and receipt of supplies.  
  • Assembles components by examining connections for correct fit, fastening parts and subassemblies.
  • Perform general housekeeping of the work area.
  • Tasks can include but are not limited to welding, painting, operating machines and presses, assembly and disassembly of parts, wiring, shipping preparation, and performing quality checks and tests.

Requirements:

  • High School Diploma or General Equivalent Diploma (GED) is required.
  • Familiar with and ability to utilize all hand tools including wrenches, sockets, hammers, tape measures, crimpers, cutters, and steel banding.
  • Basic mechanical aptitude to use equipment and maintain general understanding of business process.
  • Familiar with and can utilize power tools.
  • Knowledgeable of and able to utilize computer systems.
  • Frequently required to sit, stand, and walk for extended periods.
  • Reaching and handling with high levels of dexterity.
  • Must be able to lift up to 25 pounds from floor to waist.  Occasionally required to lift up to 50 pounds.
  • Occasionally required to work near moving mechanical equipment.
  • Frequent exposure to various chemicals, sealants, and lubricants.
  • Occasionally required to work outside where weather conditions range from moderate cold to moderate heat.
  • Normal exposure to moderate noise levels.  Occasional exposure to high noise, levels where hearing protection will be required.


Core Competences:

  • Knowledge of and willingness to comply with all general work rules, policies and procedures, including safety guidelines and procedures.
  • Able to rely on experience and judgment to plan and accomplish goals.
  • Ability to learn to operate all equipment associated with the job; including, but not limited to, power hand tools, forklifts, skyjacks, cranes, and measuring devices.
  • Ability to identify routine problem causation, and correct routine problems, and willingness to learn.
  • Broad working knowledge and experience with standard work instructions.
  • Team oriented, must have the ability to work cohesively with others.
  • Must possess ability to work well in a manufacturing environment.
  • Must be detail-oriented and self-motivated.
  • Must be able to work in a multi-tasked environment.


Preferences:

  • Three (3) years in manufacturing experience preferred.
  • Prior experience in mechanical assembly, electrical wiring, precision measurement, blueprint reading and pipefitting is preferred.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage and Develop Channel Partners: Build, manage, and develop a robust network of Channel Partners to drive the sale of Elmo Rietschle products. Assess partner competencies to identify strengths and areas of improvement, develop action plans, and appoint new partners in underperforming areas to meet business goals.
  • Collaborate with Stakeholders to Drive Strategy: Work closely with Channel Partner Principals, Product Champions, and the National Sales Manager to develop and execute territory strategies that align with revenue, margin, and growth targets.
  • Lead Sales Activities and Pipeline Development: Identify, qualify, and pursue opportunities through cold calls, market research, and maintain a network of industry contacts. Drive sales activity through Channel Partners to achieve measurable outcomes and maintain a documented pipeline via Salesforce.
  • Provide Technical and Product Support: Offer product education and technical assistance to customers, including troubleshooting, installation guidance, and identifying causes of product malfunctions to maintain the high-quality image of Elmo Rietschle products.
  • Engage in Sales Cycle and Account Management: Actively participate in all stages of the sales cycle, including quoting, account management, and assisting with collections. Establish measurable goals for targeted accounts and provide regular updates on progress and opportunities.
  • Collaborate with Cross-Functional Teams: Work with internal teams such as Engineering, Product Management, Business Development, and Operations to ensure seamless implementation, new product commercialization, and effective account growth.
  • Lead Customer Engagement and Presentations: Schedule, facilitate, and lead presentations to customers while attending industry trade shows and conferences to establish contacts, identify trends, and proactively develop leads.
  • Oversee Channel Partner Network: Supervise a large network of Channel Partner organizations across multiple states, ensuring alignment with Elmo Rietschle’s standards and objectives.

Requirements:

  • High School Diploma or related field.
  • 3+ years of sales experience in industrial Sales with Blowers, Vacuums or Rotating equipment.

Core Competencies:

  • Channel Sales Expertise: Strong understanding of channel sales strategies, including managing partner networks, driving revenue growth, and achieving measurable results through collaboration.
  • Product and Market Knowledge: Expertise in dry and lubricated vacuum technologies, booster blowers, and other rotating equipment, with the ability to articulate the value proposition of Elmo Rietschle products in customer terms.
  • Strategic Thinking and Planning: Ability to assess market opportunities, develop actionable strategies, and set specific, measurable goals to drive growth and profitability.
  • Customer-Centric Approach: Skilled at building strong relationships, understanding customer needs, and providing tailored solutions to ensure high satisfaction and repeat business.
  • Technical Proficiency: Proficient in providing technical support, troubleshooting product issues, and guiding customers through product selection, installation, and maintenance.
  • Strong Communication and Collaboration: Excellent interpersonal, negotiation, and persuasion skills to foster positive relationships with customers, vendors, and internal teams.
  • Time and Task Management: Highly organized with strong time management skills, ensuring timely execution of tasks while balancing multiple priorities effectively.
  • Business Acumen: High level of business and financial acumen, enabling informed decision-making and alignment with organizational goals.
  • Self-Motivation and Discipline: Demonstrates intrinsic motivation, a disciplined work style, and the ability to work independently while contributing as part of a team.
  • Technology Proficiency: Skilled in using Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, Outlook) and CRM tools like Salesforce to document and manage sales opportunities.

Preferences:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in: Engineering, Business, or Business degree with strong hydraulic/pneumatic systems experience demonstrated.
  • Candidates must demonstrate strong experience with positive displacement, blower systems, vacuums, or rotating equipment.
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce and SAP

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:
Up to 50%+ overnight travel is expected. This is a remote based position that is to be located near a major airport in the Northeast U.S.

Pay Range: 
The total pay range for this role, not including incentive opportunities, is $110,000 - $125,000. The pay range takes into account a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location.  Hired applicant will be eligible to receive (discretionary/nondiscretionary) annual bonuses and incentive compensation.

Welch Vacuum, a subsidiary of Ingersoll Rand since 1996, is a global leader with over a century of history in high-performance vacuum technologies. We specialize in vacuum pumps, systems, and components for laboratories, life sciences, and industrial manufacturing. Operating within Ingersoll Rand's medical and laboratory division, we combine the engineering strengths of US-based Welch Vacuum Technology and Germany's Ilmvac GmbH.

Job Overview:
We are seeking a dynamic Area Sales Manager to lead our Sales Engineering function across the US West Coast, Mexico, and potentially South America. Requiring up to 75% travel, this role drives the promotion and sale of diverse vacuum technologies and OEM components. You will champion solution-based selling to distributors, manufacturers, system integrators, and end-users across vital sectors—including Life Sciences, Medical, Chemical, and General Manufacturing.

Responsibilities

  • Drive Business Growth: Expand market share using modern prospecting methods, structured toll-gate sales processes, and solution-selling best practices.
  • Manage & Acquire Accounts: Nurture the existing distributor base and partner with dealer reps while aggressively pursuing new distribution, reseller, and OEM/system integrator opportunities.
  • Provide Technical Support: Serve as a trusted technical advisor to OEMs, large end-users, and academic research institutions to guide the pump specification and selection process directly in customer labs.
  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner closely with Field Sales Support, Application Engineering, Product Management, Operations, Quality, Finance, and Demand Generation to secure new business and drive profitable growth.
  • Lead Commercial Negotiations: Manage major pricing negotiations, define technical specifications, and ensure alignment across complex commercial agreements.
  • Build Multi-Level Relationships: Interface confidently with diverse customer departments on a technical and commercial level, including Engineering, Purchasing, Quality, and decision makers and leadership.
  • Maintain Data Integrity: Manage accurate sales forecasts and maintain up-to-date internal CRM reporting to support strategic growth objectives.
  • Apply Subject Matter Expertise: Leverage technical sales experience and vacuum pump technology knowledge to develop business and promote the Welch brand to new customers.
  • Execute Strategic Agility: Perform other responsibilities as assigned or required to support evolving business needs.

  • High School Degree or a related technical field.

  • Organization: Exceptional multi-tasking abilities with sharp attention to detail, organization, and analysis.
  • Technology: Proficient in Microsoft Office and CRM systems (Salesforce preferred).
  • Languages: Professional fluency in English is required; Spanish proficiency is a strong plus.

Preferences:

Job title: Service Technician
Schedule: Monday - Friday, 7:30 AM - 4:30 PM 
Hourly Range: $25.00 - $40.00, weekly pay, based on experience, skills, qualifications, and geographic location. In addition to base pay, Ingersoll Rand offers a comprehensive benefits package, career development opportunities, and company-sponsored training.

Locations: 
Minneapolis, MN
Milwaukee, WI
Kansas City, MO 
Des Moines, IA
Denver, CO
Omaha, NE 
West Fargo, ND
Wichita, KS
Portland, OR
Seattle, WA
Kent, WA

About Us 
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.

Job Overview:
The Field Service Technician for Ingersoll Rand's Compression Systems and Services Division serves customers by installing, troubleshooting, repairing, and maintaining all makes of rotary screw and reciprocating and/or Centac and ECC air compressors, along with additional compressed air system components. You will use precision measuring tools for diagnostic troubleshooting of compressed air equipment. In addition, you need to have knowledge of all operations and parts manuals associated with all equipment.

Responsibilities:
•In addition to performing preventative maintenance on Ingersoll Rand compressed air equipment, our service techs will interact with customers to address existing and unanticipated equipment concerns. 
•Collaborate with Service Coordinator on ordering and gathering parts and supplies necessary to complete installations and repairs. All service technicians will assist and train apprentices and Field Service Technicians.
•Effectively communicates verbally and in writing with customers and co-workers.
•Provides technical assistance on equipment pre-commissioning and start-ups, installations, and repairs of compressed air systems.  Including “hands-on” work to assure equipment operates to customer’s requirement with limited guidance from the Master Technician.
•Increases Ingersoll Rand customers awareness of how Ingersoll Rand products, services, and solutions, such as Preventative Maintenance, Diagnostics, Audits and Leak Detection can benefit their operations.

Requirements:
•2 years+ experience of troubleshooting industrial/commercial mechanical systems.
•Must possess a valid driver's license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years.
•Every service technician is required to be on-call, but you will not be on-call for the first 90 days to get used to the schedule. This is shared with every service tech, and it requires being available 24/7 for the 1-week duration where you will go to customer sites. On-call weeks can be as often as every 4 weeks or greater than 4 weeks, but that will be determined by the hiring manager.
•This position is highly physical and requires regular use of hands, fingers, walking, stooping, and kneeling.  It requires employees to regularly lift and or move weight limits in line with the safety policy.
•High School Diploma or equivalent required.

Core Competencies:
•Able to read wiring schematics and diagrams for all equipment.
•Advanced network systems installations (IMMC/ASC, X Series Automation).
•Basic vibration troubleshooting.
•Basic Air Quality (system compressor/dryer – air treatment).
•Operating knowledge of Microsoft office software and other basic computer usage.  Working proficiency with handheld computer (i.e. Smartphone, iPad) and network bases.
•Maintain proper business travel practices in a cost-efficient manner

Preferences:
•Industrial air compressor maintenance & knowledge.
•EPA Certification.
•Veterans/Active-Duty Military are encouraged to apply.

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:
•Service Technicians will travel daily in a 3-hour radius within our service area.
•A company vehicle and fuel card will be provided.

Pay Range: 
•The pay range for this role is $25.00 - $40.00. The pay range considers a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location. 

What We Offer:
At Ingersoll Rand, we embrace a culture of personal ownership — taking responsibility for our company, our communities, and our environment — as well as for our individual well-being. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to empower you with the tools and support needed to take charge of your health and future.

Our benefits include healthcare coverage (medical, prescription, dental, and vision), wellness programs, life insurance, a 401(k) plan with company match, paid time off, and an employee stock program, among other offerings. These benefits, combined with our pay transparency and inclusive culture, reflect our commitment to supporting you at work and beyond.

TO APPLY: Please apply via our website https://careers.irco.com by 12/31/2026 in order to be considered for this position.

Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to empower you with the tools and support necessary to take charge of your health, ensuring that together, we can continue to make life better. Schedule: Monday - Friday, 7:30 AM - 4:30 PM

Kansas City, MO
