About Us 
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.

Job Overview:
The Field Service Technician for Ingersoll Rand's Compression Systems and Services Division serves customers by installing, troubleshooting, repairing, and maintaining all makes of rotary screw and reciprocating and/or Centac and ECC air compressors, along with additional compressed air system components. You will use precision measuring tools for diagnostic troubleshooting of compressed air equipment. In addition, you need to have knowledge of all operations and parts manuals associated with all equipment.

Responsibilities:
•In addition to performing preventative maintenance on Ingersoll Rand compressed air equipment, our service techs will interact with customers to address existing and unanticipated equipment concerns. 
•Collaborate with Service Coordinator on ordering and gathering parts and supplies necessary to complete installations and repairs. All service technicians will assist and train apprentices and Field Service Technicians.
•Effectively communicates verbally and in writing with customers and co-workers.
•Provides technical assistance on equipment pre-commissioning and start-ups, installations, and repairs of compressed air systems.  Including “hands-on” work to assure equipment operates to customer’s requirement with limited guidance from the Master Technician.
•Increases Ingersoll Rand customers awareness of how Ingersoll Rand products, services, and solutions, such as Preventative Maintenance, Diagnostics, Audits and Leak Detection can benefit their operations.

Requirements:
•2 years+ experience of troubleshooting industrial/commercial mechanical systems.
•Must possess a valid driver's license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years.
•Every service technician is required to be on-call, but you will not be on-call for the first 90 days to get used to the schedule. This is shared with every service tech, and it requires being available 24/7 for the 1-week duration where you will go to customer sites. On-call weeks can be as often as every 4 weeks or greater than 4 weeks, but that will be determined by the hiring manager.
•This position is highly physical and requires regular use of hands, fingers, walking, stooping, and kneeling.  It requires employees to regularly lift and or move weight limits in line with the safety policy.
•High School Diploma or equivalent required.

Core Competencies:
•Able to read wiring schematics and diagrams for all equipment.
•Advanced network systems installations (IMMC/ASC, X Series Automation).
•Basic vibration troubleshooting.
•Basic Air Quality (system compressor/dryer – air treatment).
•Operating knowledge of Microsoft office software and other basic computer usage.  Working proficiency with handheld computer (i.e. Smartphone, iPad) and network bases.
•Maintain proper business travel practices in a cost-efficient manner

Preferences:
•Industrial air compressor maintenance & knowledge.
•EPA Certification.
•Veterans/Active-Duty Military are encouraged to apply.

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:
•Service Technicians will travel daily in a 3-hour radius within our service area.
•A company vehicle and fuel card will be provided.

Pay Range: 
•The pay range for this role is $25.00 - $40.00. The pay range considers a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location.

Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to empower you with the tools and support needed to take charge of your health and future.

Our benefits include healthcare coverage (medical, prescription, dental, and vision), wellness programs, life insurance, a 401(k) plan with company match, paid time off, and an employee stock program, among other offerings. These benefits, combined with our pay transparency and inclusive culture, reflect our commitment to supporting you at work and beyond.

Job Title: Regional Sales Manager - Elmo Rietschle
Location: Remote in Territory: NM, TX, KS, OK, MO, AR, LA, MS, W. TN, KY, S. IL, IN, S. OH, WV, AL, FL, GA 

About Us:
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.

Job Overview: 
The Regional Sales Manager (RSM) will be responsible for increasing revenue and achieving sales targets in the assigned geographic territory. The RSM will work closely with the distribution network to identify the addressable market and generate opportunities within the territory. RSM will maintain regular communication and constructive relationships with senior leadership, Customers, Channel Partners, End Users and other internal and external stakeholders. A strong understanding of the selling process, a technical acumen and outstanding written and verbal communication skills are essential in this role. RSM must have the skill sets defined below to competently discuss, share knowledge, train and troubleshoot our products to a variety of stakeholders.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage and Develop Channel Partners: Build, manage, and develop a robust network of Channel Partners to drive the sale of Elmo Rietschle products. Assess partner competencies to identify strengths and areas of improvement, develop action plans, and appoint new partners in underperforming areas to meet business goals.
  • Collaborate with Stakeholders to Drive Strategy: Work closely with Channel Partner Principals, Product Champions, and the National Sales Manager to develop and execute territory strategies that align with revenue, margin, and growth targets.
  • Lead Sales Activities and Pipeline Development: Identify, qualify, and pursue opportunities through cold calls, market research, and maintain a network of industry contacts. Drive sales activity through Channel Partners to achieve measurable outcomes and maintain a documented pipeline via Salesforce.
  • Provide Technical and Product Support: Offer product education and technical assistance to customers, including troubleshooting, installation guidance, and identifying causes of product malfunctions to maintain the high-quality image of Elmo Rietschle products.
  • Engage in Sales Cycle and Account Management: Actively participate in all stages of the sales cycle, including quoting, account management, and assisting with collections. Establish measurable goals for targeted accounts and provide regular updates on progress and opportunities.
  • Collaborate with Cross-Functional Teams: Work with internal teams such as Engineering, Product Management, Business Development, and Operations to ensure seamless implementation, new product commercialization, and effective account growth.
  • Lead Customer Engagement and Presentations: Schedule, facilitate, and lead presentations to customers while attending industry trade shows and conferences to establish contacts, identify trends, and proactively develop leads.
  • Oversee Channel Partner Network: Supervise a large network of Channel Partner organizations across multiple states, ensuring alignment with Elmo Rietschle’s standards and objectives.

Requirements:

  • High School Diploma or related field.
  • 3+ years of sales experience in industrial Sales with Blowers, Vacuums or Rotating equipment.

Core Competencies:

  • Channel Sales Expertise: Strong understanding of channel sales strategies, including managing partner networks, driving revenue growth, and achieving measurable results through collaboration.
  • Product and Market Knowledge: Expertise in dry and lubricated vacuum technologies, booster blowers, and other rotating equipment, with the ability to articulate the value proposition of Elmo Rietschle products in customer terms.
  • Strategic Thinking and Planning: Ability to assess market opportunities, develop actionable strategies, and set specific, measurable goals to drive growth and profitability.
  • Customer-Centric Approach: Skilled at building strong relationships, understanding customer needs, and providing tailored solutions to ensure high satisfaction and repeat business.
  • Technical Proficiency: Proficient in providing technical support, troubleshooting product issues, and guiding customers through product selection, installation, and maintenance.
  • Strong Communication and Collaboration: Excellent interpersonal, negotiation, and persuasion skills to foster positive relationships with customers, vendors, and internal teams.
  • Time and Task Management: Highly organized with strong time management skills, ensuring timely execution of tasks while balancing multiple priorities effectively.

Job Overview

The Mechanical Designer is responsible for the design and development of mechanical components, assemblies, and subsystems for professional-grade cordless, pneumatic, and electric power tools. Working within cross-functional New Product Development (NPD) teams, this role leads the design of mechanisms, gear trains, housings, and electromechanical integrations from concept through production release.

The successful candidate combines strong CAD expertise with practical engineering knowledge and a deep understanding of manufacturing processes to deliver innovative, reliable, and cost-effective product solutions. This role requires significant ownership of design decisions, collaboration across global teams, and direct engagement with suppliers and manufacturing partners


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop mechanical components, assemblies, and product subsystems using Creo or similar 3D CAD tools.
  • Create and maintain engineering drawings, BOMs, and product documentation.
  • Lead design activities for drivetrains, gear systems, mechanisms, housings, and structural components.
  • Apply GD&T, tolerance analysis, DFM, and DFA principles to ensure robust product designs.
  • Support prototype builds, product validation, issue resolution, and production launches.
  • Collaborate with Product Management, Manufacturing, Quality, Sourcing, and suppliers to optimize performance, cost, reliability, and manufacturability.
  • Participate in design reviews, root cause investigations, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Support engineering change management and product lifecycle activities.

 

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, Mechanical Engineering Technology, Mechatronics, or related discipline.
  • 5+ years of experience designing mechanical or electromechanical products.
  • 5+ years experience with Creo, SolidWorks, NX, CATIA, or equivalent CAD systems.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in power tools, industrial equipment, automotive, or related industries.
  • Strong knowledge of GD&T, tolerance stack-up analysis, and engineering drawing standards.
  • Experience designing injection-molded plastics, castings, machined components, and sheet metal parts.
  • Understanding of mechanical systems, gears, bearings, motors, and mechanisms.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills.
  • Knowledge of planetary gearing, impact mechanisms, clutches, and power transmission systems.
  • Experience with Windchill or similar PLM systems.
  • Familiarity with FMEA, DVP&R, reliability testing, and root cause analysis.

 

 What Success Looks Like

  • Delivers innovative, manufacturable designs that meet performance, quality, cost, and schedule objectives.
  • Demonstrates strong ownership of product subsystems and technical decision-making.
  • Produces high-quality CAD models and release documentation.
  • Successfully supports new product launches and continuous product improvements.
  • Acts as a trusted technical contributor within global engineering teams.

Pay Range
The pay range for this role is $80,000 - $100,000. The pay range considers a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location.

Job Overview:
The Centrifugal Service Technician is a highly skilled field-based technical professional responsible for installing, commissioning, troubleshooting, repairing, and maintaining Ingersoll Rand centrifugal and reciprocating compressor systems. This role primarily supports our Centac® and Turbo Air® product lines, along with dryers, cooling towers, filtration systems, and associated compressed air equipment.
As a trusted technical advisor, you will work directly with customers across a variety of industrial environments, providing hands-on service, start-up support, diagnostics, major overhauls, and technical training. Successful candidates possess strong mechanical and electrical aptitude, excellent customer service skills, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced field service environment.

Responsibilities:
•    Install, commission, inspect, troubleshoot, maintain, and repair centrifugal compressors, compressed air systems, and related equipment at customer locations nationwide.
•    Perform advanced mechanical, electrical, and controls diagnostics using precision measuring instruments, technical drawings, wiring schematics, and OEM documentation.
•    Lead equipment start-ups, major overhauls, upgrades, preventative maintenance, and corrective repairs to maximize equipment reliability and performance.
•    Serve as a trusted technical advisor by providing customers with equipment assessments, operational recommendations, technical training, and exceptional service support.
•    Accurately document service activities, technical findings, labor, parts usage, expenses, and recommendations while ensuring timely submission of all required reports and records.
•    Maintain compliance with all safety standards and customer site requirements while effectively managing travel schedules, customer commitments, and ongoing technical training and development.

Requirements:
•    High school diploma or GED required.
•    Minimum 3 + years of experience troubleshooting and repairing industrial or commercial mechanical systems.
•    Strong mechanical and electrical troubleshooting skills.
•    Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, wiring diagrams, schematics, and service manuals.
•    Experience working independently in customer-facing service environments.
•    Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
•    Proficiency using Microsoft Office applications, mobile devices, and digital reporting systems.
•     Must possess a valid driver's license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years.

Preferences: 
•      Associate degree or technical certification in Electrical Technology, Electronic Technology, HVAC, Industrial Maintenance, Mechatronics, or a related field preferred. 
•      Experience servicing centrifugal compressors, rotary screw compressors, compressed air systems, industrial controls, PLCs, motor controls, refrigeration systems, cooling towers, and air treatment equipment. 
•     EPA 608 Certification or equivalent refrigeration certification preferred. 
•     Military mechanical, electrical, or technical experience strongly preferred. 
•     Demonstrated ability to perform equipment startups, advanced troubleshooting, and major overhauls in an industrial field service environment. 
•     Ability to lift up to 50 pounds, work safely around industrial machinery and energized systems, perform physical activities including standing, walking, bending, kneeling, and climbing, work in varying environmental conditions, and travel extensively throughout the United States.

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:
•      Monday – Friday travel, home for the weekends is typical.

Job Overview:
The Field Service Technician for Ingersoll Rand's Compression Systems and Services Division serves customers by installing, troubleshooting, repairing, and maintaining all makes of rotary screw and reciprocating and/or Centac and ECC air compressors, along with additional compressed air system components. You will use precision measuring tools for diagnostic troubleshooting of compressed air equipment. In addition, you need to have knowledge of all operations and parts manuals associated with all equipment.

Responsibilities:
•In addition to performing preventative maintenance on Ingersoll Rand compressed air equipment, our service techs will interact with customers to address existing and unanticipated equipment concerns. 
•Collaborate with Service Coordinator on ordering and gathering parts and supplies necessary to complete installations and repairs. All service technicians will assist and train apprentices and Field Service Technicians.
•Effectively communicates verbally and in writing with customers and co-workers.
•Provides technical assistance on equipment pre-commissioning and start-ups, installations, and repairs of compressed air systems.  Including “hands-on” work to assure equipment operates to customer’s requirement with limited guidance from the Master Technician.
•Increases Ingersoll Rand customers awareness of how Ingersoll Rand products, services, and solutions, such as Preventative Maintenance, Diagnostics, Audits and Leak Detection can benefit their operations.

Requirements:
•2 years+ experience of troubleshooting industrial/commercial mechanical systems.
•Must possess a valid driver's license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years.
•Every service technician is required to be on-call, but you will not be on-call for the first 90 days to get used to the schedule. This is shared with every service tech, and it requires being available 24/7 for the 1-week duration where you will go to customer sites. On-call weeks can be as often as every 4 weeks or greater than 4 weeks, but that will be determined by the hiring manager.
•This position is highly physical and requires regular use of hands, fingers, walking, stooping, and kneeling.  It requires employees to regularly lift and or move weight limits in line with the safety policy.
•High School Diploma or equivalent required.

Core Competencies:
•Able to read wiring schematics and diagrams for all equipment.
•Advanced network systems installations (IMMC/ASC, X Series Automation).
•Basic vibration troubleshooting.
•Basic Air Quality (system compressor/dryer – air treatment).
•Operating knowledge of Microsoft office software and other basic computer usage.  Working proficiency with handheld computer (i.e. Smartphone, iPad) and network bases.
•Maintain proper business travel practices in a cost-efficient manner

Preferences:
•Industrial air compressor maintenance & knowledge.
•EPA Certification.
•Veterans/Active-Duty Military are encouraged to apply.

•Service Technicians will travel daily in a 3-hour radius within our service area.
•A company vehicle and fuel card will be provided.

Job Overview: 
The Regional Sales Manager (RSM) will be responsible for increasing revenue and achieving sales targets in the assigned geographic territory. The RSM will work closely with the distribution network to identify the addressable market and generate opportunities within the territory. RSM will maintain regular communication and constructive relationships with senior leadership, Customers, Channel Partners, End Users and other internal and external stakeholders. A strong understanding of the selling process, a technical acumen and outstanding written and verbal communication skills are essential in this role. RSM must have the skill sets defined below to competently discuss, share knowledge, train and troubleshoot our products to a variety of stakeholders.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage and Develop Channel Partners: Build, manage, and develop a robust network of Channel Partners to drive the sale of Elmo Rietschle products. Assess partner competencies to identify strengths and areas of improvement, develop action plans, and appoint new partners in underperforming areas to meet business goals.
  • Collaborate with Stakeholders to Drive Strategy: Work closely with Channel Partner Principals, Product Champions, and the National Sales Manager to develop and execute territory strategies that align with revenue, margin, and growth targets.
  • Lead Sales Activities and Pipeline Development: Identify, qualify, and pursue opportunities through cold calls, market research, and maintain a network of industry contacts. Drive sales activity through Channel Partners to achieve measurable outcomes and maintain a documented pipeline via Salesforce.
  • Provide Technical and Product Support: Offer product education and technical assistance to customers, including troubleshooting, installation guidance, and identifying causes of product malfunctions to maintain the high-quality image of Elmo Rietschle products.
  • Engage in Sales Cycle and Account Management: Actively participate in all stages of the sales cycle, including quoting, account management, and assisting with collections. Establish measurable goals for targeted accounts and provide regular updates on progress and opportunities.
  • Collaborate with Cross-Functional Teams: Work with internal teams such as Engineering, Product Management, Business Development, and Operations to ensure seamless implementation, new product commercialization, and effective account growth.
  • Lead Customer Engagement and Presentations: Schedule, facilitate, and lead presentations to customers while attending industry trade shows and conferences to establish contacts, identify trends, and proactively develop leads.
  • Oversee Channel Partner Network: Supervise a large network of Channel Partner organizations across multiple states, ensuring alignment with Elmo Rietschle’s standards and objectives.

Requirements:

  • High School Diploma or related field.
  • 3+ years of sales experience in industrial Sales with Blowers, Vacuums or Rotating equipment.

Core Competencies:

  • Channel Sales Expertise: Strong understanding of channel sales strategies, including managing partner networks, driving revenue growth, and achieving measurable results through collaboration.
  • Product and Market Knowledge: Expertise in dry and lubricated vacuum technologies, booster blowers, and other rotating equipment, with the ability to articulate the value proposition of Elmo Rietschle products in customer terms.
  • Strategic Thinking and Planning: Ability to assess market opportunities, develop actionable strategies, and set specific, measurable goals to drive growth and profitability.
  • Customer-Centric Approach: Skilled at building strong relationships, understanding customer needs, and providing tailored solutions to ensure high satisfaction and repeat business.
  • Technical Proficiency: Proficient in providing technical support, troubleshooting product issues, and guiding customers through product selection, installation, and maintenance.
  • Strong Communication and Collaboration: Excellent interpersonal, negotiation, and persuasion skills to foster positive relationships with customers, vendors, and internal teams.
  • Time and Task Management: Highly organized with strong time management skills, ensuring timely execution of tasks while balancing multiple priorities effectively.
  • Business Acumen: High level of business and financial acumen, enabling informed decision-making and alignment with organizational goals.
  • Self-Motivation and Discipline: Demonstrates intrinsic motivation, a disciplined work style, and the ability to work independently while contributing as part of a team.
  • Technology Proficiency: Skilled in using Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, Outlook) and CRM tools like Salesforce to document and manage sales opportunities.

Preferences:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in: Engineering, Business, or Business degree with strong hydraulic/pneumatic systems experience demonstrated.
  • Candidates must demonstrate strong experience with positive displacement, blower systems, vacuums, or rotating equipment.
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce and SAP

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:
Up to 50%+ overnight travel is expected. This is a remote based position that is to be located near a major airport in the Northeast U.S.

Job Title: Strategic Sourcing Manager, New Product Development                
Location:  Mocksville, NC 
 
About Us
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.  

Job Overview:
Lead the team. Shape the products. Influence what comes next. Ingersoll Rand is evolving its compressor portfolio, and sourcing will help determine how that future takes shape. As a Sourcing Leader within the Compression Systems & Services Americas Sourcing Organization, you’ll lead the people and supplier decisions that bring new products, redesigns, and Innovate to Value (i2V) initiatives from concept through launch. Your greatest impact starts with the team. You’ll develop an established group of sourcing professionals, giving them the coaching, tools, and confidence to make sound decisions and take ownership of their work. Through clear priorities, thoughtful delegation, and meaningful accountability, you’ll strengthen the team’s capabilities while removing barriers and keeping sourcing commitments aligned with project milestones. You’ll also lead selected projects yourself, combining people leadership with hands-on sourcing execution.

Working closely with engineering, project and product management, operations, quality, finance, commodity teams, and suppliers, you’ll guide direct-material sourcing across an industrial compressor portfolio. The work spans components such as motors, drives, electronic controls, and heavy castings within a global supply base. You’ll set sourcing direction, develop supplier strategies, lead complex negotiations, and advance dual-sourcing and risk-mitigation efforts suited to a manufacturing environment with a broad product mix and lower production volumes. You’ll also help define how the team measures success: making progress visible, identifying schedule risks early, and connecting sourcing decisions to cost savings, product margins, quality, and supply assurance. As legacy products evolve and new platforms move toward production, your leadership will help turn sourcing strategy into measurable results.

For a sourcing professional who enjoys developing people, solving complex supplier challenges, and seeing decisions take shape in real products, this is an opportunity to influence both how the team performs and what Ingersoll Rand brings to market next.

Responsibilities: 
  • Sourcing Strategy and Project Leadership: Lead sourcing strategy for NPD and I2V initiatives from early concept through launch and stabilization. Align sourcing resources and deliverables with business objectives, project gates, commodity strategies, supplier rationalization, plant needs, localization objectives, and regional priorities.
  • People Leadership and Team Development: Lead, coach, and develop sourcing professionals supporting NPD, value engineering, localization, supplier transitions, and productivity projects. Set goals, prioritize assignments, balance workloads, conduct performance discussions, and support career development and succession planning. Build capability through best practices, collaboration, barrier removal, and a culture of ownership and accountability.
  • Supplier Selection and Commercial Management: Lead supplier selection, sourcing decisions, RFPs, RFQs, and negotiations, balancing cost, quality, delivery, lead time, capacity, risk, and long-term supplier capability. Oversee pricing, payment terms, tooling, inventory programs, capacity commitments, and supplier development needs.
  • Cost Management and Value Improvement: Own sourcing cost models, business case inputs, and project cost tracking for legacy-to-new product comparisons, productivity targets, and launch readiness. Drive I2V and VAVE workstreams to identify cost reduction, design-to-value, supplier optimization, localization, and specification improvement opportunities.
  • Project Governance and Performance Tracking: Establish standard work, reporting cadence, and performance measures that provide visibility to sourcing milestones, risks, savings, cost avoidance, and launch readiness. Represent Sourcing in product gate reviews, plant reviews, VAVE events, MMR events, and leadership operating reviews, ensuring actions are documented, assigned, and completed.
  • Risk Resolution and Supplier Recovery: Identify gaps to project goals and lead cross-functional countermeasures addressing cost, supplier readiness, part qualification, capacity, delivery, and quality. Manage supplier escalations and recovery plans when issues threaten launches, customer commitments, warranty performance, or project timelines.
  • Cross-Functional Partnerships and Continuous Improvement: Build strong relationships with engineering, product management, operations, quality, finance, commodity leaders, plant teams, and suppliers to align priorities, resolve conflict, and maximize value. Facilitate continuous improvement and ideation sessions to build the project pipeline and strengthen sourcing execution.
  • Special Projects and Additional Responsibilities: Lead or participate in special projects and perform additional duties as assigned.

Requirements: 
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Engineering, Operations, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of progressively responsible experience in sourcing, supply chain, engineering, operations, or project leadership, including direct-material sourcing and support for NPD, VAVE, I2V, and / or complex cross-functional programs.
  • 3+ years of people leadership, supervisory, or team-lead experience, including assigning work, setting priorities, coaching employees, monitoring performance, and supporting employee development.
  • 3+ years of experience coordinating sourcing deliverables with engineering and project management teams through structured development processes, including tracking milestones, resolving barriers, and addressing schedule risks.

Title: Electro-Mechanical Assembler
Location: Mocksville, NC (Onsite) (338 Valley Rd. Mocksville, NC 27028) 
Shift: 1st Shift (Monday - Friday 6AM - 2PM) - Full-time Direct Hire

 

Job Overview 

The Precision Assembler performs complex mechanical and electromechanical assembly for rotary air compressor systems and custom industrial control panels. The role requires solid comprehension of compressor package builds, low?voltage control wiring, and strict adherence to manufacturing, quality, and EHS standards in a fast-paced environment. 

 

Mechanical Assembly – Air Compressor Systems 

  • Assemble rotary screw compressor packages, including air ends, drive systems, inlet/discharge piping, coolers, filtration, and related sub?assemblies. 

  • Install and align couplings, belts, sheaves, motors, gear drives, and mounting hardware using dial indicators, torque wrenches, and feeler gauges. 

  • Route and secure hard lines, hoses, coolant lines, and pneumatic tubing per engineering specifications. 

  • Perform torque?controlled fastening to OEM specifications and verify leak integrity of assembled components. 

  • Interpret compressor assembly drawings, P&IDs, schematics, and BOMs to ensure build accuracy. 

     

Electrical Panel & Wiring Assembly 

  • Perform point-to-point wiring for 12V/24V control circuits and compressor instrumentation. 

  • Build and populate electrical enclosures with breakers, fuses, contactors, relays, power supplies, motor starters, PLC I/O, VFDs, and soft?starters. 

  • Route, terminate, and label conductors in accordance with UL 508A panel?building practices or company standards. 

  • Install sensors and wiring for temperature probes, pressure transducers, level switches, solenoid valves, and safety interlocks. 

  • Perform continuity, insulation, and functional tests; verify VFD parameters as required. 
     

Quality, Testing & Compliance 

  • Execute in?process inspection of mechanical clearances, wire routing, torque values, and build sequencing. 

  • Support run?test operations to validate startup readiness, motor rotation, control logic, and I/O functionality. 

  • Ensure all tools and measurement devices are within calibration; escalate out?of?tolerance conditions immediately. 

  • Document inspections, sign?offs, and nonconformances per the internal quality system. 
     

Operational Support 

  • Maintain 5S discipline, apply lean practices, and participate in continuous improvement initiatives. 

  • Identify assembly issues, assist with root?cause analysis, and support corrective actions. 

  • Provide training and technical guidance to team members as needed. 
     

Required Qualifications 

  • High School Diploma or GED. 

  • Minimum 1 year experience in industrial equipment assembly, preferably compressors, HVAC, pumps, or electromechanical systems. 

  • Proficiency in mechanical assembly, precision alignment, low?voltage wiring, and panel assembly. 

  • Ability to read mechanical prints, electrical schematics, and wiring diagrams; follow standard work instructions. 

  • Proficient with torque tools, hoists, pneumatic tools, crimping equipment, and test instruments (multimeters, megohmmeters). 

  • Working knowledge of industrial safety, LOTO, and rotating equipment best practices.

Job Overview:
The Field Service Technician for Ingersoll Rand's Compression Systems and Services Division serves customers by installing, troubleshooting, repairing, and maintaining all makes of rotary screw and reciprocating and/or Centac and ECC air compressors, along with additional compressed air system components. You will use precision measuring tools for diagnostic troubleshooting of compressed air equipment. In addition, you need to have knowledge of all operations and parts manuals associated with all equipment.

Responsibilities:
In addition to performing preventative maintenance on Ingersoll Rand compressed air equipment, our service techs will interact with customers to address existing and unanticipated equipment concerns. Collaborate with Service Coordinator on ordering and gathering parts and supplies necessary to complete installations and repairs. All service technicians will assist and train apprentices and Field Service Technicians.
  • Effectively communicates verbally and in writing with customers and co-workers.
  • Provides technical assistance on equipment pre-commissioning and start-ups, installations, and repairs of compressed air systems.  Including “hands-on” work to assure equipment operates to customer’s requirement with limited guidance from the Master Technician.

Requirements:
  • 2 years+ experience of troubleshooting industrial/commercial mechanical systems.
  • Must possess a valid driver's license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years.
  • Every service technician is required to be on-call, but you will not be on-call for the first 90 days to get used to the schedule. This is shared with every service tech, and it requires being available 24/7 for the 1-week duration where you will go to customer sites. On-call weeks can be as often as every 4 weeks or greater than 4 weeks, but that will be determined by the hiring manager.
  • This position is highly physical and requires regular use of hands, fingers, walking, stooping, and kneeling.  It requires employees to regularly lift and or move weight limits in line with the safety policy.

job.description:

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.


 

Title: Welder - 1st Shift (5am - 130pm)

Location: Bentleyville Facility in Charleroi, PA (Gardner Denver Nash - 200 Simko Blvd. Charleroi, PA 15022) 

Shift: 1st Shift, Monday - Friday (5am - 130pm)

 

About Us: 
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future. 

 

Job Overview: 
We are looking for a skilled Welder to perform a variety of tasks as assigned in conjunction with the assembly of our product. You will ensure all parts fit correctly and are suitable for the final product. This position is responsible for safely performing high-level continuous work to quality standards. Assignments may change based on business demands.  You must have desired technical knowledge and possess great manual dexterity. Ability to interpret instructions represented in manuals, drawings, schematics etc. and follow them with precision. 

 

Responsibilities: 

  •  Welding nickel 55/45 wire to cast-iron as a filler or to build back up or to fill in part erosion/cavitation 
  • Welds all types of metals and alloys of various sizes, shapes, and thicknesses, including dissimilar metals such as steel. 
  • ?Operates various hand-welding, flame-cutting, hand-soldering, or brazing equipment to weld or join metal components or to fill holes, indentations, or seams of fabricated metal products. 
  • May set up, operate, and/or tend to robots that weld, braze, solder, or heat treat metal products, components, or assemblies. 
  • Read and understand fabrication blueprints/drawings; 
  • Fit metal components as per provided blueprints/drawings and specifications, ensuring all tolerances are met; 
  • Using processes such as GMAW (MIG), GTAW (TIG) and FCAW to fuse together metal segments; 
  • Operate welding equipment (manual or semi-automatic), metal shaping machines;  
  • Ensuring that all tasks are performed in the allotted time provided and in accordance with Health and Safety regulations and company policies and procedures; 
  •  Basic maintenance of welding equipment. 

 

Requirements: 

  • 2+ years of experience welding  
  • 1+ years of fitting experience 


Core Competencies: 

  • Experience and ability to read and understand fabrication prints; 
  • Manual Dexterity and hand-eye co-ordination;
  • Able to stand for extended periods of time and handle heavy loads (up to 50lbs) 
  • Ability to work both independently, with little supervision and as a team 
  • Ability to adjust quickly to changing priorities and conditions 

 

Preferences: 

  • High School Diploma or GED 
  •  GTAW, SMAW and Sub-arc welding experience 
  •  Reading and understanding blueprints  
  • The ability to pass a GMAW/FCAW 6G test.  
  • Familiar with and can utilize power tools. 
  • Knowledgeable of and able to utilize computer systems. 

 

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:
This position will be based at our site in Bentleyville, PA no travel.

These benefits are our commitment to you, so you can be your best at work and beyond.

Job Title: Regional Sales Manager - Elmo Rietschle
Location: Remote in Territory: NM, TX, KS, OK, MO, AR, LA, MS, W. TN, KY, S. IL, IN, S. OH, WV, AL, FL, GA 

About Us:
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.

Job Overview: 
The Regional Sales Manager (RSM) will be responsible for increasing revenue and achieving sales targets in the assigned geographic territory. The RSM will work closely with the distribution network to identify the addressable market and generate opportunities within the territory. RSM will maintain regular communication and constructive relationships with senior leadership, Customers, Channel Partners, End Users and other internal and external stakeholders. A strong understanding of the selling process, a technical acumen and outstanding written and verbal communication skills are essential in this role. RSM must have the skill sets defined below to competently discuss, share knowledge, train and troubleshoot our products to a variety of stakeholders.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage and Develop Channel Partners: Build, manage, and develop a robust network of Channel Partners to drive the sale of Elmo Rietschle products. Assess partner competencies to identify strengths and areas of improvement, develop action plans, and appoint new partners in underperforming areas to meet business goals.
  • Collaborate with Stakeholders to Drive Strategy: Work closely with Channel Partner Principals, Product Champions, and the National Sales Manager to develop and execute territory strategies that align with revenue, margin, and growth targets.
  • Lead Sales Activities and Pipeline Development: Identify, qualify, and pursue opportunities through cold calls, market research, and maintain a network of industry contacts. Drive sales activity through Channel Partners to achieve measurable outcomes and maintain a documented pipeline via Salesforce.
  • Provide Technical and Product Support: Offer product education and technical assistance to customers, including troubleshooting, installation guidance, and identifying causes of product malfunctions to maintain the high-quality image of Elmo Rietschle products.
  • Engage in Sales Cycle and Account Management: Actively participate in all stages of the sales cycle, including quoting, account management, and assisting with collections. Establish measurable goals for targeted accounts and provide regular updates on progress and opportunities.
  • Collaborate with Cross-Functional Teams: Work with internal teams such as Engineering, Product Management, Business Development, and Operations to ensure seamless implementation, new product commercialization, and effective account growth.
  • Lead Customer Engagement and Presentations: Schedule, facilitate, and lead presentations to customers while attending industry trade shows and conferences to establish contacts, identify trends, and proactively develop leads.
  • Oversee Channel Partner Network: Supervise a large network of Channel Partner organizations across multiple states, ensuring alignment with Elmo Rietschle’s standards and objectives.

Requirements:

  • High School Diploma or related field.
  • 3+ years of sales experience in industrial Sales with Blowers, Vacuums or Rotating equipment.

Core Competencies:

  • Channel Sales Expertise: Strong understanding of channel sales strategies, including managing partner networks, driving revenue growth, and achieving measurable results through collaboration.
  • Product and Market Knowledge: Expertise in dry and lubricated vacuum technologies, booster blowers, and other rotating equipment, with the ability to articulate the value proposition of Elmo Rietschle products in customer terms.
  • Strategic Thinking and Planning: Ability to assess market opportunities, develop actionable strategies, and set specific, measurable goals to drive growth and profitability.
  • Customer-Centric Approach: Skilled at building strong relationships, understanding customer needs, and providing tailored solutions to ensure high satisfaction and repeat business.
  • Technical Proficiency: Proficient in providing technical support, troubleshooting product issues, and guiding customers through product selection, installation, and maintenance.
  • Strong Communication and Collaboration: Excellent interpersonal, negotiation, and persuasion skills to foster positive relationships with customers, vendors, and internal teams.
  • Time and Task Management: Highly organized with strong time management skills, ensuring timely execution of tasks while balancing multiple priorities effectively.
  • Business Acumen: High level of business and financial acumen, enabling informed decision-making and alignment with organizational goals.
  • Self-Motivation and Discipline: Demonstrates intrinsic motivation, a disciplined work style, and the ability to work independently while contributing as part of a team.
  • Technology Proficiency: Skilled in using Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, Outlook) and CRM tools like Salesforce to document and manage sales opportunities.

Preferences:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in: Engineering, Business, or Business degree with strong hydraulic/pneumatic systems experience demonstrated.
  • Candidates must demonstrate strong experience with positive displacement, blower systems, vacuums, or rotating equipment.
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce and SAP

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:
Up to 50%+ overnight travel is expected. This is a remote based position that is to be located near a major airport in the Northeast U.S.

Pay Range: 
The total pay range for this role, not including incentive opportunities, is $110,000 - $125,000. The pay range takes into account a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location.  Hired applicant will be eligible to receive (discretionary/nondiscretionary) annual bonuses and incentive compensation.  

What We Offer:
At Ingersoll Rand, we embrace a culture of personal ownership — taking responsibility for our company, our communities, and our environment — as well as for our individual well-being. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to empower you with the tools and support needed to take charge of your health and future. 
 
Our benefits include healthcare coverage (medical, prescription, dental, and vision), wellness programs, life insurance, a 401(k) plan with company match, paid time off, and an employee stock program, among other offerings. These benefits, combined with our pay transparency and inclusive culture, reflect our commitment to supporting you at work and beyond. 

Ingersoll Rand Inc. (NYSE:IR), driven by an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset, is dedicated to helping make life better for our employees, customers and communities. Customers lean on us for our technology-driven excellence in mission-critical flow creation and industrial solutions across 40+ respected brands where our products and services excel in the most complex and harsh conditions. Our employees develop customers for life through their daily commitment to expertise, productivity and efficiency. For more information, visit www.IRCO.com.

Job Title: Service Coordinator
 Location: Indianapolis, IL or Cincinnati, OH
 

 

About Us 

Ingersoll Rand thrives on a culture of innovation and a sense of ownership, committed to enhancing the lives of our employees, customers, and the planet. With over 80 renowned brands, our customers rely on our products and services to deliver high-quality flow creation and industrial solutions designed to perform in the most complex and harsh conditions. Additionally, our unwavering commitment to ownership has enabled our employees to cultivate strong customer relationships, driving them to solve the industry’s most difficult problems. 

 

Job Summary  

  • This position is a Service Coordinator supporting the Customer Center and serving the compressed air needs of the industrial sector. The Service Coordinator is responsible for delivering exceptional customer service, and efficiently and effectively coordinating service technicians to meet customer needs.? Service Coordinators will manage and communicate with customers, sales teams, and management, while adhering to all order management and operational requirements of the position. 

 

Responsibilities  

  • Answer incoming service calls and schedule technicians to perform preventive maintenance and service repairs. When scheduling and tracking service technicians, maximize operating efficiency and effectiveness.  

  • Guide and develop service technicians as appropriate, assisting in technical issue resolution.  

  • Ensure timely and accurate invoicing.  

  • Manage service inventory and rental fleets (repair status, location, etc.)  

  • Ensure environmental, health and safety, as well as Operational Excellence adherence in the Customer Center. Assist with the auditing process.  

  • Earn customer loyalty by effectively and efficiently managing customer interactions, ensuring customer satisfaction. Generate and follow-up on service quotes and seek new business whenever possible. 

  • Order and receive parts for jobs. Monitor shipping and receiving activities. Conduct service request data entry and management.? Submit warranty claims and ship parts to the factory.? Ensure SARBOX compliance.  

  • Display team effort and dedication to customer by maintaining flexibility to work overtime and weekends as the business requires.  

 

Basic Qualifications 

  • High school diploma or GED and 2-3 years of experience in a related field is required. 

  • Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree preferred?  

  • Operating knowledge of Microsoft office software and working proficiency with hand-held computer (i.e. Smartphone, iPad) is required.  

  • Knowledge of mechanical and electrical systems is preferred.  

  • Salesforce experience a plus   

  • Forklift certification a plus, but not required (we'll certify you!)  

  • This position is highly physical and requires regular use of hands, fingers, walking, stooping, and kneeling.? It requires employees to regularly lift and or move up to 10 lbs. and occasionally lift and or move 40+ lbs. 

 

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements  

This position will be based in Elmhurst, IL, and may travel occasionally within the US for meetings, employee training, and other business needs (5-10%).

Job Overview:
The Sales Manager will be responsible for driving revenue growth and market share expansion for chiller and advanced cooling solutions within the data center industry. This role focuses on identifying, developing, and managing relationships with hyperscale, colocation, enterprise, and edge data center customers, as well as influencers including consulting engineers, design firms, contractors, and key channel partners. The successful candidate will possess strong technical and commercial knowledge of HVAC and cooling systems, with a particular emphasis on mission-critical environments.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute strategic sales plans to achieve annual revenue and profitability targets for chiller products and cooling solutions in the data center market.
  • Identify and develop new business opportunities with hyperscale, colocation, cloud service providers, enterprise, and edge data center customers.
  • Establish and maintain executive-level relationships with key customer stakeholders, including facility managers, engineering teams, procurement leaders, and C-suite decision-makers.
  • Build and maintain a robust sales pipeline through proactive prospecting, customer engagement, and market intelligence gathering.
  • Lead the sales process from opportunity identification through contract award and project handover.
  • Understand customer requirements related to mission-critical cooling, energy efficiency, sustainability, uptime, and total cost of ownership.
  • Position chiller solutions as preferred technologies for data center cooling applications.
  • Support customers in evaluating cooling system designs and technology alternatives, including air-cooled, water-cooled, modular, and high-efficiency chiller solutions.
  • Promote innovative cooling technologies supporting AI, high-density computing, and next-generation data center applications.
  • Represent the company at industry conferences, trade shows, and customer events.
  • Collaborate with consulting engineers, data center designers, general contractors, MEP firms, and EPC organizations to influence project specifications.
  • Engage in early-stage project development to secure preferred vendor positioning.
  • Work closely with application engineering teams to develop technical and commercial proposals.
  • Monitor project pipelines and construction activity within assigned territories.
  • Partner with product management, engineering, marketing, operations, and service teams to ensure customer satisfaction.
  • Provide market feedback regarding product requirements, competitive activity, pricing trends, and emerging technologies.
  • Support forecasting, sales planning, and CRM management activities.


Requirements:

  • High School Dioplma
  • 3+ years of sales experience in HVAC, cooling systems, chillers, data center infrastructure, or mission-critical environments.


Core Competencies:

  • Demonstrated success in consultative and solution-based selling.
  • Experience managing complex sales cycles with multiple stakeholders.
  • Proven track record of achieving or exceeding sales targets.
  • Experience selling chillers, cooling solutions, CRAH/CRAC systems, liquid cooling, or thermal management solutions.
  • Experience working with hyperscale, colocation, cloud, or enterprise data center customers.
  • Familiarity with data center design and construction processes.
  • Knowledge of AI-ready/high-density data center cooling requirements.


Preferences:

  • Strong understanding of HVAC systems, chilled water systems, and data center cooling technologies.
  • Knowledge of data center market dynamics, industry standards, and sustainability initiatives.
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to communicate complex solutions to both technical and commercial audiences.
  • Excellent negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Strategic thinker with strong business acumen.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment.
  • Proficiency in CRM platforms such as Salesforce or Microsoft Dynamics


Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:
Ability to travel up to 40-60% as required to support customer meetings, project sites, industry events, and partner engagement activities.

Pay Range:
The total pay range for this role, not including incentive opportunities, is $120,000 - $140,000. The pay range takes into account a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location.  Hired applicant will be eligible to receive (discretionary/nondiscretionary) annual bonuses and incentive compensation.

These benefits, combined with our pay transparency and inclusive culture, reflect our commitment to supporting you at work and beyond.

Job Overview: 
The Regional Sales Manager (RSM) will be responsible for increasing revenue and achieving sales targets in the assigned geographic territory. The RSM will work closely with the distribution network to identify the addressable market and generate opportunities within the territory. RSM will maintain regular communication and constructive relationships with senior leadership, Customers, Channel Partners, End Users and other internal and external stakeholders. A strong understanding of the selling process, a technical acumen and outstanding written and verbal communication skills are essential in this role. RSM must have the skill sets defined below to competently discuss, share knowledge, train and troubleshoot our products to a variety of stakeholders.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage and Develop Channel Partners: Build, manage, and develop a robust network of Channel Partners to drive the sale of Elmo Rietschle products. Assess partner competencies to identify strengths and areas of improvement, develop action plans, and appoint new partners in underperforming areas to meet business goals.
  • Collaborate with Stakeholders to Drive Strategy: Work closely with Channel Partner Principals, Product Champions, and the National Sales Manager to develop and execute territory strategies that align with revenue, margin, and growth targets.
  • Lead Sales Activities and Pipeline Development: Identify, qualify, and pursue opportunities through cold calls, market research, and maintain a network of industry contacts. Drive sales activity through Channel Partners to achieve measurable outcomes and maintain a documented pipeline via Salesforce.
  • Provide Technical and Product Support: Offer product education and technical assistance to customers, including troubleshooting, installation guidance, and identifying causes of product malfunctions to maintain the high-quality image of Elmo Rietschle products.
  • Engage in Sales Cycle and Account Management: Actively participate in all stages of the sales cycle, including quoting, account management, and assisting with collections. Establish measurable goals for targeted accounts and provide regular updates on progress and opportunities.
  • Collaborate with Cross-Functional Teams: Work with internal teams such as Engineering, Product Management, Business Development, and Operations to ensure seamless implementation, new product commercialization, and effective account growth.
  • Lead Customer Engagement and Presentations: Schedule, facilitate, and lead presentations to customers while attending industry trade shows and conferences to establish contacts, identify trends, and proactively develop leads.
  • Oversee Channel Partner Network: Supervise a large network of Channel Partner organizations across multiple states, ensuring alignment with Elmo Rietschle’s standards and objectives.

Requirements:

  • High School Diploma or related field.
  • 3+ years of sales experience in industrial Sales with Blowers, Vacuums or Rotating equipment.

Core Competencies:

  • Channel Sales Expertise: Strong understanding of channel sales strategies, including managing partner networks, driving revenue growth, and achieving measurable results through collaboration.
  • Product and Market Knowledge: Expertise in dry and lubricated vacuum technologies, booster blowers, and other rotating equipment, with the ability to articulate the value proposition of Elmo Rietschle products in customer terms.
  • Strategic Thinking and Planning: Ability to assess market opportunities, develop actionable strategies, and set specific, measurable goals to drive growth and profitability.
  • Customer-Centric Approach: Skilled at building strong relationships, understanding customer needs, and providing tailored solutions to ensure high satisfaction and repeat business.
  • Technical Proficiency: Proficient in providing technical support, troubleshooting product issues, and guiding customers through product selection, installation, and maintenance.
  • Strong Communication and Collaboration: Excellent interpersonal, negotiation, and persuasion skills to foster positive relationships with customers, vendors, and internal teams.
  • Time and Task Management: Highly organized with strong time management skills, ensuring timely execution of tasks while balancing multiple priorities effectively.
  • Business Acumen: High level of business and financial acumen, enabling informed decision-making and alignment with organizational goals.
  • Self-Motivation and Discipline: Demonstrates intrinsic motivation, a disciplined work style, and the ability to work independently while contributing as part of a team.
  • Technology Proficiency: Skilled in using Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, Outlook) and CRM tools like Salesforce to document and manage sales opportunities.

Preferences:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in: Engineering, Business, or Business degree with strong hydraulic/pneumatic systems experience demonstrated.
  • Candidates must demonstrate strong experience with positive displacement, blower systems, vacuums, or rotating equipment.
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce and SAP

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:
Up to 50%+ overnight travel is expected. This is a remote based position that is to be located near a major airport in the Northeast U.S.

Pay Range: 
The total pay range for this role, not including incentive opportunities, is $110,000 - $125,000. The pay range takes into account a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location.  Hired applicant will be eligible to receive (discretionary/nondiscretionary) annual bonuses and incentive compensation.

job.description:
Ingersoll Rand is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.





The Microsoft 365 Administrator  will provide day-to-day administration, operational support, and troubleshooting for Ingersoll Rand’s global Microsoft 365 environment. This role supports Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business, Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Copilot, Power Platform, Microsoft Entra ID, and Microsoft Purview under established standards and guidance. The position is focused on resolving incidents and service requests, supporting standard changes, maintaining documentation, assisting with user enablement, and helping ensure a secure, reliable, and consistent Microsoft 365 experience across the enterprise.

Responsibilities:

Key responsibilities include:

  • Administer and support Microsoft 365 services across a global enterprise, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business, Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Copilot, and Power Platform.
  • Support Microsoft Purview administration activities, including retention, sensitivity labels, data loss prevention, eDiscovery support, and information protection tasks under defined processes.
  • Resolve assigned incidents and service requests, complete standard administrative tasks, document actions taken, and escalate complex issues when needed.
  • Follow governance standards, operational runbooks, service configuration guidance, and administrative controls to support secure and reliable collaboration services.
  • Monitor service health dashboards, message center updates, usage reports, and support queues to identify issues, trends, and service impacts.
  • Use PowerShell, Microsoft admin centers, Microsoft Graph Explorer, and standard reporting tools to support routine administration, troubleshooting, and repeatable support tasks.
  • Support Microsoft 365 licensing, group and mailbox administration, access requests, change records, incidents, and operational documentation in alignment with enterprise processes.
  • Provide administrative support and escalation assistance for Microsoft 365 platform issues, including permissions, mail flow, collaboration, identity, compliance, and service health incidents.
  • Partner with service desk, security, infrastructure, and application teams to troubleshoot escalated issues, validate changes, and support Microsoft 365 service operations.
  • Assist with Microsoft 365 migrations, integrations, testing, tenant cleanup, and lifecycle activities by completing assigned administrative tasks.
  • Create and maintain clear knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, runbooks, and support readiness materials for administrators, service desk teams, and end users.

Requirements:

Required qualifications include:

  • Associate degree or bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical IT administration experience.
  • 3+ years of experience administering or supporting Microsoft 365 services, with hands-on experience in Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business, Microsoft Teams, and Microsoft 365 admin centers.
  • Experience using PowerShell and Microsoft administration tools for mailbox, user, group, permission, reporting, and troubleshooting activities.
  • Experience working in ticket-based IT support environments, including incidents, service requests, standard changes, documentation, and escalation processes.
  • Experience assisting with technology projects, testing, service changes, implementation tasks, documentation updates, and post-launch support.
  • Strong communication, troubleshooting, customer service, and collaboration skills with the ability to work with global users, support teams, and technical partners.

Core Competencies:

  • Strong ownership of assigned tickets, tasks, and follow-ups with the ability to work within defined processes and escalate appropriately.
  • Customer-focused approach to resolving issues, improving support experiences, and helping users work effectively with Microsoft 365 tools.
  • Ability to balance operational support, administration, documentation, user support, and service improvement in a fast-moving enterprise environment.

Preferences:

The ideal candidate would possess one or more of the following:

  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Intune, OneDrive for Business, Microsoft Purview, conditional access, MFA, DLP, retention, sensitivity labels, and Microsoft 365 security and compliance controls.
  • Microsoft 365 Certified: Fundamentals, Messaging Administrator Associate, Teams Administrator Associate, or related Microsoft administrator certification.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Copilot administration, Power Platform administration, Microsoft Purview, or Microsoft Entra ID is preferred.
  • Experience creating support documentation, knowledge articles, standard operating procedures, or user-facing guidance for Microsoft 365 services.

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements 

  • This position is remote, with occasional travel as needed for team meetings, project work, or business requirements.

Job Overview:
The Field Service Technician for Ingersoll Rand's Compression Systems and Services Division serves customers by installing, troubleshooting, repairing, and maintaining all makes of rotary screw and reciprocating and/or Centac and ECC air compressors, along with additional compressed air system components. You will use precision measuring tools for diagnostic troubleshooting of compressed air equipment. In addition, you need to have knowledge of all operations and parts manuals associated with all equipment.

Responsibilities:
•In addition to performing preventative maintenance on Ingersoll Rand compressed air equipment, our service techs will interact with customers to address existing and unanticipated equipment concerns. 
•Collaborate with Service Coordinator on ordering and gathering parts and supplies necessary to complete installations and repairs. All service technicians will assist and train apprentices and Field Service Technicians.
•Effectively communicates verbally and in writing with customers and co-workers.
•Provides technical assistance on equipment pre-commissioning and start-ups, installations, and repairs of compressed air systems.  Including “hands-on” work to assure equipment operates to customer’s requirement with limited guidance from the Master Technician.
•Increases Ingersoll Rand customers awareness of how Ingersoll Rand products, services, and solutions, such as Preventative Maintenance, Diagnostics, Audits and Leak Detection can benefit their operations.

Requirements:
•2 years+ experience of troubleshooting industrial/commercial mechanical systems.
•Must possess a valid driver's license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years.
•Every service technician is required to be on-call, but you will not be on-call for the first 90 days to get used to the schedule. This is shared with every service tech, and it requires being available 24/7 for the 1-week duration where you will go to customer sites. On-call weeks can be as often as every 4 weeks or greater than 4 weeks, but that will be determined by the hiring manager.
•This position is highly physical and requires regular use of hands, fingers, walking, stooping, and kneeling.  It requires employees to regularly lift and or move weight limits in line with the safety policy.
•High School Diploma or equivalent required.

Core Competencies:
•Able to read wiring schematics and diagrams for all equipment.
•Advanced network systems installations (IMMC/ASC, X Series Automation).
•Basic vibration troubleshooting.
•Basic Air Quality (system compressor/dryer – air treatment).
•Operating knowledge of Microsoft office software and other basic computer usage.  Working proficiency with handheld computer (i.e. Smartphone, iPad) and network bases.
•Maintain proper business travel practices in a cost-efficient manner

Preferences:
•Industrial air compressor maintenance & knowledge.
•EPA Certification.
•Veterans/Active-Duty Military are encouraged to apply.

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:
•Service Technicians will travel daily in a 3-hour radius within our service area.
•A company vehicle and fuel card will be provided.

Pay Range: 
•The pay range for this role is $25.00 - $40.00. The pay range considers a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location.
