job.title: Service Technician
job.description:
Job title: Service Technician
Schedule: Monday - Friday, 7:30 AM - 4:30 PM 
Hourly Range: $23.55 - $36.63, weekly pay, based on experience, skills, qualifications, and geographic location. In addition to base pay, Ingersoll Rand offers a comprehensive benefits package, career development opportunities, and company-sponsored training.

Locations: 
Lee's Summit, MO 
Aurora, CO

About Us 
Cullum & Brown is an industry leading industrial equipment distributor and service company.  With over 135 years of industry experience, Cullum & Brown is a reliable solutions provider with locations in Kansas City and Springfield. We are an authorized distributor of Gardner Denver, Elmo Rietschle, Hoffman, Lamson, Tuthill pumps, Crane Deming, Travaini vacuum pumps, Graco, Dean Pumps, Grundfos, PowerEx, and Great Lakes. Cullum & Brown is proud to offer 24/7 emergency customer service for not only the brands we sell, but all makes and models. Our 18 factory-trained and certified technicians are prepared and the best in the industry. Join our team!  

Job Overview:
The Field Service Technician for Cullum & Brown's Compression Systems and Services Division serves customers by installing, troubleshooting, repairing, and maintaining all makes of rotary screw and reciprocating and/or Centac and ECC air compressors, along with additional compressed air system components. You will use precision measuring tools for diagnostic troubleshooting of compressed air equipment. In addition, you need to have knowledge of all operations and parts manuals associated with all equipment.

Responsibilities:
•In addition to performing preventative maintenance on Ingersoll Rand compressed air equipment, our service techs will interact with customers to address existing and unanticipated equipment concerns. 
•Collaborate with Service Coordinator on ordering and gathering parts and supplies necessary to complete installations and repairs. All service technicians will assist and train apprentices and Field Service Technicians.
•Effectively communicates verbally and in writing with customers and co-workers.
•Provides technical assistance on equipment pre-commissioning and start-ups, installations, and repairs of compressed air systems.  Including “hands-on” work to assure equipment operates to customer’s requirement with limited guidance from the Master Technician.
•Increases Ingersoll Rand customers awareness of how Ingersoll Rand products, services, and solutions, such as Preventative Maintenance, Diagnostics, Audits and Leak Detection can benefit their operations.

Requirements:
•2 years+ experience of troubleshooting industrial/commercial mechanical systems.
•Must possess a valid driver's license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years.
•Every service technician is required to be on-call, but you will not be on-call for the first 90 days to get used to the schedule. This is shared with every service tech, and it requires being available 24/7 for the 1-week duration where you will go to customer sites. On-call weeks can be as often as every 4 weeks or greater than 4 weeks, but that will be determined by the hiring manager.
•This position is highly physical and requires regular use of hands, fingers, walking, stooping, and kneeling.  It requires employees to regularly lift and or move weight limits in line with the safety policy.
•High School Diploma or equivalent required.

Core Competencies:
•Able to read wiring schematics and diagrams for all equipment.
•Advanced network systems installations (IMMC/ASC, X Series Automation).
•Basic vibration troubleshooting.
•Basic Air Quality (system compressor/dryer – air treatment).
•Operating knowledge of Microsoft office software and other basic computer usage.  Working proficiency with handheld computer (i.e. Smartphone, iPad) and network bases.
•Maintain proper business travel practices in a cost-efficient manner

Preferences:
•Industrial air compressor maintenance & knowledge.
•EPA Certification.
•Veterans/Active-Duty Military are encouraged to apply.

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:
•Service Technicians will travel daily in a 3-hour radius within our service area.
•A company vehicle and fuel card will be provided.

Pay Range: 
•The hourly pay range for this role is $23.55 - $36.63. The pay range considers a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location. 

What We Offer 
At Ingersoll Rand, we embrace a culture of personal ownership — taking responsibility for our company, our communities, and our environment, as well as our individual health and well-being. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to empower you with the tools and support necessary to take charge of your health, ensuring that together, we can continue to make life better. Our range of benefits includes health care options like medical and prescription plans, dental and vision coverage, as well as wellness programs. Additionally, we provide life insurance, a robust 401(k) plan, paid time off, and even an employee stock grant, among other offerings. These benefits are our commitment to you, so you can be your best.

TO APPLY: Please apply via our website https://careers.irco.com by 12/31/2026 in order to be considered for this position.

Job Overview

  • The Service Technician for Ingersoll Rand's Industrial Technologies and Services Division serves customers by installing, troubleshooting, repairing and maintaining all makes of rotary screw and reciprocating and/or Centac and ECC air compressors, along with additional compressed air system components. You will use precision measuring tools for diagnostic trouble shooting of compressed air equipment. In addition, you need to have knowledge of all operations and parts manuals associated with all equipment. 
     

Responsibilities

  • Ensure the correct installation, maintenance, and field repair of the equipment manufactured and sold by Ingersoll Rand at the purchaser's location. 

  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of the field installation and repair requirements of this equipment. 

  • Provide technical advice and be able to train customers, potential customers, field salesmen, and field service trainees.

  • Diagnose problems, recommend corrective action in this unsupervised environment and submit clear, accurate records and/or oral reports to the manufacturing facility. 

  • Maintain a high degree of integrity in handling business affairs.

  • Maintain proper written and oral communication skills to transfer information related to service work in a concise and logical manner. 

  • Submit detailed technical reports on each service call in a legible fashion, suitable for billing customers. 

  • Submit accurate, detailed & timely expense account records along with timecards on a weekly basis. Maintain good financial records and practices to manage company business matters, credit cards, and if required, a company car.

Requirements

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience of troubleshooting industrial/commercial mechanical systems. Experience on compressed air systems/centrifugal technologies/solid controls background is a plus. While not required, those with knowledge in the service, diagnosis, and startup of both rotary and centrifugal air compressors, including dryers, cooling towers, and filtration systems are encouraged to apply. 

  • High school diploma or equivalent required. .

Core Competencies 

  • Must possess a mechanic's set of tools; specialty tools will be provided. 

  • Must possess a valid driver's license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years

  • This position requires working in diverse conditions including but not limited to mechanical equipment rooms with exposure to noisy operating equipment, exposure to extreme weather conditions, precarious places, and risk of electrical shock (high voltage) with NFPA or equivalent standards. 
  • Operating knowledge of Microsoft office software and other basic computer usage. Working proficiency with handheld computer (i.e. Smartphone, iPad) and network bases.
  • Customer service skills such as conflict resolution, communication, negotiation, etc. 
  • Maintain proper business travel practices in a cost-efficient manner. 
  • Mechanical competency to be able to learn, diagnose, and troubleshoot compressor systems and machinery. 
  • This position is highly physical and requires regular use of hands, fingers, walking, stooping, and kneeling.  It requires employees to regularly lift and or move weight limits in line with the safety policy. 
Preferences

  • Desired degree program in Electrical/Electronic Technology or HVAC with basic knowledge of some or all of the following: AC/DC circuits, wiring diagrams/schematics, motors/controls, PLCs, HVAC electricity, controls, refrigeration systems and/or refrigerant certification. Military experience and/or sufficient mechanical working experience is a plus. Candidates who possess this knowledge or skills but have not completed a formal program may be considered. 

  • EPA 608 /F-GAS 303/2008/CE/ISHRAE Certification Preferred (Refrigeration experience/certification a plus).

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements 

  • This position may require occasional travel for training. 1-2 times per year for one week at a time. (5-10%). 

  • This position is included in an on-call rotation with other service technicians in the local area to service customer emergencies in the evenings or on weekends. Occasional evening or weekend work may be required during scheduled on-call weeks.

  • Act as key customer contact to provide information to customers on complete sales cycle from quote through delivery.
  • Mentor peers and share best practices with those less experienced as needed.  
  • Manage inventory to stocking levels. Ensure the order process is complete and error-free.  
  • Manage outside purchases and product transportation expenses effectively and efficiently.  
  • Ensure environmental, health and safety compliance.
  • Operate forklift in Parts Warehouse within compliance.  
  • Ensure that all paperwork, purchase orders, etc. are maintained to respond to customer inquiries timely and ensure internal process requirements.  
  • Prepare all sales and activity reports, presentations, studies and research as requested.

Requirements: 

  • High school diploma or GED required
  • 2+ years of customer service experience 

Core Competencies:

  • Uses data analysis and excellent processes to help predict problem areas and identify areas of opportunity.   
  • Ability to communicate effectively to all teammates, providing responses and updates timely   
  • Excellent multi-tasking skills to receive information and requests via multiple media methods    
  • Excellent written & verbal communication skills  
  • Organizational skills – ability to manage time and multi-task.  
  • Thinks and acts strategically   
  • Customer service focus – understand the need, solve problems, and respond in an efficient manner

Job Title: Project Manager

Location: Georgia, Tennessee, South Carolina

 

About Us 

Ingersoll Rand thrives on a culture of innovation and a sense of ownership, committed to enhancing the lives of our employees, customers, and the planet. With over 80 renowned brands, our customers rely on our products and services to deliver high-quality flow creation and industrial solutions designed to perform in the most complex and harsh conditions. Additionally, our unwavering commitment to ownership has enabled our employees to cultivate strong customer relationships, driving them to solve the industry’s most difficult problems. 

 

Job Summary 

  • Ingersoll Rand has a new exciting opportunity to join our organization as Project Manager you will manage all aspects of equipment projects, from beginning to end, with direct responsibility for project execution while leading a team, or teams, to accomplish specific objectives in a given time frame and with available resources. You will also be responsible for the administration, implementation, and management of control projects and accountable for assigned project’s scope of work, schedule, and budget. 

 

Responsibilities 

  • Performs construction plan review to meet customer requirements. Develops, evaluates, and discusses possible equipment solutions with appropriate Account Managers, Suppliers and customers.  

  • Coordinates selection, pricing, & integrates equipment, controls, & services for each project.  

  • Responsible for creating detailed cost estimates. Resolves major deviations from scope w/ team after Project Scope Validation.  

  • Responsible for identifying possible cost saving opportunities &/or risk items that will occur on various projects. Optimizes job costs by negotiating prices w/ vendors/sub-contractors through quotations for materials/services. Plans & analyzes assigned projects, establishes schedules & project parameters & sets procedures to accomplish system objectives, involving complex applications.  

  • Responsible for maintaining the accuracy of the forecasted cost at completion.  

  • Creates & makes revisions to project schedules including: generating tasks, estimates, dependencies; & milestones.  

  • Responsible for the preparation of material & vendor orders; recording the receipt of materials & approving payments.  

  • Responsible for entering equipment orders & issuing purchase orders for vendor orders. Generates work orders for equipment start-ups.  

  • Responsible for project cash-flow management: progress billing, collections support & monitoring, & resource management.  

  • Maintains customer satisfaction by investigating concerns, implementing corrective action, & communicating w/ customers & assigned staff.  

  • Responsible for the successful transition of warranty to the service process 
     

Basic Qualifications 

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, engineering technology or business management with 3-5 years of experience in estimating, engineering or construction management.  

  • Working knowledge of all facets of construction including mechanical, electrical, plumbing systems and knowledge with the operation of HVAC systems, electrical systems and temperature controls.  

  • Knowledge reading and understanding blueprints and construction plans and specifications.  

  • Experience with computer estimating and word processing software programs.  

 

Key Competencies 

  • Exceptional organization, communication (verbal and written), and follow-up skills with the ability to effectively manage a high volume of priorities and commitments with internal and external customers in a highly visible, fast-paced work environment.   

  • Strong interpersonal skills, able to follow standard processes and work autonomously while understanding when to escalate issues that require further review.   

  • Proven ability to collaborate, influence and support change with stakeholders across multiple levels of a global organization. 

 

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements 

  • This position may require travel: roughly 25%.

Job title: EPC Account Manager 

Location: Remote in Illinois or Texas 
 

About Us 
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.

 

Job Overview:

The EPC Account Manager serves as the primary commercial interface with assigned Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) firms and engineering organizations, driving specification influence, project pursuit activities, and profitable growth for centrifugal and rotary compressor solutions. This role is responsible for developing strategic customer relationships, identifying emerging opportunities, and positioning Ingersoll Rand as the preferred supplier for critical compression applications across targeted industrial markets. 

Working closely with Engineering, Tendering, Product Management, Project Management, and Field Service teams, the EPC Account Manager leads customer engagement from early project development through award and execution. The role supports projects across North America, with particular focus on key EPC and engineering hubs, including the Gulf Coast region, where strong customer relationships and early specification influence are critical to success.

Responsibilities:

  • Drive business development and revenue growth for centrifugal and rotary compressor solutions by engaging EPCs, engineering firms, end users, and key project stakeholders.
  • Identify, qualify, and pursue capital project opportunities while developing account strategies that increase specification influence, market presence, pipeline, bookings, revenue, and margin.
  • Build and maintain trusted customer and EPC relationships, positioning Ingersoll Rand as a preferred solutions provider and engaging stakeholders early in the project lifecycle.
  • Influence project specifications and bidding strategies through early collaboration with engineering and project teams to understand customer objectives and requirements.
  • Develop competitive, technically sound solutions in partnership with Engineering, Tendering, and Product Management, leveraging strong application knowledge and technical expertise.
  • Manage opportunities through the full sales cycle, including qualification, proposals, negotiations, awards, forecasting, and project execution support.
  • Maintain strong commercial and pipeline discipline through accurate Salesforce management, regular forecasting, cross-functional collaboration, and focus on project execution, cash flow, and customer satisfaction.
  • Serve as a strategic, technically credible, and results-oriented trusted advisor, effectively negotiating and collaborating with engineering, procurement, operations, and executive stakeholders to deliver sustainable customer and business outcomes.
Requirements:
•    Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Business, or a related field
•   5+ years of experience in compressor sales, rotating equipment, industrial capital equipment, or related markets. 
 

Preferences:
•    Demonstrated success selling complex engineered solutions through EPCs, engineering firms, industrial contractors, or large end-user organizations. 
•    Strong technical aptitude with the ability to understand complex customer applications and industrial processes.
•    Proven sales, negotiation, account management, and business development skills.
•    Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship-building capabilities. 
•    Experience with CRM systems; Salesforce experience preferred. 
•    Strong organizational, forecasting, and opportunity management skills. 

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements :
20% travel

Pay Range:

The total pay range for this role, not including incentive opportunities, is $125,000-$155,000. The pay range takes into account a wide range of factors that include a candidate’s skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and geographic location.  Hired applicant will be eligible to receive (discretionary/nondiscretionary) annual bonuses and incentive compensation.

Our range of benefits includes health care options like medical and prescription plans, dental and vision coverage, as well as wellness programs. Additionally, we provide life insurance, a robust 401(k) plan, paid time off, and even an employee stock grant, among other offerings. These benefits are our commitment to you, so you can be your best at work and beyond.

Job Title:  Field Service Technician, Electromechanical
Location: Blandon, PA  (Hybrid with travel)

About Us: 
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future. 

Job Overview:
Excelsior Blower Systems, a proud Ingersoll Rand brand, has been a powerhouse in engineered air solutions delivering decades of proven performance, reliability, and innovation. Backed by a legacy of excellence, we’re trusted across industries for systems that perform under pressure and consistently exceed expectations.  We’re looking for a hands-on Field Service Technician who thrives in the field and takes pride in keeping critical equipment running at peak performance. In this role, you’ll be the expert customers rely on—installing, maintaining, troubleshooting, and repairing Ingersoll Rand positive displacement (PD) blower systems, including controls and VFDs, directly at customer sites. You’ll play a vital role in delivering responsive, high-impact service that supports customers’ operational needs.  
Your work won’t stop in the field. You’ll also install controls and wiring for PD blower systems at our facility, applying your electromechanical expertise across the full equipment lifecycle. If you already bring PD blower experience, you’ll hit the ground running. If not, you bring a strong foundation in rotating equipment, motor and electrical troubleshooting, alignment, system-level diagnostics, and reading schematics and P&IDs—and the drive to master the rest. This is a role for someone who enjoys solving real-world problems, working independently, and making a visible impact every day. 

Responsibilities: 

  • Install, commission, and start up positive displacement (PD) blower packages, vacuum/pressure systems, and associated rotating equipment per OEM specifications and site requirements.

  • Configure, program, and troubleshoot variable frequency drives (VFDs) and soft starters (parameter setup, PID loops, accel/decel profiles, motor protection, fieldbus/communication interfaces such as Modbus/TCP, EtherNet/IP).

  • Diagnose and repair electrical controls including relays, contactors, motor starters, overloads, interlocks, safety circuits, and control transformers.

  • Perform control panel wiring and field terminations (24 VDC control, 120/480 VAC power, grounding/bonding, signal wiring, shielded cable practices); read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and P&IDs.

  • Install and integrate instrumentation (pressure, temperature, vibration, flow, differential pressure transmitters, proximity sensors, limit switches) and calibrate as required.

  • Execute mechanical service tasks (coupling alignment—laser or dial, belt tensioning, blower timing, bearing replacement, seal changes, lubrication, fastener torque verification).

  • Conduct vibration and performance checks; identify root cause of abnormal noise, heat, vibration, or amperage draw (airflow restrictions, leaks, misalignment, cavitation, resonance).

  • Troubleshoot system issues end-to-end across electrical, mechanical, and controls, including motor diagnostics (insulation resistance, megger testing, continuity), VFD/motor matching, and load-related faults.

  • Perform field measurements and documentation (voltage/current, phase balance, harmonics, airflow/pressure, vibration readings) and produce detailed service reports with parts lists and recommended follow-up.

Requirements:

  • High School diploma or GED
  • 5+ years of relevant / equivalent technical experience: millwright, maintenance, engineering, field service.
  • 2+ years of electromechanical experience
Core Competencies

  • Strong electromechanical troubleshooting skills, including rotating equipment such as motors, gearboxes, compressors, mixers, blowers, and pumps; electronic power conversion (AC to DC) and related faults/alarms (GF, OC, OV, UV, OL, OH); and PLC troubleshooting, including I/O, hardware, and software checks.
  • Clear and concise verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively and build strong relationships with customers, employees, and Sales Representatives.
  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills with demonstrated ability to troubleshoot issues, resolve conflicts, make sound decisions, and appropriately escalate problems in dynamic environments.
  • Strong organizational, prioritization, and time-management skills with the ability to meet deadlines and work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
  • Valid driver’s license held for at least 12 months with a satisfactory driving record. No major or frequent violations, including DUI within the past 5 years, hit-and-run, license suspension, reckless/careless driving, or multiple minor violations/preventable collisions within the past 3 years.
Travel & Work Arrangements

  • Position is 40% onsite shop repairs and up to 60% travel for field work
  • Possible minimal travel to Canada, Puerto Rico, and/or Mexico
  • Paid travel time at full hourly rate
  • Company vehicle and gas provided

Compression Technologies & Services is hiring for an Area Operations Leader to join our team. This position is responsible for providing the leadership for all activities in the value stream process from the time the customer center receives the purchase order (PO) for an equipment or services sale through PO closure. This position has responsibilities to all processes within that oversight, including service coordination, daily process management, order management, parts inventory and shipment, inside sales, invoicing and collections, and customer satisfaction for 4 customer center locations across Texas & Oklahoma.

 

Responsibilities: 

 

  • Monitor the order management process and identify process improvement opportunities to drive accuracy, efficiency, timeliness, and customer satisfaction.  
  • Collaborate with sales on contract terms and order processing to minimize errors and maximize accuracy and on time delivery.  
  • Collaborate with service to ensure optimal customer experience, parts and resource availability and technician productivity.    
  • Visit customers on a regular basis to understand process challenges and customer requirements.  
  • Effectively attract, coach, counsel, train and develop all inside sales employees.  Drive continuous improvement through company performance management process and technical product training programs available. Develop employee skill levels, including customer service, process and technical skills, to the highest degree possible.    
  • Proactively manage the workforce with cross-training and support to manage employee gaps, leveraging strengths and employee skill sets.  
  • Maximize cash flow by ensuring invoices are generated immediately upon completion of work, resolving disputes in a timely manner, managing budgets, and increasing utilization of sales support operations team. 
  • Create standard work processes where needed and ensure they are followed. Improve transactional processes impacting the customer experience and increase overall customer satisfaction.  
    Ensure environmental, health and safety compliance within service team. Provide training to all employees to ensure a safe and productive work environment.  
 

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s Degree required in a related discipline; Engineering, Technical, Marketing or Business preferred.
  • Individual must have a minimum of 7-10 years of experience in industrial product space, preferably with a diverse product portfolio including service offerings.
 

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:  

This position will be based out of one of the regional customer centers in Texas or Oklahoma with regional and overnight, out of town travel required (45-70%).  

 

Key Competencies: 

  • Leadership skills are essential. Individual must have a minimum of 3-5 years management experience; preferably in a customer-facing environment.
  • Work is completed through other employees, so this person must excel at hiring, developing, training, coaching, leading and motivating a diverse workforce for optimal results.
  • Profit & Loss experience is critical. Individual must have experience in forecasting needs, obtaining resources, and managing budgets.
  • A strategic business mindset is important. This individual must be able to support the Regional Director in creation of a strategic business plan to support the growth of the business through internal process improvements and lean strategies to positively impact our market position.

Job Title: Mechanical Engineer, Design Development               
Location:  Bentleyville, PA
 
About Us
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.  

Job Overview:
Step into a Mechanical Engineer, Design Development role with Ingersoll Rand’s Bentleyville, Pennsylvania site—a key North American engineering and packaging hub for Nash and MD Kinney liquid-ring vacuum pumps and compressors. The team supports a broad portfolio of rotating-equipment designs, global manufacturing, and U.S. service operations, with responsibility spanning product engineering, design support, packaging, and lifecycle support.

In this role, you’ll take meaningful ownership of complex rotating equipment within two established, market-leading product brands. You will support the design, development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of commercial liquid-ring vacuum pumps and compressors, including engineering changes, product data and documentation, manufacturing support, and technical collaboration with Quality, Operations, Service, Sales, and Product Management. You’ll contribute to both current product support and new product development, helping improve performance, reduce cost without compromising reliability, expand CFD capability, and advance proven technology into its next generation. Whether you’re early in your engineering career and ready for greater development ownership, or you’ve taken a broader path into mechanical/product design, this role offers room to grow your technical depth and impact.

What makes you an instant-yes candidate? You take ownership, work independently, stay organized, communicate effectively across teams, and keep projects moving with the right priorities and attention to detail. Technically, you bring a strong mechanical foundation and an interest in understanding the mechanics, assembly, and operation of rotating equipment. You can perform engineering calculations and analysis and are proficient in 3D CAD. Experience with FEA/CFD, vibration, fluid dynamics, troubleshooting, ERP/BOM ownership, or Ansys adds value. Direct Nash or MD Kinney experience is not required—a strong mechanical design and problem-solving foundation, combined with the ability to quickly develop deeper analytical skills, can be equally valuable.

Bring your mechanical design development expertise, curiosity, and ownership mindset—and help take proven Nash and MD Kinney technology into its next generation.

Responsibilities:
  • Support commercial liquid-ring vacuum pump and compressor product lines through product engineering, design improvements, performance evaluation, manufacturing support, and documentation.
  • Develop and maintain strong product knowledge across assigned configurations, components, applications, engineering data, and legacy/current platforms.
  • Execute product design and development activities from concept and design review through prototype support, validation, implementation, and release.
  • Improve product designs to enhance performance, reliability, manufacturability, serviceability, and cost effectiveness.
  • Create and maintain 3D CAD models, drawings, specifications, design layouts, bills of material, and supporting engineering records.
  • Prepare and implement ECRs, ECNs, drawing revisions, BOM updates, and product data changes, maintaining accurate engineering change histories.
  • Analyze test results, product performance, manufacturing feedback, field service data, and quality concerns to drive troubleshooting, corrective actions, and design improvements.
  • Partner with Manufacturing, Quality, Operations, Sourcing, Customer Service, Field Service, Sales, and Product Management, while managing multiple priorities and supporting authorized government, defense, or export-controlled projects as assigned.

Requirements
  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or related engineering discipline.
  • 3+ years of progressive experience in rotating equipment design, mechanical product design, industrial equipment design, or manufacturing engineering.
  • 2+ years experience maintaining engineering data within an ERP system, such as SAP.
  • 2+ years working knowledge of manufacturing processes to include machining, casting, fabrication, assembly, and rotating equipment design principles.
  • 1+ year of experience using 3D CAD software, ideally Autodesk Inventor.

Core Competencies 
  • Ownership & Accountability – Takes responsibility for assigned products, including design integrity, documentation accuracy, product performance, and continuous improvement.
  • Analytical Problem Solving – Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate technical issues, interpret data, and apply sound engineering judgment.
  • Mechanical Engineering Judgment – Applies sound mechanical engineering principles to balance performance, reliability, manufacturability, serviceability, and cost.
  • Data-Driven Decision Making – Uses engineering analysis, testing, manufacturing feedback, and field performance data to guide decisions and improvements.
  • Attention to Detail – Maintains accuracy across engineering documentation, bills of material, technical records, and change management.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration – Communicates effectively and works collaboratively with engineering, manufacturing, quality, service, sourcing, and other stakeholders.

Preferences: 
  • Experience with vacuum pumps, compressors, liquid ring equipment, or other rotating fluid machinery.
  • Experience applying mechanical products to customer operating conditions, performance requirements, or industrial process applications.
  • Experience with Finite Element Analysis (FEA) and Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) software, including ANSYS and/or Simerics MP+.
  • Experience with Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) tools; Windchill preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of thermodynamics, fluid dynamics, and compressible flow principles.
  • Experience with vibration analysis and/or acoustic analysis.

Travel & Work Arrangements
  • On-site position based in Bentleyville, PA.
  • Must hold US Citizenship due to assigned government engineering activies
  • Occasional travel may be required to support customers, suppliers, manufacturing facilities, or project activities.
  • Support for global product initiatives may be required as business needs dictate.

About Us: 
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Job Overview:
As the Quality Manager, you'll lead the Quality Department, playing a pivotal role in the local leadership team. Your primary responsibility will be ensuring compliance with ISO-9001 International Quality Standards, developing and maintaining all ISO 9001 procedures and audits at our facility. Collaborating closely with Procurement, you'll guarantee that external suppliers, both domestic and international, deliver raw materials and components that meet our engineering and purchasing specifications. We're seeking a candidate who can serve as a player-coach in a dynamic machining manufacturing environment, fostering effective collaboration with key stakeholders.

Responsibilities:

  • Supervise Quality Team and oversee plant warranty administration.
  • Create and foster a highly engaged and performing team, through strategic talent and engagement plans.
  • Manage plant compliance with ISO-9001 and ISO-14001 Quality System standards, coordinating ISO visits and managing corrective actions from external audits.
  • Drive improvement of First Pass-Yield data, supplier scorecards, warranty trends, and other quality metrics.

Job Overview:
Our Ingersoll Rand’s Compression Systems and Services Customer Center is hiring a General Line Account Manager to join their team. In this role, you will be responsible for driving the Customer Center equipment sales and service activity for a specific territory. Traveling in a defined geographic area, this includes quoting, strategizing, prospecting, and developing relationships to achieve revenue targets, maximize profits, increase market share and maintain customer loyalty while achieving organizational goals. The position is a unique blend of supporting a major distributor and selling direct to customers. 

Responsibilities:

  • Generate Revenue - Responsible for generating sales of equipment, service contracts, and service offerings with our direct end users and partners selling to a defined customer base within a geographic area.  Develop existing customer base and secure new, competitive accounts to expand IR presence in the market. Provide and design compressed air solutions to fulfill industrial customer needs. Products include compressed air equipment, accessories, turnkey installations, service contracts, parts, service, rental equipment and energy audits. Keep current with all product knowledge, industry standards and training needed. Execute strategy for continuous improvement and exceeding customer satisfaction. Achieve all assigned sales targets.  
  • Develop People Capabilities - Provide selling skills and product/services training for dealer sales personnel (as required) as well as personnel within customer center. Partner with services team to best understand products and services and satisfy and anticipate customer’s needs.  
  • Manage Cash - Ensure that all orders obtained are error-free with correct customer documentation. Ensure resolution of all customer disputes. Manage all costs associated with selling efforts, including travel and entertainment expenditures.   
  • Ensure adherence to safety rules (vehicle safety, customer site safety) in the field, as well as in the customer center.  
  • Earn Customer loyalty by collaborating cross functionally. Leverage best support for customers by partnering with service team to help troubleshoot customer issues or offer unique solutions.   
  • Maintain Customer Relationship Management database including face-to-face customer interactions, assets, agreements, contacts, and opportunities in order management system. Record order follow-up activities (e.g. delivery), reporting requirements (email) and database requirements. Provide feedback on market conditions. Responsible for driving and tracking sales pipeline of all account activity and daily reporting.  

Requirements:

  • High School Diploma 
  • 4+ years’ of experience in an industrial sales business setting

Core Competencies:

  • Excellent relationship-building and interpersonal skills, including verbal, written and presentation communication skills. 
  • Establishes and builds solid relationships with customers, key institutions and team members 
  • Honest, self-motivated and team oriented. 
  • Able to work within a team environment and independently. 
  • Mechanical and electrical expertise required. 
  • Ability to assess customer needs, analyze and interpret, perform basic equipment performance calculations, and to recommend technical solutions 
  • Tech savvy; knowledge of Salesforce preferred 
  • Proven business and sales acumen, including the ability to prospect accounts, effectively navigate within a customer organization, value sell, and win competitive accounts 
  • Must have excellent prioritization and time management skills  

Preferences:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, engineering technology, business or equivalent
  • Knowledge of Salesforce

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:

  • Regional travel to customer sites is required within assigned geographic territory.  
  • Must possess a valid driver’s license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations included, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years; Hit & Run; License Suspension; Reckless/Careless Driving; 
  • Multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years. 

Pay Range: The total pay range for this role, including incentive opportunities, is $60,000 - $180,000. The total pay range takes into account a wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including, but not limited to, skills; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed pay range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. Job Overview:
Our Ingersoll Rand’s Compression Systems and Services Customer Center is hiring a General Line Account Manager to join their team. In this role, you will be responsible for driving the Customer Center equipment sales and service activity for a specific territory. Traveling in a defined geographic area, this includes quoting, strategizing, prospecting, and developing relationships to achieve revenue targets, maximize profits, increase market share and maintain customer loyalty while achieving organizational goals. The position is a unique blend of supporting a major distributor and selling direct to customers. 

Responsibilities:

  • Generate Revenue - Responsible for generating sales of equipment, service contracts, and service offerings with our direct end users and partners selling to a defined customer base within a geographic area.  Develop existing customer base and secure new, competitive accounts to expand IR presence in the market. Provide and design compressed air solutions to fulfill industrial customer needs. Products include compressed air equipment, accessories, turnkey installations, service contracts, parts, service, rental equipment and energy audits. Keep current with all product knowledge, industry standards and training needed. Execute strategy for continuous improvement and exceeding customer satisfaction. Achieve all assigned sales targets.  
  • Develop People Capabilities - Provide selling skills and product/services training for dealer sales personnel (as required) as well as personnel within customer center. Partner with services team to best understand products and services and satisfy and anticipate customer’s needs.  
  • Manage Cash - Ensure that all orders obtained are error-free with correct customer documentation. Ensure resolution of all customer disputes. Manage all costs associated with selling efforts, including travel and entertainment expenditures.   
  • Ensure adherence to safety rules (vehicle safety, customer site safety) in the field, as well as in the customer center.  
  • Earn Customer loyalty by collaborating cross functionally. Leverage best support for customers by partnering with service team to help troubleshoot customer issues or offer unique solutions.   
  • Maintain Customer Relationship Management database including face-to-face customer interactions, assets, agreements, contacts, and opportunities in order management system. Record order follow-up activities (e.g. delivery), reporting requirements (email) and database requirements. Provide feedback on market conditions. Responsible for driving and tracking sales pipeline of all account activity and daily reporting.  

Requirements:

  • High School Diploma 
  • 4+ years’ of experience in an industrial sales business setting

Core Competencies:

  • Excellent relationship-building and interpersonal skills, including verbal, written and presentation communication skills. 
  • Establishes and builds solid relationships with customers, key institutions and team members 
  • Honest, self-motivated and team oriented. 
  • Able to work within a team environment and independently. 
  • Mechanical and electrical expertise required. 
  • Ability to assess customer needs, analyze and interpret, perform basic equipment performance calculations, and to recommend technical solutions 
  • Tech savvy; knowledge of Salesforce preferred 
  • Proven business and sales acumen, including the ability to prospect accounts, effectively navigate within a customer organization, value sell, and win competitive accounts 
  • Must have excellent prioritization and time management skills  

Preferences:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, engineering technology, business or equivalent
  • Knowledge of Salesforce

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:

  • Regional travel to customer sites is required within assigned geographic territory.

  • Multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years.

Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Job Overview:
As the Quality Manager, you'll lead the Quality Department, playing a pivotal role in the local leadership team. Your primary responsibility will be ensuring compliance with ISO-9001 International Quality Standards, developing and maintaining all ISO 9001 procedures and audits at our facility. Collaborating closely with Procurement, you'll guarantee that external suppliers, both domestic and international, deliver raw materials and components that meet our engineering and purchasing specifications. We're seeking a candidate who can serve as a player-coach in a dynamic machining manufacturing environment, fostering effective collaboration with key stakeholders.

Responsibilities:

  • Supervise Quality Team and oversee plant warranty administration.
  • Create and foster a highly engaged and performing team, through strategic talent and engagement plans.
  • Manage plant compliance with ISO-9001 and ISO-14001 Quality System standards, coordinating ISO visits and managing corrective actions from external audits.
  • Drive improvement of First Pass-Yield data, supplier scorecards, warranty trends, and other quality metrics.
  • Manage key processes such as 4D/8D, SCAR, CAPA to enhance Customer Satisfaction and improve Supplier performance.
  • Develop and implement effective quality control processes aligned with customer needs and requirements.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Operations, Purchasing, Engineering, and Customer Service Teams to address customer and production issues for product portfolio (legacy and/or new products).
  • Partner with Manufacturing Engineers to troubleshoot and resolve quality-related production issues.
  • Collaborate with external vendors to enhance manufacturing processes for purchased components.
  • Actively engage in Kaizen Events and Lean activities to improve quality and reduce manufacturing waste and costs.
  • Utilize advanced Quality Assurance techniques (FMEA, CMM Inspection, GD&T, Gage R&R Studies, Process Capability Studies, Six Sigma, statistical quality/process control methods) to proactively manage product quality.
Requirements:

  • Bachelor's Degree in related field (Mechanical/Industrial Engineering).
  • 8+ years of quality assurance experience, ideally in a machining/assembly facility.
  • 5+ years of progressive leadership, managing quality assurance programs and leading audits.
  • 1+ years of experience in Manufacturing/Quality Engineering in machining manufacturing, utilizing Lean Six Sigma techniques.
  • 1+ years of experience in regulatory accreditation processes (UL, CE, ATEX, IECEx, CSA, CSA-UK, TUV, NSF, RoHS, REACH, Prop 65, ITAR, and related).
  • 1+ years of experience in managing and implementing quality control procedures and relevant standards.
  • 1+ years of experience with ERP systems.

Preferences:
  • Engineering Management preferred
  • SAP experience preferred
Core Competencies:

  • Demonstrated mechanical aptitude and knowledge of general machinery.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with advanced proficiency in Microsoft Suite.
  • Leads Authentically: Exhibits a poised and calm demeanor that instills confidence and respect, while embodying humility and consideration for others. Advocates for the organization's mission and values authentically.
  • Project Management: Proven track record in effectively managing projects, adept at organizing tasks and optimizing time management to handle multiple assignments concurrently within set timelines and budget constraints.
  • Decisiveness and Results Orientation: Demonstrates the ability to make timely decisions with creativity and sound judgment. Utilizes rigorous logic and problem-solving methods to devise effective solutions for complex issues. Capable of articulating rationale clearly and compellingly, ensuring understanding and buy-in from stakeholders. Consistently delivers on commitments.
  • Customer Focus: Committed to meeting the needs and expectations of both internal and external customers, ensuring their satisfaction remains a top priority.
Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:

  • Onsite

This is more than just a job; it’s an opportunity to be part of a company that values creativity, excellence, and collaboration. 

Responsibilities:

  • Performs set ups of large Liquid Ring Vacuum Pump components and operations of large Vertical & Horizontal Lathes used to repair and overhaul Large Liquid Rind Vacuum Pumps & Compressors. 
  • Interprets blueprints/drawings to determine critical dimensions, etc. Ability to read Micrometers, Vernier Calipers, Dial Indicators & other precision measuring & test equipment as required. 
  • Able to maintain low tolerances as indicated by specifications or drawings as low as .0005” at times. 
  • Understands how to select appropriate cutting tools for various metals. Understands how to determine speeds and feeds to obtain proper surface finish.
  • Able to work overtime; typically, throughout the week and occasionally on weekends. 
  • Safe operation of Forklift within a Machine Shop environment. Safe Over Head Crane operation. Adheres to all company EH&S & QMS processes.
  • Lifting and rigging of heavy components of various configurations & weights. Assisting in the disassembly, reassembly, repair and rebuilding of Large Liquid Ring Vacuum Pumps.
  • Other responsibilities as assigned. 


Requirements:

  • Applicants will be required to demonstrate knowledge of machine setup, as well as usage of machine controls and capabilities. 
  • 3+ years of experience as a machine operator/Machinist.
  • 2+ or more years of experience reading and interpreting blueprints.  
  • 1+ or more years of experience working on king style boring mills (or vtls) 
  • Ability to effectively and safely use a variety of tools and equipment, including but not limited to depth gauges, bore gauges, height gauges, feeler gauges, micrometers, calipers, deburring tools, die grinders, drill presses, and overhead lifting equipment.


Core Competencies: 

  • Proficiency with prioritizing and meeting multiple deadlines.
  • Ability to convert between metric and US standard units of measure.
  • Ability to deal with problems involving several variables 
  • Ability to use standard problem-solving methods (i.e. 5 Whys) as trained 
  • Ability to effectively share information about job duties in one-on-one and small group situations to supervisor, customers, clients, and other employees of the organization. 



Preferences: 

  • HS Diploma or GED preferred. Higher Education or certificate is a plus.
  • Experience with manual machining such as VTL/Boring Mill/ or Horizontal Lathe. Brands would include but not limited to Cincinnati and King brand.
  • Proven ability to set up and operate Manual Machines, work centers, specializing in tool changes and in-process offset adjustments. 



Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements: 

  • This position will be based 100% onsite at our Moody, AL facility

Job Overview:  
The Regional Sales Manager will concentrate on assigned product and/or group of products in order to increase revenue, market share and profitability for assigned product. Job Overview:
The Centrifugal Service Technician – Compression Technologies and Services serves customers by installing, trouble shooting, repairing and maintaining our centrifugal compressor product lines including Centac and Turbo Air models, along with additional compressed air system components. You will use precision measuring tools for diagnostic trouble shooting of compressed air equipment. In addition, you need to have knowledge of all operations and parts manuals associated with all equipment. 


Responsibilities:

  • Provide technical assistance on equipment pre-commissioning and start-ups, installations, and repairs of compressed air systems, including “hands-on” work to assure equipment operates to customer’s requirement.
  • Read wiring schematics and diagrams for equipment, research complex technical issues, and find/implement solutions. 
  • Document service and installation activities by completing work orders for each job, performing maintenance checklists, and maintaining daily time sheets.
  • Maintain rapport with customers by suggesting improved methods and techniques and recommending system improvements. Increase Ingersoll Rand customer’s awareness of how Ingersoll Rand products, services and solutions; such as Package CARE, Preventative Maintenance, Diagnostics, Audits, and Leak Detection, can benefit their operations.
  • Conduct safety assessments of a continuously changing work environment. Ensure proper operation of compressed air equipment by completing preventative maintenance requirements and 47-point inspections on a wide variety of compressors, refrigerated dryers, desiccant dryers and additional compressed air components.
  • Work with Service Coordinator and operations teams on ordering and gathering parts and supplies necessary to complete installations and repairs.
  • Explain practices, procedures, and policies to reach agreement with suppliers and others outside of the job area.
  • Conduct basic vibration and air quality troubleshooting. 

Requirements:

  • Desired applicants will have 3-5 years’ of Centrifugal compressor experience.
  • High school diploma or equivalent required.  
  • Must possess a valid driver's license for a minimum of 12 months, with no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 5 years, Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless/Careless Driving or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years.
 

Core Competencies: 

  • Operating knowledge of Microsoft office software and other basic computer usage. Proficiency with hand held computer (i.e. Smartphone, iPad) and network bases. 
  • Excellent verbal/written communication skills and customer service skills including conflict resolution, communication, negotiation, etc. 
  • Ability to work in diverse conditions including but not limited to mechanical equipment rooms with exposure to noisy operating equipment, exposure to extreme weather conditions, precarious places, and risk of electrical shock (high voltage) with NFPA or equivalent standards. 
  • This position is highly physical and requires regular use of hands, fingers, walking, stooping, and kneeling, and requires employees to regularly lift and or move weight limits in line with the safety policy. 

Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements:

  • Daily travel to customer sites, occasional overtime, and regular overnight stays required.

You will use precision measuring tools for diagnostic troubleshooting of compressed air equipment. Collaborate with Service Coordinator on ordering and gathering parts and supplies necessary to complete installations and repairs. All service technicians will assist and train apprentices and Field Service Technicians.

  • Effectively communicates verbally and in writing with customers and co-workers.

On-call weeks can be as often as every 4 weeks or greater than 4 weeks, but that will be determined by the hiring manager.

  • Veterans/Active-Duty Military are encouraged to apply.

Job Title: Sourcing Engineer                
Location: Sedalia, MO 
 
About Us
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.  

Job Overview:
Step into a highly visible sourcing role where no two days are the same. The Sourcing Engineer will balance forward-looking supply chain improvement with hands-on support of the Sedalia manufacturing operation. Approximately half of the role will focus on strengthening the supply chain and supplier partnerships, while the other half will involve working closely with the materials team to address supplier escalations and help ensure the plant has the components needed to meet production and revenue commitments. The balance will shift as business priorities change, giving this individual exposure to a wide range of challenges and opportunities.

Working across Sedalia’s diverse product lines and active global supply network, the Sourcing Engineer will turn complex data into practical business strategies, build productive supplier relationships, and help navigate issues ranging from delayed materials to broader supply disruptions and resourcing needs. This is not a transactional purchasing position—the individual will serve as a trusted problem-solver who connects suppliers, materials, operations, and other internal partners to keep critical work moving forward.

This opportunity is ideal for someone who enjoys variety, thrives on solving new problems, and wants to see the direct impact of their work on both plant performance and long-term supply chain success. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to take ownership of meaningful initiatives within the first few months, expand their knowledge of Sedalia’s products and operations, and grow into a fully integrated member of a collaborative, fast-moving team.

Responsibilities

Cost Reduction & Sourcing Projects
  • Identify, develop, and manage sourcing projects that reduce material costs and achieve savings goals.
  • Analyze spend, purchase price variance, materials, and other data to identify new savings opportunities.
  • Maintain sourcing/savings project tracking and lead cross-functional reviews to drive projects to completion.
  • Track sourcing activity, savings, and performance results to ensure accurate and timely reporting.
Supplier Sourcing & Commercial Negotiations
  • Identify and develop new suppliers and improve the value delivered by existing suppliers.
  • Lead RFP/RFQ activities in partnership with internal stakeholders.
  • Negotiate supplier pricing, payment terms, lead times, inventory programs, and other commercial terms.
  • Monitor purchase price variances and resolve discrepancies with suppliers and internal teams.
Supplier Development & Performance
  • Partner with suppliers and internal teams to qualify new parts and support sourcing transitions.
  • Address significant or systemic supplier performance issues involving quality, delivery, warranty, cost, or other concerns.
  • Work with suppliers to improve overall performance and support sourcing objectives.
Market Intelligence & Special Projects
  • Monitor commodity pricing, market trends, and domestic/international events that may affect supplier pricing or supply.
  • Participate in special projects and perform additional responsibilities as assigned.

Requirements:
  • High School Diploma or GED
  • 3+ years of progressive experience in sourcing, procurement, supply chain, or supplier management.
  • 2+ years of experience negotiating directly with suppliers on pricing, cost increases, payment terms, lead times, inventory programs, or other commercial terms.
  • 2+ years of experience analyzing sourcing, spend, pricing, PPV, or supplier data to identify savings opportunities and support business decisions.
  • 2+ years of experience using Excel for data analysis, including pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, financial or logical functions, and multiple worksheets/workbooks.
  • 1+ years of experience leading sourcing initiatives, such as RFQ/RFP activities, cost-reduction projects, supplier development, resourcing, or new supplier qualification.

Core Competencies:
  • Cost Optimization & Value Creation – Identifies and drives opportunities to reduce material costs and improve supplier value.
  • Sourcing Project Management – Organizes, tracks, and drives sourcing initiatives from identification through completion.
  • Supplier Development & Performance Management – Builds supplier capability and addresses quality, delivery, warranty, and other performance issues.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration – Coordinates effectively with internal stakeholders to advance sourcing initiatives, RFPs, and new-part qualification.
  • Commercial & Business Acumen – Understands the business impact of pricing, payment terms, lead times, inventory programs, and sourcing decisions.

The Sourcing Engineer will balance forward-looking supply chain improvement with hands-on support of the Sedalia manufacturing operation. Approximately half of the role will focus on strengthening the supply chain and supplier partnerships, while the other half will involve working closely with the materials team to address supplier escalations and help ensure the plant has the components needed to meet production and revenue commitments. The balance will shift as business priorities change, giving this individual exposure to a wide range of challenges and opportunities.

Working across Sedalia’s diverse product lines and active global supply network, the Sourcing Engineer will turn complex data into practical business strategies, build productive supplier relationships, and help navigate issues ranging from delayed materials to broader supply disruptions and resourcing needs. This is not a transactional purchasing position—the individual will serve as a trusted problem-solver who connects suppliers, materials, operations, and other internal partners to keep critical work moving forward.

This opportunity is ideal for someone who enjoys variety, thrives on solving new problems, and wants to see the direct impact of their work on both plant performance and long-term supply chain success. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to take ownership of meaningful initiatives within the first few months, expand their knowledge of Sedalia’s products and operations, and grow into a fully integrated member of a collaborative, fast-moving team.

Cost Reduction & Sourcing Projects
  • Identify, develop, and manage sourcing projects that reduce material costs and achieve savings goals.

  • Track sourcing activity, savings, and performance results to ensure accurate and timely reporting.
Supplier Sourcing & Commercial Negotiations
  • Identify and develop new suppliers and improve the value delivered by existing suppliers.
  • Lead RFP/RFQ activities in partnership with internal stakeholders.
  • Negotiate supplier pricing, payment terms, lead times, inventory programs, and other commercial terms.
  • Monitor purchase price variances and resolve discrepancies with suppliers and internal teams.
Supplier Development & Performance
  • Partner with suppliers and internal teams to qualify new parts and support sourcing transitions.
  • Address significant or systemic supplier performance issues involving quality, delivery, warranty, cost, or other concerns.
  • Work with suppliers to improve overall performance and support sourcing objectives.
Market Intelligence & Special Projects
  • Monitor commodity pricing, market trends, and domestic/international events that may affect supplier pricing or supply.
  • Participate in special projects and perform additional responsibilities as assigned.

Requirements:
  • High School Diploma or GED
  • 3+ years of progressive experience in sourcing, procurement, supply chain, or supplier management.
  • 2+ years of experience negotiating directly with suppliers on pricing, cost increases, payment terms, lead times, inventory programs, or other commercial terms.
  • 2+ years of experience analyzing sourcing, spend, pricing, PPV, or supplier data to identify savings opportunities and support business decisions.
  • 2+ years of experience using Excel for data analysis, including pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, financial or logical functions, and multiple worksheets/workbooks.
  • 1+ years of experience leading sourcing initiatives, such as RFQ/RFP activities, cost-reduction projects, supplier development, resourcing, or new supplier qualification.

  • Cost Optimization & Value Creation – Identifies and drives opportunities to reduce material costs and improve supplier value.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration – Coordinates effectively with internal stakeholders to advance sourcing initiatives, RFPs, and new-part qualification.
  • Commercial & Business Acumen – Understands the business impact of pricing, payment terms, lead times, inventory programs, and sourcing decisions.
  • Market & Commodity Awareness – Monitors market conditions, commodity trends, and global events that may affect supplier cost or availability.

Preferences:
  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Business, or related field
  • Manufacturing sourcing/procurement experience
  • Global and/or Low-Cost-Country sourcing experience
  • SAP or other ERP/MRP experience

  • Designs tooling, gages and fixtures using 3D modeling software
  • Develops manufacturing routings internal and sub-con operations

  • Innovation: Creative thinking to introduce new manufacturing solutions. 
  • Leadership: Ability to train and guide production staff.

  • Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing Techniques and ability to create standard work.
  • Fluent using inspection tools, techniques and their application to the engineering requirements.
  • Proficient in gear or helical grinding.
  • Understanding of rotary screw compressors and/or centrifugal compressors.

job.description:

Job Title: Supply Chain Leader                
Location: Southern Pines, NC 
 
About Us
Imagine a company with technology leadership of over 160 years, yet it operates with the energy of a startup. Ingersoll Rand has dedicated itself to Making Life Better for its employees, customers, shareholders, and planets. We produce innovative and mission-critical flow creation and life science technologies – from compressors to precision handling of liquids, gasses, and powers – to increase industrial productivity, efficiency, and sustainability. Supported by over 80+ brands, our products are used in various end-markets including life sciences, food and beverage, clean energy, industrial manufacturing, infrastructure, and more. Across the globe, we’re driving growth with an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset. Learn more at irco.com and join us to own your future.  

Job Overview:
Are you a supply chain leader who enjoys owning the full picture—people, materials, suppliers, schedules, inventory, and customer delivery? This role offers the opportunity to lead a buyer/planner/scheduler team supporting a defined value stream within the Southern Pines manufacturing operation. You’ll have the autonomy to run your portion of the business, partner closely with operations and supply chain peers, and directly impact on-time shipment, inventory performance, supplier accountability, and production execution. The Supply Chain Leader will own supply chain activities for a defined value stream/product family, ensuring customer demand is supported with the right material at the right time while balancing inventory and operational priorities. You’ll lead a team of buyers, planners, and schedulers responsible for material availability, production scheduling, supplier follow-up, inventory management, and customer shipment commitments. 

This is a highly visible, hands-on leadership role working across supply chain, manufacturing operations, suppliers, and business-unit stakeholders to keep production moving, reduce past-due backlog, improve on-time shipment, and strengthen inventory and supplier performance. The ideal candidate will bring strong buying, planning, scheduling, or materials experience within a manufacturing environment—preferably assembly-based—with exposure to bills of material, ERP systems, supplier constraints, production schedules, and customer delivery requirements. Experience with the company’s specific ERP system is not required, but you should understand how ERP supports plant supply chain operations and be comfortable using data, Excel, and disciplined follow-up to drive results. Success will also require strong communication, organization, follow-through, and the ability to build effective relationships with direct reports and cross-functional partners.

For a supply chain professional seeking autonomy, team leadership, and visible impact, this is an opportunity to strengthen performance and drive meaningful improvement within an established business.

Responsibilities:

Production Planning & Scheduling:
  • Translate the monthly SIOP consensus plan by product family into a detailed weekly Master Production Schedule (MPS) with a 12–18-month planning horizon in the ERP for weekly MRP generation.
  • Maintain the material plan within the time fence to ensure continuity of supply.
  • Identify and resolve capacity, resource, and material constraints.
  • Facilitate long-term capacity assessments (RCCP) and develop countermeasure/action plans.
  • Conduct lead-time analysis, measure gaps against published lead times, drive corrective actions, and update published lead times as needed.
  • Coordinate with planners to achieve assigned serviceability and inventory goals.
  • Interface with required functional groups to resolve challenging delivery requirements.
ERP / MRP Management & Data Integrity:
  • Monitor and drive resolution of MRP processing errors.
  • Manage ERP-generated exception messages in a timely manner.
  • Serve as the factory subject matter expert (SME) for ERP production planning and scheduling modules within the assigned business unit.
  • Maintain the integrity of ERP planning parameters, including lead times, lot sizes, safety stock, delivery times, and order file data for all master-scheduled items.
  • Maintain item master lead-time information based on process improvements, current constraints, total demand by product family, and priority requirements.
Supplier Management & Material Availability:
  • Engage with suppliers to secure inventory flow needed to support plant shipment goals.
  • Communicate forecasts and replenishment plans to suppliers.
  • Review open requirements, monitor supplier performance, and expedite deliveries as needed.
  • Expedite deliveries to meet or exceed critical schedule requirements.
  • Ensure supplier issues related to delivery, quality, or pricing are communicated and resolved promptly.
  • Coordinate with Quality Assurance to resolve supplier quality issues.
  • Resolve invoicing discrepancies with suppliers and Accounting.
  • Develop effective methods for monitoring supplier agreements that support future cost savings and inventory goals.
Customer Delivery & Service Support:
  • Support Customer Service with exception-request analysis and expediting resolution.
  • Help drive delivery performance, reduce supply disruptions, and support customer shipment commitments.
  • Apply root-cause problem solving to resolve supply disruptions and achieve inventory targets.
Reporting & Performance Management:
  • Create and publish daily, weekly, and monthly reports covering factory schedule adherence, capacity, and inventory.
  • Analyze and report key performance indicators, including delivery performance, backlog, performance to master schedule, and inventory turns.
  • Maintain productivity pipelines and financial records used to report and track improvement initiatives.
Continuous Improvement & Cost Productivity:
  • Drive continuous process improvement and identify opportunities to increase efficiency.
  • Challenge existing processes when more effective alternatives are available.
  • Identify and implement cost-reduction and productivity projects aligned with corporate initiatives and goals.
Team Leadership & Development:
  • Develop, coach, and mentor team members to achieve outstanding results.
  • Lead and direct others as needed to accomplish organizational objectives.
Project & Cross-Functional Support: Manage projects and perform other duties as needed.

Requirements:
  • BS/BA degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or a related discipline preferred; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
  • 5+ years of manufacturing supply chain experience, including materials management, buying, planning, production control, master scheduling, inventory, and customer delivery support.
  • 3+ years supporting material availability, production schedules, MRP/ERP-driven planning, inventory performance, customer demand, and plant shipment targets.
  • 3+ years working directly with suppliers to manage material availability, delivery performance, follow-up, issue resolution, and accountability.
  • 2+ years leading, coaching, mentoring, or providing day-to-day direction to buyers, planners, schedulers, materials, or other supply chain team members.
  • Strong working knowledge of ERP/MRP systems and proficiency with Microsoft Excel required.

Core Competencies
  • Decision-Making & Prioritization: Able to make sound, complex decisions with limited time and information, using business priorities to establish clear decision criteria.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Builds effective partnerships across functions and works successfully with internal teams, external resources, suppliers, and business partners.
  • Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills: Strong analytical capability with the ability to evaluate data, identify root causes, and independently resolve problems; working knowledge of basic statistical analysis techniques.
  • Leadership & Influence: Proven ability to lead, influence, and manage competing requirements while effectively guiding discussions with peers, matrix partners, operational teams, and leadership.
  • Communication & Interpersonal Effectiveness: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to lead productive discussions, challenge perspectives, and drive alignment.
  • Organization & Follow-Through: Demonstrated ability to stay organized, manage competing priorities, follow up consistently, work cross-functionally, and drive actions through completion.
  • Data Analysis & Reporting: Proficient in accessing, manipulating, and analyzing data using Microsoft Excel and other available reporting tools.
  • ERP Systems Knowledge: Working knowledge of ERP systems and their application within planning, materials, and manufacturing operations.

Preferences:
  • Demonstrated success improving on-time delivery, customer service levels, inventory performance, and/or past-due backlog.
  • Experience working with bills of material (BOMs) within a manufacturing supply chain environment.
  • Machining and castings experience.
  • Experience with QAD and/or Oracle ERP systems.
  • Experience within rate-based, flow-line, non-MRP, and/or job shop manufacturing environments.
  • Experience with lean manufacturing practices and visual management systems.
  • Experience supporting new product introductions and/or value stream/product family supply chain activities.

Travel and Work Arrangements 
  • CPIM certification
  • Minimal travel (<10%), primarily to suppliers as needed.
  • Required PPE includes safety glasses, hearing protection, steel-toe shoes, and gloves when handling parts. 
  • Office and manufacturing environment with occasional exposure to moving equipment and permissible levels of coolant/oil mist. Moderate noise levels.

What We Offer
